khong, tieng choi, khong chiu rang co. chang co. khong co. chang phai. chang co nhu vay, khong phai la; quay. chang hay. khong biet, chang kha. chang qua la. chang co the gi khac; qua thiet la. no ve som, chang qua la no tron hoc. chang lua la noi. chang can chi phai noi. bat tat phai noi; chang phai noi lam chi. chang chi. chang can chi; chang co chi thi... chang them. chang cau, chang muon. chang dong. khong da dong; chang nhuc nhich; chang cam dong. chang bon. chang dinh dap, chang chut bon nho. chang co khi sai. thiet muc, mot muc, co chung. phai chang. dieu phai su quay. chang nen. trai phep, trai le; khong co phep, khong duoc (tieng cam ngan). chang xiet. ke khong cung. chang het. chang cung, hay con nua, chang thieu chi. qua co canh vui, chang het cho tao di, chi nghia la hay con co tao di. chang thieu. nhieu lam, du dat; vua du. chang thieu chi nguoi. chang cau. chang muon, chang cay. chang trong. khong vong, khong cho. chang ham. khong ham, khong them. chang may. rui ro; nhu co deu rui. chang ky. chang phan biet, chang lua. chang luan. id. chang ngon cung sot chang tot cung moi. qui tai long thao lao, nhut la trong luc ban so. chang cung. chang het, con hoai hoai. chang hay cung. chang hay het, chang thieu gi khi. chang hay vua cung. id. cuc chang da. ngat qua, cung tung qua; bat dac di. chang bang. khong bang; chi bang, sao cho bang, hay hon la. bang chang. neu khong, neu chang; vi bang khong. chang vay. chang co nhu vay, chang duoc nhu vay.

chung, net. chung chang. lam bo nung nay, lam bo gian ma doi cho duoc su gi. nhu con nit chung chang doi an. chang kiep gi vay? chung cach gi vay, lam the gi vay. (tieng duc nhau). sinh chang. khong thuan tinh, sinh tat, nay muon cai nay, mai muon cai khac. trai chang. trai thoi, trac treo, muon do, khong do; vui do buon do. di lang chang. di lung cung, di khong vung.

loai quit, ma nho cay, nho trai, mong vo, nhieu nuoc chua. cay chanh. id. trai chanh. id. chanh giay. thu chanh lon trai ma mong vo. chanh num. thu chanh lon trai va co num tai cuong trai. chanh khe mot long, buoi bong mot da. ai ai cung co mot bung ghen tuong (don ba). co khe, e chanh. giem nhau, lam cho mat qui; dang buong nay, khuay buong no. chanh ranh. bo chang rang, khong nen net; lia lia. lanh chanh. id. bong chanh. net bong chanh, nhe da, khong nen net; hay deo bong. chanh nuoc. doc nuoc, nuoc uong hay sanh benh.
cam dong. chanh nho. cam nho. chanh long. dong long. chanh tuong. nho tuong. chanh thuong. dong long thuong. chanh gan vang. dong long.

viec chanh, viec tri ly. (coi chu chinh). chanh su. viec nuoc nha. chanh giao. phep truyen day, luat phep trong nuoc. chanh lenh. id. quac chanh. viec nuoc nha; gieng moi trong nuoc. trieu chanh. viec trieu dinh. nhon chanh. phep tri dan co nhon. duc chanh. phep tri dan co duc. hinh chanh. hinh luat, phep sua tri ke co toi. chap chanh. cam quon quan tri. binh chanh. id. than chanh. vua lanh lay viec tri nuoc. (noi ve vua moi lon len). tan chanh. nha nuoc moi, phep nuoc moi. bo chanh su. quan tinh hay viec tri dan, vang ban phep nuoc. chanh tich. cong nghiep lam quan. thong chanh su. quan lon dong viec thong goi van tho, so sach. that chanh. bay vi hanh tinh la mat troi, mat trang cung nam vi sao ngu hanh. thien chanh. phep nuoc khon ngoan. can chanh dien. den ngu truyen viec chanh. hoc chanh. phep day hoc, chuc quan lanh viec day hoc. phu chanh. quan hau gan hoan de, phu viec tri nuoc. quan chanh. phep hinh, dieu luat ve viec binh. luat chanh. phep luat, luat le. thuong chanh. phep buon ban, dieu le noi ve viec buon ban. de chanh. phep coi giu cac bo de. bo chanh chau. ten chau o giap tinh nghe-an. nong chanh. phep day ve viec lam ruong. thuyen chanh. phep noi ve viec tau thuyen.

nhanh cay; sa ra. chanh hoa. nhanh hoa. chanh ranh. lang xang, dong nghia voi tieng hanh ranh. chanh doi. do tho ren, ren dinh, cung la cai bua. cay chanh ranh. thu cay nho ve loai duong tong, nhanh la deu thom, nguoi ta hay dung ma nau ruou choi, cung keu la choi ranh ranh. (dia phu tu). chanh cay. dung rieu bua ma mo cay cho tach ra, khong dung cua.
bo choi hoi, nhe nhe. (coi chu choanh.) chanh hoanh. tinh tao; cham ham; gon gang.

xao rua, dao nuoc. uom chao. bo ken vao nuoc soi chao qua chao lai ma lay moi to uom, cung la tieng doi, chi nghia la uom. chao oi. tieng than vi dau don. chao rua. bo xuong nuoc ma xao, rua. chim bo chao. loai chim dong giong con choc mao, lay tieng no keu ma dat ten.
do an co mui chua, thuong lam bang tom ca, ep cho rao nuoc cung gia vi. nem chao. tieng goi chung hai thu do an lam bang tom, thit cung gia vi. chao rao. bo ron rang nhieu tieng noi.

do nau bang gao nep, hoac nau bang dau gi ma do nhieu nuoc. chao dac. chao nau len, it nuoc. chao long. chao nau nhieu nuoc. chao ngo. chao nguoi ngo hay an, chao nau nhu. chao boi. chao nau dac ma nhuyen. com mai chao chieu. that thuong, dang buoi mai mat buoi hom; vua du ma doi bua; vua khoi doi. leu lao nhu chao gao luong. chao gao luong het deo dai, hoa ra leu lao. nghia muon la ban lang, leu lao. chao long. chao nau voi long heo. chao ca. chao nau voi ca. hup chao. lay hoi ma lua chao vao mieng. cung chao. kinh dang bua chao (noi ve su cung thanh). dua vang chao. dua moi co com dom ra mong mong nhu vang dong tren mat chao. ho chao. nuoc ho, nuoc chao de ma boi gan. lua ho chao thi la lua mong lua xau, nho ho chao coi nhu lua day. tien trao chao muc. doi chac hien tien. chao rao. kinh so, khong yen.

hoi, mang nhau, lam dau hoi mang. chao hoi. hoi nhau. chao anh. mang anh. binh chao thuoc. benh kho tri, uong thuoc lan dau thi chiu, qua lan sau thi khong. le nang dau chao cha me chong. le chao khi moi di hoi, khi ay cha me chong phai dem vat ma cho. chao dan mac. chao truoc cho ngo thay, keo con tron lanh. chao rao. tieng nhieu nguoi noi mot luot.

do duc bang dong bang gan, trom long, de ma chien nau. chao dun. chao lon. chao dong. chao bang dong. chao gang. chao bang gang. non chao. non duong co mo, non don ba hay doi. long chao. vat chi lom chinh giua nhu cai long chao. mieng chao. vat chi be len, hoac co vanh cao nhu mieng chao. chao quai vac. thu chao lon co quai.

cung vat san ban trong thang 12. thang chap. thang 12. gio chap. lam le cung quai (tieng chung). chap mieu. lam le cung mieu trong thang 12. chap ma. lam le cung trong khi tao mo. cham chap. cham lut.

noi. chap noi. noi lai. cuoi vo lay chong khac, lap doi khac. chong chap vo noi. hai ben deu lai dong. chap day. noi day lam cho dai. chap gai. dau noi gai soi ma lam day nho. ngoi buon sao chang - gai, den khi co ca muon chai ai cho. khong biet lo hau. chap canh hong. thap canh ma bay, truong buom di cho thau.
mot hoi lau. bat chap. san thi bat luon, bat xap, bat lam xap. thay mat thi bat chap, bieu phai lam gium. hat chap. hat rieng mot hai loi. mot chap. mot hoi; mot lien nam cai. tu chap. tu hoi.

cam, giu; chiu lay; cho nhap lai, xap lai; khong ke, khong tinh; tieng tro tu. chap phap. giu phep, cu phep. chap linh. giu hieu linh, nhu danh trong chieu thi binh phai tuu. chap su. chuc coi viec, dau moi viec. phu chap. ban tac voi cha minh. chap nhat. cau cuoc; loi phai, hay bat ti, bat o. co chap. hay chac du mua hon, khong hay thong bien; ben long. chap ne. id. cho chap. cho hon, cho trach. mien chap. xin tha loi, cho bat loi. bat chap. khong hon, khong trach. cau chap. khuc mat, hay bat loi, hay hon; bat buoc. giam chap. giam cam. bat chap bat trach. khong ke dieu quay phai, khong hay cau chap. chap tay. up hai ban tay, hai tay nam lai. chap le. giu theo le phep. chap le. chiu lay le vat, cua cho. chap don. chiu lay don. chap kinh. cu theo viec truoc. chap chua. giu lay, chua lay. chap chua mot minh: gianh lay mot minh. chap vat. chiu cho nhieu nguoi dua vat voi mot minh minh. chap ba dua danh mot. danh chap cay. danh tay khong, ma cho ke khac dung cay. doc chap sach. doc thuoc long, khong ngo toi sach. den chap choa. den loa ra, khi to khi mo.

chong len, chup len. chap chong. chong dong. chong chap. id. chap mat. chup mat hai nguoi coi co giong khong; do thu. chap chum. moi tap loi, hai tay con chup nuoc. (tieng chum ay la tieng chup nuoc ma keu). chap xuong. danh up xuong, chup xuong. chap chung. di dung khong vung (con nit); bay chua noi, moi hoc bay (chim con).

gat, rit, hay quanh mieng. chua chat. chat (tieng doi). chat ngat. chat lam. chat chua. cung la chat (tieng doi). chat tai. ray tai, oi tai, kho nghe. chuoi chat. thu chuoi nhieu hot, cung keu la chuoi hot; hoac chuoi gi moi dong voc. loi chot chat. loi noi cung xang, khong so mich long.
tieng danh bua. lat chat. tieng don cay. chi chat. id.

con dua chau minh, chau ba doi; tieng danh luoi; can say, gan, luoc, lam cho rao nuoc. chau chat. chau doi thu ba. chat luoi. lam ra tieng danh luoi, can rang, chi su thuong tiec, lay lam la. chat lot. tien tan, danh de. chat mot. can say tu phan ma danh de, can tay. chat nuoc. gan, luoc, long rot cho rao nuoc. chat rao. rot di het, rot sach, vet sach. chat sach. id. chat nuoc com. te nuoc com. chat ruot. mo ruot, lay ruot. nguoi chat chat. thu nguoi nho thap qua. hon chat. hon nho nho nhu vien dan, con nit hay danh choi voi nhau. danh chat. choi thu hon nho ay.

dung riu, rua ma sa ra; gat gong, bon bang; ben giu; kho tao. chat don. don, cot, ha xuong (cay coi). chat quach. chat phut, don phut; chem di cho ranh. chat cay. don cay, dut cay. chat dau. chem dau, chat dut dau. chat dau lot da. khac bac, bat nhon, muon cuop cua nguoi ta. (thuong noi ve ke cho vay). chat chiu. gat gong hay giu cua; cung khu, chac cung. chat cung. chac lam; cung khu, dac cung. chat da. hep hoi, ben long. chat ngang. cat san ngang; khong biet cho on nghia; khong chiu roi rong voi ai; khan khan mot be. gat chat. gat gong, khong chut chi roi rong. bop chat. giu gat, bop lai khong noi ra. cam chat. giu chac, nam cung. giu chat. giu khit ghim. ben chat. vung ben, chac chan. di song chat. di song bon, phan tao.

tinh khi, cot cach; that tha; doi chung; chung ra. sap de len tren, chong len. tu chat. tinh khi, cot cach troi cho, sang lang the nao. tu chat thong minh. 資 質 聰 明 bon chat. cot cach tu nhien, tinh khi tu nhien. tanh chat. id. khi chat. hinh khi, tanh khi. vat chat. cot cach, hinh khi moi mot vat. van chat. net trau gioi; net tu nhien; co van co chat, chi nghia la co ve tot, ma lai that chac. chan chat. that tha, khong biet deu xao tra. chat phac. id. chat that. id. chat van. tra hoi chac chan, hoi du chung ta. doi chat. doi nai cung nhau. at chat. ro rang chac chan. chat dong. sap dong, de dong, chong dong. chat ngat. cao lam, noi len cao lam. chat len. sap len, de len. chat de. sap don lai mot cho.

hep hoi, khong ho khoan; lung tung. chat hep. id. khong co be dai be rong. chat choi. id. chat bo. chat lam, chet lam; cung la tai dong, nhieu ma chat. chat cung. id. chat nha. day nha; nha khong co cho ho. nguoi vat day mot nha. ban chat. lung tung, ngheo nan. tri ban chat. tri hep hoi, khong rong luong. nha ban chat. nha ngheo. chat vat. do den, gan toi. hoi chat vat.
mot minh it dung. lau chau. khong nen net, bo lien xao, vo phep. noi lau chau. an noi lien xao, vo phep.

con con minh; con anh em, chi em minh. con chau. tieng keu chung ca con ca chau cung nhung nguoi hau sinh trong dong ho minh. chau trai. chau la con trai. chau gai. chau la con gai. chau noi. con con trai minh. chau ngoai. con con gai minh. chau ruot. chau gan lam. con chau de ong vai. con chau cai qua ong ba. con la mau, chau la mu. thuong con roi moi toi chau, lo cho con truoc chau.
xac. o chau. an o xac xuoc, kieu cang. noi chau. noi xac, noi lon loi.

mot coi, mot dia phan, hoac lon, hoac nho khong han; dat cu lao. chau quan. dia hat lon. tri chau. chuc quan hay mot chau nho hon mot phu. dong chau. dong thuoc mot dia phan, mot xu. cuu chau. chin quan ben trung quac, (ke theo xua). ngu dai chau. nam phuong thien ha, (coi chu phuong). giao chau. nuoc giao-chi. au chau. phuong tay, chinh tieng goi au la ba. dong thang than chau. dat dia loi (trong su xay huyet ma).
bai, con, cu lao. ngao chau. con ngao o tai cua co-chien. tan chau. cu lao cai-vang thuoc tinh an-giang. trieu chau. phu keu ten ay (trung quac). quinh chau. chau hai-nam.

dong chau, nuoc mat; nhan may; hot trai. chau may. nhan may, buon mat. chau roi. sa nuoc mat; chay nuoc mat. chau luy. id. dong chau. nuoc mat. hot chau. nuoc mat do hot. chau chan may mat. lam mat buon gian. la cha chau roi. nuoc mat rong rong. mat u may chau. mat may buon tham.

son; hot qui. hot chau. hot trai, hot ngoc. ngan chau. loai kim, son. chan chau. id. chau sa. loai kim mau do. tran chau. hot trai nho, hot trong suot o trong minh con diep, con trai (vi thuoc). gao chau cui que. vat an thiet qua. chau bau. qui bau. chau phe. vua ngu but son, danh chu son. ten rach o ve hat tan- an.

khap. chau luu. di khap. chau vi. be vong chung quanh; dang chau vi. chau nien. giap nam; quanh nam. chau tue. day tuoi. chau than. ca minh; khap vong ba con. chau nhi phuc thi. giap vong, roi tro lai. thi chau. phep thu con nit day tuoi; cung la phep moc mieng: thu con trai thi de viet, muc, cung, dao; thu con gai thi de kim chi, bong hoa; he no bat nham mon gi thi doan viec ngay sau cho no.
ten ho. chau tran. ho chau, ho tran. hai ho the nguyen lam sui cung nhau, thuo con con o trong bung, khong bo nhau. nghia chau tran. nghia sui gia ben vung.

do dung bang dat rong mieng; co nhieu viec dung. bon chau. chau lon. chau hoa. chau trong bong hoa. chau bong. id. hoac la chau co ve bong hoa. chau kieng. chau trong kieng, nghia la cay thanh kieng ma choi. chau tam. ang lon de ma tam. chau up khon soi. chuyen an vi, khong le biet cho het. trot mieng chau. trang mieng, hoac trot ra nhu mieng chau.

loai cao cao, nhon dau; chon no cung co gai co khua; cay chong vong; gium dau lai. con chau chau. loai cao cao, ma nhon dau. chau chau thay sang den thi nhay. con chau chau thay den sang thi nhay, chang de den chay het canh. noi vi nguoi tham sang giau khong biet nghi hau. chang chau. khinh bac, nguoi khong de dat. dinh chon chau. dinh nhon hai dau. chau dau. gium dau. chau vao. ap vao. chon chau. cay gac treo ma chong; vat cat co khia co rang, giong cai chon con - -. chau vong. cay chong vong. chau luoi liem. khia luoi liem; dua nhau ma cat. liem chon chau. liem co cat khia. cat chau. cat cho co khia. chau giao. xum lai ma dam ma lam hai. chau sung. gia sung, hoac dung sung giao ngon lai voi nhau.

ung hau vua chua; mot buoi, mot khi; danh trong thuong; gium lai. chau le. xem le, hau le. (dao thien chua). chau vua. hau vua. chau chuc. ung chuc, ung hau. chau quan. lanh lam quan. san chau. san cac quan chau vua. ao chau. ao trieu, do trieu phuc. mu chau. mao trieu. giao dong hang chau. giao hau dong co hang. chau troi. ve troi, chet. chau gium. gium lai, qui ve mot moi. lui chau. thoi chau. chau ray. bua ray, ngay ray. man chau. man ky, het ky. danh trong chau. danh trong thuong. danh chau. id. cam chau. id. chau thuong. id. chau cho. thuong cho. trong chau. thu trong lon hay dung ma danh thuong hat boi. chau doi chau ba. noi lap di lap lai; chinh nghia la danh thuong giap. keu chau doi chau ba. keu giap nhu keu cha cha, me me, v. v. co ban chau, hoac vung chau. thu co moc goc re mot vang. chau trau. mot thien trau lien. chau cau. mot dong cau buong chat gium lai, nguyen so la mot tram trai du dau; 12 chau vao mot thien. chau nhung. nguoi moi theo dao, dao moi.

bao phu, lam cho khuat. che phu. id. che lap. id. lam cho khuat lap; bo qua; binh bo. che cho. binh vuc, ung ho. che day. day lai; giu gin cho; em cho. che mieng the gian. lam cho khoi tieng noi. troi che dat cho. cong on dung tao hoa. truong phu man che. su the cao sang. che du. dung du ma che nang che mua. che non. dung non ma che mat, hoac doi tren dau. che long. dung long ma che nang, lam cho trong su the nha quan. che dau. lay vat chi ma che dau. che mat. lay vat chi ma day mat. che choi. lam choi, cat choi. che thum. cat thum. tot thi khoe, xau thi che. ai ai cung muon lay phan ma gioi mat. che dap mia. truc can mia, do cuoc dap mia. lo che. lo nau duong cung do cuoc dap mia (co trai che).
do bang sanh, dung trai nguoi ta hay dung ma dung ruou trong luc lam le cuoi hoi. che ruou. id. che dung nuoc. thu che lon, thuong dung ma dung nuoc.

thu cay nho, la co chia, nguoi ta hay phoi say de nau nuoc ma uong; chao nep bo duong; (tieng tro tu). che tau. tra trung-quac, thu nho la hon, chinh la tra uop bong thom. che hue. tra dat hue, lon la cung hieu chung ve tra nam-ky. che thu. tra trong tai thu-dau-mot, cung hieu la cac thu che o tai nam-ky. che ngu. tra de rieng cho vua uong, che cong pham. ngu che. uong che (tieng dung cho vua chua). phong che. trai lanh viec pha tra, hau tra. hau che. hau pha che nuoc tra. ve che. ve pha tra. chen che. chen uong tra; chen nho. do che. noi bo ve chen, chinh la do dung ma pha tra. binh che. binh dung che. pha che. nau nuoc cho soi bo tra vao cho no ra nuoc, hoac dem ra ma rot. bo mot noi che. bo che vao ve cho vua mot lan uong. quat che. quat lo nau nuoc tra. nuoc che. nuoc tra tham ra; nuoc mia moi dap ma chua nau. che dam. che ra nhieu nuoc, hoac tai bo nhieu qua. che lot. tra ra it nuoc, hoac tai bo it. xoi che. uong nuoc che (tieng dung cho quan truong). nau che. nau chao nep, dau, co bo duong. che xoi. chao ngot voi com nep nau cach thuy; do an choi, do cung. che dau. chao nau lon voi dau, ma co bo duong. say ba che. do say, do tinh. nuoc che hai. nuoc khong man ngot, co pha nuoc bien it nhieu. banh che lam. thu banh in lam xam lon nhieu mon khac. che re. bo khong te chinh. che he. bo ho hang. ngoi che he: ngoi vo y, hach hai ve. che ne. cha boi, nhanh cay. banh che. xuong lac leo o tai dau goi.

sa doc, lach ra, phan ra. che cay. sa cay ra, cat theo be doc no. che tre. cat sa tre cay; roc ra tu mieng. che tre nghe long: nghe lom, nghe khong thiet. che lat. che ra tu lat, tu soi de lam day, (thuong dung tre). che may. sa doc soi may. may che. may da sa doc ra roi. tre che an. con moi biet an; duong chung ham an. tre che noi. con moi hoc noi; duong chung ham noi (chua biet gi). biet che. biet het, biet ro rang. tinh ra cho che nhu hinh con buon. xet ra cho ki thi chang khac gi con buon.
mot cuong, mot ba. che to. cuong chi to. che vai. cuong chi vai. chieu che. chieu nho. mot che. mot cuong, mot vong.

bo di, khong dung. che bai. khinh de, khong them. che bo. id. che ghet. khong ua, khong chiu. che cuoi. nhao cuoi, khinh de. cuoi che. id. giem che. id. noi deu khinh bac. tot khen, hen che. phai viec che khen.
xe xuong, liet di. che canh. xui canh, se canh. ngoi chiem che. ngoi tinh queo, ngoi chim bim. ngoi chuyen che. ngoi ca ra. chuyen che. chuyen van, cham chap.

sua, dinh; tieng vo khach keu nhau cung nhu di, co. che do. viec dinh ra, phep luat. che le. chuoc dinh le phep. che tho. chieu chi, giay vua lam ra. tang che. phep de tang; do tang phuc. de che. ban do tang phuc. thu che. id. tho che. chiu lay do tang. chiu phep ai. ngu che. vua lam ra, viet ra. sach ngu che. sach vua lam ra. thong che. chuc quan vo hay mot dinh binh. tiet che. tuoc quan vo, dong viec binh. dong che. id.

cham chuoc, sua don, lam theo phep. che thuoc. phep lam cho chin thuoc (bac). bao che. sao tam lam cho chin thuoc. che cham. lam cho vua. bot cho, dung cho. che cho. dung cho, bot cho. che phien xau. dung tha cho khoi phien xau.  bien. tuy theo viec ma sua dinh.  dau. them dau. che nuoc. rot nuoc them. cham che. cham chuoc, lam cho vua, lieu cach the cho duoc viec; bot cho, dung tha. dung che. dung cho, lam cho khoi, mien cho. cay che; bat che. sua banh bat, banh cay vua vua vay.
ngoi che be. ngoi nghenh ngang, choan cho. (thuong noi ve nguoi map).
nguoi khach, chu khach. nguoi trieu-chau goi chu la chec. a chec. chu khach. chu chec. id.

le loi ; nghieng trieng khong chinh; chech mich. chech mac. le loi, khong bau ban, khong nguoi hom som. chech ban. le ban. chech canh. mat di mot canh, mat the nuong nho. chech goi. le goi, le ban. chech phan. doan phan le loi, khong may man. chech doi le ban. le doi, cach ban. chech lua. id. chech long. mech long; buon y, phien long. chech y. id. chech mich. mat long. chech lech. nghieng trieng. chech mot ben. nghieng ve mot ben. don phu chech the. gai goa chong, trai chet vo.

dung guom dao ma chat dut. chem chet. chem di, giet di; tieng noi lay: chem chet no cung khong chua co bac. chem dau. chat lay dau. tieng ngam de: tao chem dau. chem quach. chat phut. dam chem. va dam va chem. anh em chem nhau dang song, khong le chem nhau dang luoi. anh em khong no giet nhau. thap duoc tim giau, giau chang thay, cam guom chem kho, kho theo sau. giau kho tim, ngheo kho lanh. noi nhu rua chem xuong dat. noi chac chan, noi mot loi.

tieng tro tu. ca chem. loai ca vuoc, giep minh cung nho vay hon. guom dao sac chem chem. guom dao sac lam. ba con ruot chem chem. thiet la ruot thit. chem bem hoac chem bem. bo thua thot ma choc len (noi ve rau). co ba cai rau chem bem nhu rau ca tre.

nem them, tra them, lam cho chat; gia them; cai nem, cai chot. chem cho ho. nem them, tra them, lam cho het ho. chem cay. dung cay ma nem them, tra nem; (dung cach ay cho de bua cui). chem them. gia them, nem them. chem cho day. gia them, che them cho day (noi ve do nuoc). do chem. do de ma tra them, nem them.

xen vao, nhet vao. chen chuc. id. (tieng doi). chen vao. id. tron chen. id. chen minh. tron minh. chen nhet. nhet vao cho ket, cho ho; dut nhet, giau dut cho ai. bon chen. an bon, an luong. chen chun khong lot. dong lam. chat lam, khong cho di.
gie lua, bong co. chen lua. gie lua. gia ken chen hom. ken chon lam, thuong khong duoc viec; (loi noi xua rat kho giai).

do sanh tron trai, sau long, thuong de ma uong nuoc, an com. chen kieu. chen ky kieu, min thit. chen da. chen sanh, to thit. chen cam bien. thu chen keu la cam-bien. chen tra chen ruou. cuoc an uong no say vat ma. noi theo chen tra chen ruou thi la noi theo viec an uong. chen thuoc. thuoc nuoc dung trong chen. chen uong che. thu chen nho thuong dung ma uong nuoc che. chen uong ruou. chen nho hay dung ma uong ruou. bat chen. bat lon, chen nho; keu chung ca hai thu. qua chen. uong qua, say qua. chen thu chen tac. uong ruou do. danh mot chen me. thuong dung chen ma hot me. danh mot lan keu la mot chen. chen an. chen dang (noi ve cuoc danh me). chen thua. chen that. id. mua chen. de chen tren dau, hoac tren tay ma mua. ve chen. ve la do dung che dung ruou (tieng goi chung). do ve chen, keu chung. set chen. vua day chen, vua toi vanh chen. chen mat trau. chen nho, bang con mat trau.

kem, cap them, noi va them. chen nhet. kem cho nay nhet cho kia. cat giau, danh de; lay bot. chen dut. id. co chen dut moi co ma an. chen vao. nong vao, cap them. chen them. bo them, nhet them. chen vach. them la them cay cho kin tam vach.
khong du. chen ngoen. bo tro troi. ngoi chen ngoen: ngoi co mot minh. vua chen. vua du, vua khit. ao chen. ao ban vua khit minh. chen riu. cay giat luoi riu, ma tra vao dau riu.

nghieng. chenh lech. id. chenh chong. bo nghinh ngang cho chong. nam chenh chong thi la nam gac chun len cung choan cho. chenh venh. id. chenh chenh bong ac. xien xien bong xe. chenh chenh bong nguyet xe manh. lenh chenh. hay con cho cao cho thap, khong bang thang; chua xuoi, chua yen. viec hay con lenh chenh. dat chenh. dat nghieng trieng.
n. chenh chang. bo di venh cuong, bo di nghenh ngang.

chieu than, nap tien cau than (noi ve le cuoi). le cu, he co dam cuoi di ngang qua lang nao, thi lang ay dem it thuoc lua do, giang ngang qua dang ma don, goi la nhai lan, khi ay dang trai phai dem tien, nhu khac lang thi ba quan, dong lang thi it hon, ma xin lang nhin biet lay minh cho di thong tha, ay la nghia chieu than. tien cheo heo khoan. tien chieu than, heo phat ta. cuoi cheo. tieng doi chi nghia la cuoi. vo khong cheo nhu keo neo khong mau. co tien cheo moi thanh le cuoi. cheo leo. nguy hiem, bo cao qua; heu qua. cheo meo. bo hiem ngheo, o cho meo, cho tot, khong co the vo vin.
loai thu nho, chun nho, chay hay ma nhat. con cheo. id. nhat nhu cheo. nhat lam. noi nhu phat, nhat nhu cheo. noi lon loi ma khong co gan. ghe chun cheo. ghe dong vot chun.

goc, cho dam ra, cho gio ra. cheo ao. cho goc vat ao, gau ao. cheo khan. cho goc cai khan. ao noi cheo. ao may them cho goc. ruong bien, ruong cheo. ruong o ngoai bia, ngoai goc, o theo me rach, me song. noi cheo veo. duc lac, noi giong kho nghe.

dung cay dai danh nuoc cho ghe di toi. lam vong treo lai xo cay vao ma quay. gay lay nhau, mac lay nhau. cheo ghe. danh nuoc cho ghe di. cheo do. cheo ghe do; cheo qua cheo lai. cay cheo. cay dai, mot dau tron mot dau giep ma lon, co the ma day nuoc. cong cheo. chinh minh cay cheo. coc cheo. cay dong dung de ma gay cheo. mai cheo. be giep cay cheo co the ma day nuoc. guoc cheo. tay cam cay cheo. quai cheo. day gay cheo. gay cheo. treo quai, van quai cheo vao coc cheo. cheo banh. cheo sau lai, cung goi la cheo lai. cheo doc. cheo phia sau, ke lay cheo banh. cheo phach. cheo phia truoc, ke lay cheo mui, co phach nhi, ba, tu, v. v. cheo hang. cheo thuong, cu muc ma cheo. cheo mui. cheo truoc mui. cheo ngon. id. cheo ban. cheo phan hai, nghieng nghieng mai cheo. cheo mai mot. bo xuong do len, cat mai cheo cho gon. cheo dua linh. cheo khoan khoan. liet mai cheo. danh mai cheo xien xien, cheo nay xien xien. cheo lau. danh mai cheo qua lai ma nung ghe toi. cheo ra. ra mai cheo duoi nuoc ma cheo nghieng nghieng. gac cheo. xep cheo, thoi cheo. xuoi cheo. tha xuoi mai cheo; thoi cheo. lot cheo. lay quay cheo, thoi cheo. chong cheo thi vo cung cheo hai dang da ngheo lai dung lay nhau . kho dap. tay cheo. ban cheo. chuot cheo. bao chuot cay cheo. cheo keo. gay lay nhau, mac lay nhau. viec cheo keo. viec duong gay tro, khong xuoi mot be. cheo queo. bo co xep lai mot cho. nam cheo queo. nam khoanh, nam xep dong dao; bo buon ba. dung gian chun cheo. dung dan chon nhu khi dung ma cheo, thi la ra bo manh me. noi cheo dai. noi dai. cheo beo. keo nai. noi cheo beo. noi keo nai, ke nhe. cheo kep. cach van day nai riet lai cho dau, de ma thau tien hoac de ma tra hoi toi gi. thuong dung mot cai nai, nghia la day khoanh tron, trong vao chun nguoi ta, ngoai lay mot cai cay van van, xo treo ma quay cho riet lai.

cheo keo, trac tro. cheo neo. gay tro, vuong van lay nhau. viec con cheo neo. viec con gay lay nhau, chua xuoi. reo cheo cheo. keu om som, cu ten ai ma keu mai. khoc cheo cheo. keu khoc mai, khong dut tieng khoc. doi an cheo cheo. doi an mai, khong dut tieng. cheo chet. ray rac, ngay nga. noi cheo chet thi la noi nhieu tieng. bong cheo. cuoc choi, bong hai dong tien ma up lai, he co mot dong sap mot dong ngua, thi goi la cheo, nghia la cheo voi nhau, con hai sap hai ngua thi la thuan.
tieng tro tu. trong cheo. trong lam. nuoc trong cheo. nuoc trong lam.

bien, sao. sao chep. id. bien chep. id. ghi chep. ghi vao, bien lay. chep sach. bien lam sach vo; sao ta sach gi. chep bai. bien lay bai vo. chep de. bien de danh. chep tho. sao chep tho tuong. chep tuong. sao tuong tap. con chep chep. loai so nho va mong vo, nguoi ta hay dung ma ham voi.
tieng tro tu. chep bep. bo nhep xuong. mat chep bep. mat tret let, mat giep dep. ngoi chep bep. ngoi sat ca dui ve.
tieng tro tu. chep bep. bo lon ma tret. mat chep bep. mat lon ma tret, mat bep.

xia vao, xen vao; cai xuong nho. chet vao. id. lua chet. cay lua nho hay moc theo lua lon; lua moc sot, moc theo chon lua gat roi ma cung yeu ot. cai chet. cai xuong nho, luoi xuong nho. cuoc chet. keu chung hai thu do dao dat, lon la cuoc, nho lam la chet. ca chet. thu ca bien nho vay, lon con ma ngot thit.
con bo chet. loai trung rat nho hay o nen nha, nhay hay ma can dau. chung bo chet. chung hay noi hay ngay.

gia doi, bo minh. chet gia. chet khi da gia. chet non. chet khi con nho. chet tre. id. chet yeu. chet khi con be, hoac con tuoi tre, chet som qua. chet tuoi. chet bay gio, khong dau om ma chet. chet tuc. chet gap, chet khong kip troi;
