(noi ve khi co nhieu le chong nhau). chiet bien. bien bat. chiet ra. phan ra, re ra. chiet cay. lay phan dat bo nhanh cay cho no dam re, roi thi cat ma trong rieng. chiet khan. mo ra ma coi (noi ve tho tu). khai chiet. id. chiet ruou. sang ruou qua ve nho. thue dong chiet sac. thue dong nua tien nua vat, nhu la nua tien nua lua. chiet ban. chia hai, be hai, lay nua phan. rau chiet. thu cay thap nho ma lon la, hay moc hai ben me song, nham con nuoc rong no sinh la non, mui chat chat; nguoi ta hay an nhu cac mon rau. cai chiet. do dung duong bang tre, may co nap day, cung goi la cai ro, cai nung.

bu them, chan tru. tien chiet. tien bu them, gia nhu mot chuc quan them mot tien, de ma bu tien thieu. no tra chiet. no nhieu tra khong noi, xin cu moi mot tram quan tra hien tien nam bay chuc , v. v. ma tru het. bu chiet. bu them ma tru lai, den lai.

ra dau, ra hieu lenh ma keu moi; khai ra, xung ra; ben tay trai. chieu mo. keu ru nguoi lam quan linh. chieu qui. keu tro ve, ru nhau ve cho cu. chieu an. ra hieu lenh cho dan yen, nhu keo co cho dan tro ve. chieu coi. tuc coi ma doi quan linh. chieu co. keo co lam hieu linh. chieu binh mai ma. qui binh mua ngua. sam sua ma danh giac, lo viec danh giac. chieu muong. ra hieu gi cho cho san tro lai. dam chieu. tay huu, tay ta. tay chieu. tay ta. cua chieu. cua trom cap, cua gian lan. mua cua chieu that ky tien. tieng trong le noi he mua cua gian, ma quan bat dang, thi lay ngay khong tra tien lai. chieu hien dai si. moi ke hien, dai ke hoc hanh; biet yeu chuong nguoi hien ngo. di chon dam chon chieu. di khong chinh dinh. chieu khai. chiu toi, khai ngay truoc mat quan. chieu xung. id. lay khau chieu. lay loi khai. tu chieu ky hoa. minh ruoc lay hoa hai cho minh. chieu lieu. thu cay tap day vo, vi thuoc tri chung thuong han.
sang. chieu quan. nang chieu-quan, bi cong ho. chieu hoang. cong chua nha ly, lam ban voi tran-canh, ma doi to cho nha tran; (viet-nam su-ky).
loi vua phan day. chieu tho. giay vua truyen day. chieu chi. y vua truyen day. chieu du. id. xuong chieu. ban loi chieu. noi chieu. noi chua choi (it dung).

* do det bang lac, bang co, hoac vat gi khac de lot ma nam. chieu liep. chieu det ki, liep duong so sai, bang tre, hoac bang may. cung la tieng doi. chieu lac. chieu det bang cong co lac. chieu may. chieu det bang may che nho. chieu nga. chieu det bang nga tuoc ra tu soi. chieu du. chieu det ki, tron nhu mo. chieu bach dinh. thu chieu trang xanh, chieu nhut. chieu ke. chieu co vien co ket vai sac. chiec chieu. mot kho chieu (chiec la tieng keu ke). hang chieu liep. hang quan truong. trai chieu. lot chieu. dap chieu. dung chieu ma dap minh cung nhu cai men. cuon chieu. lan chieu lai. con cuon chieu. loai trung nhieu chun, co dong toi thi cuon tron. chieu bong. chieu det co bong hoa. chieu hoa. id. det chieu. dung cong co, hoac vat khac ket lai ma lam ra chiec chieu. chieu day tran. chieu day nho. chieu noi. chieu nho kho, de cho con nit nam. chieu manh. chieu mong xau. chieu dat man troi. dat lam chieu, troi lam man, chi nho troi dat cho che; khong cho nuong dua, khong cho goi nho.

soi, cu theo. mat troi chieu. mat troi soi den. chieu sang. soi to. chieu khap. soi khap cho. chieu hao quang. bua hao quang. nhut nguyet tuy minh nan chieu phuc bon chi ha. mat troi, mat trang dau sang cung khon soi duoi chau up. ngoi dong chieu kinh. phep rieng thay phap cung bong chang, thuong de con nit vao trong gio, lay vai bao phu cho kin, ngoai dat vat ma hoi thu, nhu no noi duoc thi chi nghia la co qui than chieu ung cho no. chieu ung. choi nhau, choi voi nhau, co nghia doi voi nhau; viec nay chieu ung cung viec truoc. ngoc chieu. ngoc anh sang, nhang sang. chieu theo. cu theo, y theo. chieu giam. to soi, xet soi. than minh chieu giam. tham chieu. xet nghi ky cang. tieng xin quan truong xet viec cho minh. thanh chieu. chu nep nguoi ta hay viet ngoai bi tho, xin nguoi duoc tho xem coi. binh chieu. id. di chieu. chu viec quan, chi nghia la da xem roi, hay roi. minh chieu. to soi. cap chieu. giay cap cho ai di dau, lam viec gi. anh chieu. bong sang giai ra. linh te chieu thuy. sung tay linh, soi thau duoi nuoc. den chieu ngu sac. den gioi ra nhieu sac. chieu tuong. tieng noi rieng trong su danh co, chi ngay vi tuong ben giac.

buoi xe qua, tu hai, ba gio cho den toi. buoi chieu. id. chieu ca. chieu som,, buoi xe, ke tu 2, 3 gio. chieu hom. chung gio thu 5 toi. chieu mai. buoi chieu ngay mai. chieu mot. buoi chieu cach ngay mai. chieu toi. buoi gan toi. xe chieu. xe qua roi; cham tre. chieu nay. chieu hom nay. chieu ray. chau ray, ngay ray. chieu luoi. buoi ghe danh ca ve. ca lo -. com mai chao chieu. bua doi bua no, su the kho khan.

loai bay, loai cam. chim choc. (tieng doi) id. muong chim. loai thu, loai cam. chim troi ca nuoc. su the minh mong, chang lay dau lam chac. chim dau chang bat, bat chim bay. vung toan, khong hay tinh truoc. chim so long khon trong tro lai. cho trong dua tron tro ve. bat chim chim. chung benh dau me, hai ban tay hay co vo mo ra, duong nhu khi muon bat con chim. cay chim chim. ten cay co la 5 chia, vo no keu la ngu da bi; vi thuoc dau minh. (coi chu bi). khi cay thi chang thay chim, den khi lua chin chim tim den an. an thi co lam thi khong. ca chim. thu ca bien giep minh ma van, hay lieng tren mat nuoc.
mot minh it dung. chum chim. min cuoi. chim mieng. mim mieng cuoi.

sa dam, tram minh xuong nuoc. chet chim. chet duoi nuoc. chim dam. chim mat, sa dam. chim xuong. tram xuong. chim thuyen. bi chim ghe; lo mat von. chim mat. chim di mat, mat tam dang; bat tin. chim ngam. id. uong ruou nhu hu chim. manh ruou qua, uong ruou li bi. da noi vong chim. chuyen phi thuong, chuyen khong co. cua chim. cua khong doi duoc: nhu vuon dat; doi voi cua noi la nhung do gia dung. kham chim can chim. can lan.
. chim bim. bo tinh tuong. ngoi chim bim. ngoi khong nhich mep.

so ba ba; ky cang; nau nuong toi chung roi; trai cay toi ky hai, ky rung; khong con song sit. hai chin chong nhau. bang nhau, khong ai thua ai. chin dao. giu dao chin chan. chin chan. ky cang, sieng nang. chin lop. ky cang, thu lop. chin muoi. chin mem (trai cay). chin ung. chin qua. (trai cay). chin toi. moi vua chin. chin bay. chin ra ra, nat ra (thuong noi ve do nau). com chin. com nau roi. nho hot com —. chi nghia la nho cho co com an. ca chin. ca kho roi, nau nuong roi. trai chin cay. trai chin tu tren cay. dao chin. ten dao giat. lam cho chin. lam cho ky. nau cho chin. nau cho toi chung.
tieng tro tu, chi nghia la von thiet; ma thoi. chin thiet. von thiet. chin e. con so, mot so. chin ghe. id. nen ghe gom.

di; thau; danh; nghieng. than chinh. minh di lay. chinh thue. danh thue. chinh thau. danh thue cung thau thue. chinh phat. danh phat nuoc co toi. chinh lech. nghieng trieng. van — thi la van lot khong bang thang, co hoi nghieng ve phia nao. chinh chong. bo nghieng dau nay, vong dau kia khong yen mot muc; bo khong te chinh. nam chinh chong thi la nam gac tay, gac chon khong xuoi xa.

(chanh) ngay, that, chac chan. trung chinh. ngay that. cong chinh. giu phep cong, khong chut chi ta vay. nghia chinh. nghia phai, le phai, viec lam phai. dao chinh. dao chan thiet, ai nay phai theo. le chinh. le ngay, le phai. bien phan ta chinh. (hieu sach). luan phan le ta, le chanh. chan chinh. chon that. minh chinh. ro rang, ngay that. doan chinh. ngay thang, nghiem trang. chinh truc. ngay thang. chinh dinh. nham chung, ngay ngan, khong xien veo. chinh giua. ngay giua. chinh y. bon y, nguyen y; nham y. chinh ly. nham ly, nham le phai, thiet la le phai. chinh phep. nham phep, thiet la phep. chinh vi. chinh vi; vi o dau, chinh cho ngu; chinh cho ngoi; (noi ve quan, vua). chinh dien. den lon, den o chinh giua. chinh dinh. dinh lon. chinh cung. cung giua; tuoc hoang hau thu nhut. chinh cho. nham cho, ngay cho. chinh ngo. giua ngay, dung bong, dang mat troi di qua thi tron bong. chinh thong. chinh vi vua. hieu vua trung-quac. chinh giao. dao chanh. chinh viec. nham viec, phai viec; viec dau het, thiet viec. chinh lang. nguyen la lang minh; thiet lang minh. chinh quan. nguyen la xu so, chinh la nhau run. chinh sac. chanh mau sac; doan chanh; chinh vat tho san: (tieng noi ve thue). dong thue tien, hoac dong chinh sac. thue chinh cung. chanh mat thue, nhu thue dinh dien khong phai la tap nap. chinh hieu. thiet hieu, bon hieu. chinh danh. thiet danh, bon danh. chinh danh phan. phai danh phan, phai viec minh. cua chinh. cua lon, cua de ma ra vao. nha chinh. nha lon, nha giua. vo chinh. vo lon, co cuoi hoi theo phep. noi chinh tieng. noi nham tieng, thiet tieng, noi sua. ngon chinh danh thuan. phai loi noi, phai danh phan. thuong bat chinh ha tac loan. co cau nom rang: be tren o chang ky cang, cho nen be duoi lam dang may mua.
loai giong nhu luon ma co hai tai hay la hai vi, hay o bien, ngon hon luon. ca chinh. id. lan chinh. lan bun, lan tron.
do dung bang dat, to hong, rong mieng ma thap. cai chinh. id. chinh binh. noi phinh, no to. thuong noi ve bung. bung chinh binh.

sua soan. nghiem chinh. nghiem trang, chinh dinh. te chinh. id. tu chinh hoac chinh tu. sua lai, sap don lai. viet khong chinh. viet so luot khong ky. tho bai khong chinh. tho bai lam khong nham phep. chinh don. sua sang, don dep. chinh bi. sam san. chan chinh. sua don, lo lam cho ra su the manh me.

do dung giong cai chinh ma nho hon. chinh hu. tieng keu chung hai thu do sanh gan giong nhu nhau. chinh nho, hu lon. vo chinh. tieng keu chung hai thu do sanh gan giong nhu nhau; vo hong tron, mieng lon ma cao. chuot sa chinh nep. tieng noi choi nguoi ngheo ma dung vo giau. mua nhu cam chinh. mua nhu xoi, mua lon lam.
chap chap ngoai moi; lam cho mim moi lai. chip mieng. id. chip moi. id. chip lay. ghi lay, dem vao long da.

nho lam, chet lam. chiu chit. tieng ga con keu; tieng rieng than, noi kho cung nhau. chut chit. mot chut mot dinh; do con nit choi, nan bang dat lam hai khap, phat giay dau lai, khap duoi co chua lo nho, keo xut xit hai khap thi no keu. chau dong giua, ba doi keu la chat, bon doi keu la chit, nam doi keu la chut. cung la tieng chuot keu: chuot keu chit chit. ao chit. ao chet trong. chit khan. bit khan.
tieng tro tu. kit chit. bo rit lam.
chit chiu. (coi chu chit). liu chiu. bo nhieu nguoi xum xit, than tho cung nhau. liu chiu lit chit.

lanh lay, ruoc lay; hung lay; vuong mang, mac phai; danh long, nhin biet; giu cam. chiu lay. ruoc lay, lanh lay. chiu phep. vang phep, chiu dau, chiu thua, khong dam chong ban; lanh lay phep gi. may du lam, bat dang may roi, may chiu phep chua? chiu kho. ruoc lay viec kho nhoc, cam be kho nhoc. ben long cuc kho. chiu viec. lanh lay viec gi; duong lay viec gi. chiu mieng. hua mieng rang se lam su gi. chiu toi. nhin lay toi; chiu phat ta; mac toi: chiu toi voi troi dat. chiu loi. nhin nuoc loi, xin loi, cam tho loi. chiu chang phai. nhin su quay, phat ta vi minh quay. chiu quay. nhin lay su minh quay, khong dam chua choi. chiu xau. mac lay viec xau ho; ruoc lay dieu si nhuc, phai xau ho. chiu ho. id. chiu nhuoc. id. chiu nhuc. id. chiu chet. de cho nguoi ta giet; danh chet, khong muon song. tha chiu chet chang tha chiu nhuc. chang le nhin thua. (tieng the). chiu an. nhin lay toi, chieu xung minh co pham toi, pham phep. chiu thua. nhin thua; hang dau, nhin minh thua sut. chiu dau. id. chiu thiet. mac dieu thiet hai; chiu thua kem; khong bang ke khac. chiu sut. chiu kem hon ke khac; nhin thua ke khac. chiu on. mang on, mac on, da nho ke khac lam on. chiu lay cua nguoi. lanh lay cua nguoi; an cua nguoi. chiu hoc. chiu di hoc; danh lam hoc tro; ung bac chuoc. chiu cho. hua se cho; lanh cho, ganh vac the cho. chiu dung. ben do, chac chan, co suc chiu. do vai bo chiu dung hon hang lua. chiu phien. tieng xin ke khac danh long voi minh, dung co phien. chiu thay. gap thay cho thuoc nham binh. (noi ve thay thuoc cuu binh). chiu thuoc. uong nham thuoc hay, gap thuoc hay. chiu va. ung chay va; mac va. chiu dao. danh long theo dao nao. chiu thai. co thai. chiu chuc. lanh chuc tuoc. chiu lanh. ung bao lanh; danh lanh lay. chiu lo. lo von, mac thiet hai. chiu no. ruoc lay no. bung lam da chiu. co cau chu rang 汝 作 應 還 汝 受 nhu tac ung huon nhu tho. chi nghia la minh lam minh chiu. chiu loi hoi. le hen ngay lam le hoi. chiu loi cuoi. le hen ngay lam le cuoi. chiu xau chiu gop. mac viec xau gop, an chiu voi lang. de chiu. co the chiu duoc, khong kho gi. kho chiu. lay lam cuc kho, dau don, ganh vac khong noi. mua ban chiu. mua ban con de thieu, khong co tien mat. thieu chiu. con mac cua nguoi ma de vay chua tra. an chiu. an chua tra tien bay gio; co an thua chiu dung voi ai, nhu an chiu voi lang. dung chiu. tieng chuc su rang cho ung, cho xung ra, cho lanh, cho ruoc, cho phuc. ai chiu. ai danh, ai ruoc lay, ai xung ra. co suc an co suc chiu. an bao nhieu, phai chiu bay nhieu. chiu khach. tiep khach khong nham, ua ruoc khach; co khach thu toi hoai. chiu hang. lanh hang, bo hang, lanh do ma ban. chiu luy. vang phep, dau luy. chiu tat. mac lay tat, danh mang lay tat, khong khoi tat, (phung que). chiu loi an tieng noi. mac lay tieng noi, bi ke khac mang nhiec, noi xau cho minh. phan lao dao phai sao chiuvay. an phan kho ngheo. chiu moi. ua moi, ua dut nhet; chiu lay cua lo lot roi. chiu don. bi danh don. chiu bac tu. lanh boc, u buon. chiu duc. gio lung ra ma chiu, de cho ke khac hanh ha. chinh nghia la cho cai chiu cho duc nhay. chiu mem. chiu moi be, bi hanh ha tram be. chiu ep. bi hanh ha, bi hiep dap, cat dau khong noi. chiu dam an xoi. vi co an nho, khong ne xau ho. chiu ham oan. phai chuyen oan uc, khong dam tho than. chiu dam. lanh dam: lanh viec don dam cuoi hoi v. v. lanh oa, lanh soat. chiu do. lanh do; chieu xung do; ung do. chiu the. danh the cho, ganh vac the cho. chiu dai. khong tranh khon dai, de cho ke khac hon minh. chiu dot. ung lam dua dot, khong muon hoc hanh. chiu tran ai. cam be cuc kho. chiu cuc. ganh vac su cuc kho.

lon theo y, nuong theo; cho uat khuc, vay vo. chiu theo. nuong theo. chiu lon. ha minh, lon loi theo y nguoi khac. chiu long. lay long, vi long. tram chiu, ghe chiu. tram be. day chiu. ten cay co, la no nham, nguoi ta hay dung ma trau chuoi. theo chiu. nuong theo cho vay vo, theo khuc lon nho. nghieng chiu. nghieng minh ma theo, nghieng theo. chiu mu gia. lon loi theo y me chong. chiu hon la chiu mu gia, nghia la chiu lon het cach.

trao, giao, nhuong, de, ma chang lay tien; chuan hua, ngo dang, dang ma, vi, the vi. tieng uoc, tieng khien, tieng tro tu. cho chac. tieng doi, chi nghia la cho khong, la giao dut. cho hay. thong tin cho biet. cho hay. tieng gia su: da hay, da biet: cho hay la thoi huu tinh, do ai dut moi to manh cho xong. cho nen. khien nen, hoa ra, tieng ket lai. cho nen noi. da hoa ra the gi. cho den. thau den. cho den doi. da den chung nao. cho vay. cho ke khac vay tien bac. cho khong. cho ngay ma khong doi su gi. cho bo. bo la bo ghet, da ghet, da gian. chang ua noi thua cho bo. cho dang, cho duoc. cho co the, duoc the; dang ma. cho ranh. cho khoi vuong van, cho roi. duoi di cho ranh. cho roi. phai cho thanh, cho man, cho het viec; (tieng buoc). cho xong. phai cho xuoi, cho thanh (tieng buoc). cho xuoi. id. id. cho thanh. id. id. cho thanh. id. id. cho ky. cho ky cang. id. cho som. dung de tre muon. id. cho kip. cho het suc mau, cho gap. id. cho kip. cho vua chung, cho ben theo. id. cho chong. cho mau, cho le. id. cho mau. id. id. an thi cho, buon thi so. viec buon ban phai tinh loi hai. noi cho phai. noi theo le phai, cho nham le phai; noi theo su thiet. cho phep. cho lanh phep gi, duoc phep gi. cho lanh. cho phep lanh, giao cho ma lanh. cho di cho lai. on di on lai, thu tac vang lai. 酬 酢 往 來 cho thuoc. cuu thuoc, dem thuoc ma chua benh. cho an. cap vat thuc, cho do an, dut nhet cho. cho em an thi la dut com cho con nit hoac coi cho no an. cho mac. cap do ban, cho ao quan. cho ngu. de cho ngu, lam cho ngu. cho kheo. tieng dan phai co y, lam cho ky luong, lam cho kheo leo. hau cho. cho duoc, dang ma, (tieng uoc). ngo cho. id. de cho. de vay, lam cho co the; de lai. dang cho. dang ma, co the ma. lam cho. lam ra the gi. lam cho no phai khon. muon cho. muon ra the gi. muon cho no giau. chiu cho. chiu the vi; hua se cho. the cho. the vi, de vat ma the. cau cho. tieng uoc xin cho duoc su gi. xin cho. id. xin gium. noi cho. noi giup, noi the vi. an cho deu keu cho du. chia phan dong deu. benh troi cho. benh troi khien nhu phong lao co lai.

loai luc suc, cung keu la muong. cho san. cho de ma san, thu cho cao cang thot minh, chay hay. cho ngao. thu cho lon hon het. cho co. thu cho nho, hay sua vat. cho soi. con lang, loai cho rung, du nhu cop ma nho. cho con. cho nho, cho moi de. cho dai. cho dien dai, hoac hang nang ma hoa du. cho ghe. cho mac ghe choc, tieng mang dua o do. meo dang cho diem. tieng mang dua xao tra, diem dang, khong lo lam an, cu o dang o diem. danh cho khong kieng chu nha. khong biet kieng ne. ham cho vo ngua. cho hay can, ngua hay da, phai giu minh, cho lat lo. co cho. cuoc con nit choi, ve tung hoanh duoi dat, mot cua de rieng keu la cua cho, dua vo y di nham cua ay thi la thua, nghia la bi cho can. cay cho de. loai co nguoi ta hay dung ma lam thuoc san hau. rang cho. hai cai rang nhon moc hai ben rang cua. chum chon cho. nhom ngon lai nhu cai chun cho; chum ngon tay ma boc. chum chun cho het ba noi ruoi. nai dat mong,cho le luoi. ay la thot tren mon, thot duoi cung mon; that loi ca hai, met nhoc ca hai. cho dau co sua lo khong. co chuyen nguoi ta moi noi. cho sua ma. sua bong sua dang, khong co chi cung sua; nhut la sua ban dem. noi nhu cho sua ma; chi nghia la noi cung nhu khong, noi ma khong ai cu. cho sua ngoat duoi mang chu. su the con cho that tinh mang ro, thuong men chu no, dau chu co danh dap, no cung chang oan thu. cho chet chu. tieng mang mo nang, mang cho den chu con cho. cho treo gian treo gac. cho hon. cho doi. tieng mang dua bat tai, khong co com an. cho thay thoc. thay do ma kho an, bo lo lao. cho vat. tieng mang dua vat ma. hot mau-. hot cham bao, noi chu la dai phong tu, chinh la thuoc ghe. tien cot co cho. cua bo, cua thi. ngu tuc hieu con cho chet roi, hon no xuong giu cau am giai, cho nen phai cot tien hoi lo ma tong tang, hoa ngay sau no da khong can ma lai dua minh qua cau am ti. cha cho me lon. tieng mang nhung dua khong biet dao ly, an o nhu thu vat. khong cho bat meo an do. tung phai dung do. cho ma. dep de, ngo nghinh. tieng khen con nit moi de xinh tot, ma khong dam noi ngay. cho gay xau mat nha nuoi. chu nuoi khong co cho no an. cho treo meo day. tieng dan rieng ve do an, bieu phai cat de can than.

cho gio ra. canh cho hay la kien cho. cho dau kien tay voi bap tay giap nhau, cung co the co xep. vat chi hoam hoam cung gio ra giong nhu cai dau kien cho. cui kien cho. cho dau xuong bap tay, kien tay giap nhau cung gio ra, cung goi la cui tay. chong canh cho. chong cui bap tay. loi canh cho. thuong noi ve ao rach hay loi cui kien tay; bo khong lanh le. ninh canh cho. ninh ta; dua mi xau xa.
do bang dat co hong, phia duoi co xoi lo de ma xoi ma hap. cai cho. id. cho xoi. do bang dat de ma xoi xoi.
ten cay go, co hai thu la cho chi, cho chai. cay cho. id. ngay cho, hoac ngay nhu cho. ngay do, ngay thang bang. ngoi cho ho. ngoi xom, ngoi nhon mot minh, coi bo buon buc. ngoi xo ro.

noi, chon, ngoi thu; khoan trong, khoan khong. cho ngoi. ngoi thu, cho de ma ngoi; toa vi. co cho. co ngoi thu, co viec lam, co noi, co chon. con ay da co cho, chi nghia la da co nguoi di hoi. kiem cho. kiem noi; kiem nguoi lam vo chong, bau ban; kiem cho ho khoan, trong chon ma lanh viec gi . dang cho. dang noi nao, dang nha nao, dang viec lam. lanh o mot cho, lo o mot noi. yen bon phan. cho cao. noi cao; nha cao sang. cho thap. noi thap, khoan thap, nha ngheo hen. cho an khong het, chothet khong kham. lay cho du bo cho thieu; tieng bieu phai cham che. chua co cho. chua co noi nao, chua co ai di noi. thuong noi ve cho lam vo chong. con cho cho. con cho nguoi, chua co viec lam; chua co vi; con duong chuc tiet. het cho. het noi, het cho khuyet, khong con cho bo khong. chat cho. khong con ho cho nao, het cho; du so roi. khap cho. khap moi noi, dau dau cung co.

chup cho. vo ma keu cho song lai. cuoc con nit choi; danh con thang lan, cac ke chet roi, lai vui duoi dat ma vo ma keu cho no song. bat chup cho, chi nghia la thay mat thi bat, bieu lien, cung co nghia la bat thinh linh. cho can. tieng rieng trong su danh bai, chi nghia la danh ran cho het bai.
he chai (tranh la). che cho. che mot cho, dua he nha lon.

tro (coi chu tro). cho ngo. bo khat kho, bo bo vo. lo cho long chong. bo khong chung dung, bo xo ro, bo luc lac khong yen cho. te lo cho long chong, thi la te nghieng te ngua. cho chong. bo nghieng ngua.

cho nhom ma mua ban. cho bua. tieng doi, id. cho dinh. cho o tai cho do hoi; cho buon ban lon, khong phai la cho nha que. ke cho. nguoi khon ngoan, biet phep lich su, doi voi moi ro. thanh ke cho, thi la thanh ha-noi. ca cho. ca va cho, khap cho, noi cho. mot cho. id. dong cho. chung cho nhom dong, nham gio thu 8, 9. cho dong. cho nhom dong nguoi. cho khong. cho khong nguoi nhom. tan cho. cho thoi nhom, het nhom; chung cho thoi nhom, man buoi cho. di cho. di mua an. ve cho. di mua an ma ve, nham 9, 10 gio. cho mai. cho nhom buoi mai. cho hom. cho nhom buoi toi. cho phien. cho nhom co ky, de ma ban nhung vat la thuong. quan o dinh o cho. an may. ai tang ban dat ma ngoi cho trua. hieu ve gai moi lon, co duyen thi lay chong som, vo duyen thi phai muon man. trum cho. chuc viec lang dat ra ma coi cho. chu cho. nguoi lap cho. mot minh mot cho. gianh the loi mot minh; nghenh ngang mot cho, khong ai dam tranh. do e cho. do khong ai muon mua. cam cho. khong cho nhom cho; lam ngang. duoi cho. duoi nguoi mua ban, khong cho nhom nua.

tieng cam ngan, bieu dung. tieng gang hoi; co phai, phai chang? tieng qua quyet, thuong de sau loi noi. cho chi. tieng uoc cho duoc, dong nghia voi tieng no nao. cho sao. sao vay, co sao; chang phai nhu vay sao. cho sao chu khong hoc. no noi nhu vay cho sao? tieng cho sao cau sau la tieng qua quyet. cho nao. tieng hoi; o dau; cho sao? cho nao hoc tro, khong thay tuu truong? cho he. chang he. cho dam. khong dam. cho chiu. dung chiu. cho danh. dung ung, dung de vay. cho chet. tieng ngam de, tieng ngan cam. lau ra thi cho chet, nghia la lau ra thi phai chet ma cho. cho so. dung so. cho lo. dung lo. ma cho. ma thoi, ma thoi cho, tang ay ma thoi, (thuong dat sau loi noi). thi cho. thi thoi, khong can gi. no chang lam thi cho, no lai pha. gap hay chang cho. gap thi cung hay, bang chang thi thoi, chi nghia la vo su chang biet lo chi. cho ai? con co ai? chang co ai nua. tao cho ai: chi thi la tao chang co ai dau. cho nhu. chi nhu, con nhu, con ve.

chuc, doi; tieng tro tu. cho doi hoac doi cho. chuc, doi. cho ngay. doi ngay. cho gio. doi gio, cung co nghia la cho gio chet, gan chet. cho chet. khong trong song. chan cho. thiet tha, cham lut. cho thi. cho van, cho khi. dau cho vo. dau lon qua, bo dai dot. cho chang. nhanh la tum lum, nghenh ngang (noi ve cay). cam sao ma cho ngu. chang lo viec lam an. cho nuoc toi tron moi nhay. vung toan, khong biet lo hau. cho day. cat minh day.

chat de len, van dem di (thuong hieu ve ghe, xe). cho chuyen hoac chuyen cho. id. cho hang. chat hang xuong (ghe), chat hang len xe). cho cui ve rung. khong biet dang buon ban. cho vang vao kho. lam loi cho quan. cho che hoac che cho. pho tri, ung ho. cho day. cho day ghe, xe, cho nhieu lam. cho kham. id. cho noi. suc cho duoc bao nhieu; cho khong day, ghe hay con noi. manh cho. cho duoc nhieu, chua duoc nhieu. yeu cho. khong suc cho, cho khong duoc bao nhieu.
mot minh it dung. cho day. cat minh cho day.
choi loa, nhap nhang. choa bong. nhap nhang thay khong ro. mat bong loa lam cho toi mat. bong sac loa ra, co ve xinh tot.
chap choa. cai xap xai.
van coi dong truoc dau mui, hoac sau lai ghe, veo ghe. choac ghe. id. cung co cho keu la xoac ghe, chinh cho dong dinh am duong,. can choac. can thang bang. ga la. ― ―. tieng ga so ma la lon.
rong khoe; rach khoe. mieng choac oac. mieng rong qua, rong huich. choac mieng. lon hong, ca tieng. choac choac. keu la om som. choac loi. khong dang viec gi.
con nho, bua bua khong lon nho. trau choai. trau to, trau con nho. ga choai. ga con nho. thang choai. thang nho. con choai. con nho tuoi. vo choai. vo nho. choai choai. nho nho, khong lon nho.
loai day hay moc theo dat bang, hay chiu mua nang, nguoi ta hay dung ma ben dang. day choai. id. but choai. but rut day ay. rau choai. dot day choai, dung lam mot mon rau.
cay nho nho, hay cha boi cam cho khoai len. choai khoai. id. cam choai. cam cay cho loai day nuong ma len.

chiem cu, gianh lay. choan cho. gianh cho. ngoi choan cho: ngoi gianh het mot cho, khong cho nguoi khac ngoi, hoac gianh cho ma khong lam duoc viec gi. choan dat. gianh dat. lang choan. xo ro, lam ban cho ke khac. choan mai. gianh lay mot minh, lam nhu cua minh.
(coi chu chun).

day to dau lai cho co the ma khieng ganh do nang. vat ngang qua. cai choang. id. buoc choang. buoc vat ngang, buoc ngang qua. khan choang hau. khan vat ngang qua dau cung cot moi duoi hau. choang tay. canh tay nay treo ngang qua canh tay kia. choang vai. bo kien tay qua vai nguoi khac. choang hong. om xoac lay hong nguoi khac. choang ngang. bo vat qua, nhu thoi cha-va vat khan.
bo cham ham, tinh tao. choanh hoanh. id. noi choanh. noi tren, noi lon loi.
tieng tro tu. nho choat. nho lam.

uoc mo; xuoc len; lo len. choc mong. uoc mo. choc ngoc. lo len, dua dau len. ngoi choc ngoc, thi la ngoi tro tro mot minh. choc moi. gio moi, quot moi, bo hon. choc len. xuoc len, noi len. loc choc (lo cho). bo khong vung. rau choc. loai rau hay moc duoi dat bung. chim choc. tieng doi chi nghia la chim (goi chung). chim choc mao. thu chim nho con, tren dau no co mot chom long xuoc len. cu choc. thu cu ngua, vi thuoc tri dam keu la ban ha. cho choc. thu cho rung nho con, lay tieng no keu ma dat ten.

treu gheo, dam thoc. choc gian. lam cho noi gian, noi xuc gan. choc gan. id. choc gheo hoac gheo choc. lay loi uom thu, treu gheo nhu the choc gai; kiem chuyen gay go lam cho ke khac tuc minh. treu choc. id. choc gay. kheu viec, gay viec. choc huyet. lay dao nhon dam vao hong cho chay mau (noi ve heo). choc co. lay ngon tay thoc vao trong co ma lam cho mua. choc lec. da dong, ro ram, lam cho nhot. choc trai cay. lay cay thoc lam cho trai cay rot xuong. chi choc. chi tro, lam cho ngo thay. choc ong. lam cho ong bay ra; lam cho gian du, lam cho sanh viec du; gay du. choc cho. hay khuay lam cho cho sua, cho duoi theo.

ghe lon. choc lech. id. (tieng doi). ghe choc. hieu chung la ghe. mut choc. mut ghe noi len ma do, hay moc tren dau con nit. choc dau. dau co ghe choc u nan. choc cat. ghe lon moc sau lung. trau choc cat, thay ac bay qua lien ne: co ti tich trong minh thi hay so. choc song. song chon co choc; dang song cop len, noi len.

(chuc) mot giay, mot lat. tieng tro tu dat sau tieng noi lam tieng qua quyet. choc ay. luc ay, khi ay. thoat choc. thinh linh, tinh co. bong choc. id. mot choc. mot lat. toi choc. thiet la toi, ay la toi. phai choc. phai do, phai nhu vay.

mot minh it dung. loi choi. chanh ranh, nhay troi nhay phach, khong yen mot cho. nhay loi choi. nhay nhot khong yen. chim choi choi. ten chim nho hay chay hay nhay. choi tron. nhon day, chom day (noi ve do dung).

cung voi nhau, lam cho dung nhau. choi nhau. lay loi noi ma chong bang nhau, khich nhau, kinh chong cung nhau. ga choi. ga nuoi rieng ma cho da do. choi ga. da ga. danh choi. cuoc con nit choi, lay da hoac mieng sanh doi bung cho trung vien da hoac mieng sanh khac. choi tien. cuoc con nit choi, lay tien dong doi nem cho nham dong khac.

yen sang gioi vao hoac lam cho loa con mat. choi sang. sang soi to ro. choi loa. rang ngoi hoac tai sang ma loa. choi loi. sang suot. choi mat. loa con mat. dau choi. dau loi tai cho nao. tuc choi. tuc loi tai cho nao. den choi. den chieu sang, den loa. choi den. mac ngon den ma loa con mat. mat troi choi. mat troi gioi yen sang. choi bong. mac bong ma loa. choi nuoc hoac choi nuoc. mang binh vi uong nuoc la hay la la nuoc. choi nhau. nganh nhau, ky khac cung nhau, khong ua nhau; lam cho cai tot cai xau, phan biet nhau.

nha la nho thuong cat co mot mai. tuong cham, buoi moc. choi ruong. choi cat ma o do trong luc lam ruong. choi trau. choi cat ma giu trau. choi trai, (tieng doi). nha cat ra de ma lam viec van. choi ton. choi cat co bon tru lam gac o tren cao. che choi. lam choi, lop choi. ngua choi. ngua lay chon ma buoi ma dap. san lai choi. san lai xoi can trong bung. choi moi choc moc. hay toc mach, hay chi choc. cay choi moi. ten cay, la no dung ma lam thuoc dau; re no lam thuoc bai.

chong do, guong gao, chiu lay. dan chon ra ma choi. cai choi. mot doan sat nhon dau ma dai co the ma xan da. choi da. dung choi ma xan da. chong choi. chong do, chiu lay keo te nga. choi hoi. banh lanh, thanh manh, hieu biet ro rang. nguoi benh con choi hoi. chong choi. sieng nang, cham chi.
trau, danh bong. choi lay minh. bao chuot cho minh; chua minh. choi van. gioi van.

cai di, khong chiu; khong nhin. choi cai. id. choi vai. id. chua choi. chua minh, khong chiu rang co. doi choi. choi cai truoc mat nhau. choi dao. khong nhin lay dao minh; bo dao minh. choi phut. choi ngon, khong chiu ngay. choi lut. id.

nhanh ngon moi dam len; cay nhanh moc la da o duoi thap. choi mong. id. dam choi. dam tuot. cay bi don roi con moc nhanh, dam tuot. moc choi. id. rung choi. rung thap co nhung cay nho nho, hoac da don het cay lon. choi que. con dong cua giong moi tro xanh. con da long moc, con choi len cay. khong tuyet noi; hay con co the noi sanh. dut cay ai no dut choi. chang le lam cho dut dang nhon nghia; chang no hai lay.

do dung ma quet, thuong ket bang cha, nhanh, long, co. choi quet van. do dung rieng ma quet van. choi quet nha. do dung rieng ma quet nha. choi dot. choi lam bang cay dot (loai bong co). choi cha la. choi dap bang tay cha la. choi long. choi ket bang long. cay choi. cay nho nho co nhieu nhanh, nguoi ta hay dung ma lam choi. ruou choi. ruou chung bang nhanh choi keu la 地 夫 子 dia phu tu, cung nhieu vi thuoc thom khac; ruou de ma thoa bop. choi cha. choi bo bang cha cay. cha choi. cay rung het la, con nhanh khong, cong khong, bo xo xac giong hinh cai choi cha. cung hieu la cai choi. can choi. tay cam cai choi. choi cun. choi dung lau con cong khong.
cat minh cho day. choi day. id. cat dau khong noi, choi dau khong day. bi luy qua, ngheo ngat qua.

hung vui, khong lam cong chuyen; theo cuoc vui choi. choi boi. id. choi nhoi. id. choi ac. lam chuyen mat net, loi cang thuong. con choi ac thi la con trai gai, con gian dam. ac choi. khuay choi. choi co bac. danh co bac. choi xuan. vui theo cuoc nam thanh nu tu; hung canh xanh tuoi, mat me. nhut choi tien nhi gion tien. choi tien thi la theo sac duc, gion tien thi la co bac, ay la hai cuoc hay lam cho con nguoi me dam cung phai khon. noi choi. noi deu gion choi; noi chuyen cho vui; noi dieu vui ma co y cham chich. khuay choi. bay chuyen khuay nhau, gat nhau cho vui. le di choi. le so van. dao choi. di cho kia cho no cho vui, cho khoi tu tung. gion choi. bay chuyen vui choi, gion hot. de nhu choi. de lam. choi dao co ngay dut tay. khong biet giu minh, de nguoi thi phai mac. vui choi. vui ve, choi boi. an choi. thanh nhan sung suong, khoi lo su gi. con nha an choi, thi la con nha giau. hat choi. hat hong cho vui. ngu choi. ngu cho khoe.
mot minh it dung. choi voi. hai tay buon chai, vo vuong lam cho minh troi len (thuong noi ve nguoi te xuong nuoc).
co nhieu, du ra. chinh la chu da, 多 noi theo tieng trieu-chau. choi tien. co nhieu tien. choi lo. pha tan, khong biet danh de.

mot khum, mot cum. sao chom. sao moc nhieu cai lien nhau. chom xom. mot xom nha cat xum xit theo nhau; chia phe dang. chom nha. mot cum nha cat vay lay nhau. chom ong xom kien. phe dang, be dang, cuoc nhieu nguoi toa rap ma lam loan. chom cay. mot lum cay moc xum xit. chom rau. mot khum rau moc xum xit hoac moc rieng mot cho. rau ba chom. rau moc ba cho. chom chon. tum chon, dung khong ngay (noi ve cot nha). chon. ―. chon co lai, tum lai.
tum phia duoi (thuong noi ve bat chen). chen chom chun. chen nho chun nho khu, de khong vung. chen chom long. chen rong mieng sau long ma tum phia duoi. ghe chom luon. ghe tum luon, hay sang hay lac.

co tua co long. trai chom chom. loai trai truong long. co chom chom. loai co nhieu long. cha chom. co nhieu nhanh nhoc, hoac xuoc len. lom chom. khinh bac khong nen net, bo khong te chinh. mieng chom bom. mieng ngam day chung bung (nhu ngam cau trau). con chom chom. loai nhen nhen cao cang, hay chay tren mat nuoc. nguoi ta noi no doc, an nham no thi phai chet. 1. ▲ goc:  duoc sua thanh 紀 級: chi tiet 2. ▲ goc: an - hoi lo duoc sua thanh an am cau hoi lo: chi tiet 3. ▲ goc:  duoc sua thanh 鍼 灸: chi tiet

nhay dung len, nhon len, xom toi. chom o. bo ham ho, gianh lay mot minh. nhay chom. nhay dung len ma chup (nhu cop, nhu cho). ngoi chom hom. dap hai chon ma ngoi, doi voi ngoi tret la ngoi sat dit; ngoi nhon, ngoi hong tron.
dau co chom bom. toc tai xu xop, giong cai cha choi.

nhay dung, nhay xom ma chup. chom hop. bo nhay dung, bo hon hao. chom nguoc. bo nhay len ma chup ma lay cho duoc. noi chom. noi hot, chup lay loi noi ke khac. cho chom. cho nhay dung, nhay xom toi. ngua chom. ngua dung len ma chup. chom bop. cach ho bop cho nguoi binh mac chung te me, lanh leo.
tieng tro tu. sac chom chom. bo sac lam. nhon chom chom. bo nhon lam. luoi guom chom chom. luoi guom sac ngot, sac lam.
gam ghe, dem. chom di. sam sua di, don di. chom toi. xam ram di toi. chom di noi vo. khien di lam le hoi. vua chom. vua muc, vua chung; duong sam sua. chom gay. gan muon gay.
lua lay, nham lay. chon ken hoac ken chon. id. chon lua. id. chon lay. id. chon ban. lua nguoi lam ban. chon da thu vang. chon lua, kiem tim, do thu cho chac.
gon gang, khong be bon. chon hon. id. an mac chon hon. an mac vua van, khong dai khong van. rau ma chon. ten rau, co tai giai nhiet.
mot minh it dung. lon chon. co cuc nho nho, boi roi. da lon chon. da trai nho (noi ve nhieu).

dao dat ma dap xuong. chon dam ma. chon ke chet; dam chon ke chet. chon xac. id. chon song. chon nguoi con song; lam cho phai tai hai. chon cat. dao dat ma vui giau; cung la tieng doi. chon tien. giau tien bac duoi dat. bon chon. lat dat, voi va, hoi hap. chon chun. mac vao vong, vuong mang. chon minh. lam cho minh phai tai nan. chon sap. lam lat dat, chon cat khong tu te. chet thi chon. chang phai thuong tiec qua, chang phai lam rinh rang, co lam the chi cung vo ich.

cho, noi, xu so. chon chon. khap cho, moi noi. khap chon. id. chon kinh do. cho vua chua o, thanh dau trong nuoc. chon truong an. id. chon thi thien. cho buon ban do hoi; cho dinh lieu. chon san da. dat nha que.

loai thu giong cho ma muot long. con chon. id. chon cao. giong chon lon ma du, co van nhu cop. chon bong lau. giong chon nho, duoi no giong cai bong cay lau. chon muop. giong chon nho muot long, nguoi ta hay dung long no lam ngoi viet. chon den. giong chon nho ma den, noi la luon hoa ra. chon ngan. loai chon lon ma du. chon doi. chon co kien hay bay, keu la thuong cam ha thu. kien chon. kien tha don. chon dong. don dong.

(chan). ngay that; chon cang, tuc keu la chun. chon that. chac that. chon chat. thiet tha. chon thanh. co long ngay that. chon tam. that long. chon chinh. ngay thang. chon tinh. thiet tinh, khong co y gi. chon nguon. chinh coi re, chinh goc. chon duong. hinh in, ve. viet chu chon. viet chu chon thiet, ngang bang so ngay. chon den. do lam co the ma de cay den. chon dang. ban dap ma leo len lung ngua. chon troi. vanh troi ngo thay ngang mat, coi nhu chup xuong duoi dat. chon nui. goc nui; trieng nui. nui chon-dum. ten nui o tinh an-giang. chon toc ke rang. can ke; du net. day tu chon toc ke rang. chon may. goc may, cho may tuon ra. may dut chon. may dut goc, trong chon. mot chon buoc di, muoi chon buoc lai. ay la di khong dut, but khong roi. chon vac dat an. nha nuoc vung ben, vo su. dia deo chon hac. khong xet bon phan, deo bong thai qua. tieng noi ve nguoi ngheo hen muon ket nghia hoac lam sui voi nguoi giau sang. chon quan. chot ong quan. chon dam chon chieu. bo di sang ngang, chon qua chon lai. ban chon. ca nang chon, dau chon. nang chon. id. ngon chon. nam chia ban chon. phui chon. phui dap bui dat lam cho sach chon. chum chon. nhom dau ngon chon. co chon. co xep cai chon. song chon. canh xuong gio ra truoc ong chon. bap chon. cuc thit nam dai sau ong chon. bat ngua lam chon. di ngua. manh chon khoe tay. suc khoe, manh me. lui chon. di ve, tro lai. di chon. di bo. di chon khong. di khong giay dep. cham chon. cham chap, khong tinh truoc. doi chon. di. mau chon. nham le, di mau. sai chon. giai chon, duoi chon ra. theo chon. di theo. hong chon. chon khong cham dat. mang hong chon: mang nhe minh. chay chon khong ben dat. het suc lo, het suc chay. cuong chon. dai chon, di nhieu ban qua, chon te di linh quinh. hut chon. chon dap khong nham, khong toi dau la dau; sa nga. say chon. id. que chon. dau chon, phai di nhuc nhac. lo chon trai buoc. mac viec tro buc, mat duong toi lui. gay chon. gay cang, gay gio, khong co the di dang. ke tay chon. ke bo ha, ke giup do, ke tin cay. rong chon. thong tha de di, muon di dau cung duoc. trong chon. id. trong cho. lung chon. (coi chu chung). dung chon. dung lai. chon uot chon rao. bo con bo ngo, o dau moi toi. kip mieng chay chon. noi thi gap ma di thi cham; noi de ma lam kho. khong co chon dung. khong co goc. dan binh bong khong co chon dung. vung chon. yen cho o, co the nuong dua. cam chon. cam lai khong cho di, bo buoc. bat cam the vat gi cho chac, lam nhu cua tin. the chon. the vat gi de ma lam tin. vay tien ma cho con o the chon. do chon tay. do thay viec lam. nuoi heo ran mo, nuoi con do chon tay. man chon. man che phia duoi ban tho, (quan ban). chon dai. do tien bang cay co the ma de bat chen len tren. chon nhang. do cam nhang; cong cay nhang ve phia de ma cam. chon qui. do tien duc giong cai chon qui, de ma chiu lay ban ghe. dau chon ha mieng. de cho toi viec moi noi; dau don phai noi. chon ghe. cay chiu lay mat ghe. chon tuong. goc tuong, le chiu lay tam tuong. chon vach. le chiu lay buc vach. chon rit. xia ra hai ben nhu chon con rit. chay chon rit thi la dung may chi xo qua lai, cho dang chi dang may xia xuong hai ben. co chon rit. co dai co ria hai ben. xa moi chon gan moi mieng. xa thi kho be tham vieng, gan lai mang loi an tieng noi. su the kho gan nhau. bat chon tuong. thu bat lon lam. nu-chon. ten nuoc o phia bac trung-quac. giam chon. hai chon di dap hoac dung mot cho ma nhay len dap xuong hoac nhe hoac nang. giam chon ba tieng keu troi. duoi chon. dua ngay chon ra. di het chon. moi met, khong di duoc nua. di bet chon. moi chon qua, het suc di. con mac chon tien. hay con thieu no. nhu rit nhieu chon. nhieu nguoi co the giup nhau. danh dau chon. theo dau, coi dau chon ma theo. giam chon tien. dua tien them lam cho phai mac no hoai, thuong noi ve su muon day to, muon nguoi lam cong.
co tang, co ngan; co don. chon cho. bo co tang co ngan ma cao lam. chon nuoc. ngan nuoc don; me nuoc. chon thuy. cho sup xuong o giua nguc. chon toc. me toc. toc chon. toc co don.
mot minh it dung. chon von. bo nhay dung; bo cat minh len, hai tay bo toi. chon von hum xom doi ngan. chon von muon chup. muon xong vao ma chup.

de den khong tat; gio len; cham chi mot be, cu mot be. den chong. den de luon khong tat. chong den. id. chong so. gio hai mo doi nhau, lua the ma da (noi ve ga choi). trau chong. trau nghinh, dua hai sung toi truoc. lay theo nghia tu-vi tabert thi la trau tuyen ven de ma te. com chong dau. com dom vao bat de truoc dau ke chet. phep cung com cho ke moi chet. thuc chong. thuc luon. choi chong. cu viec choi mai, nhung choi ma thoi. choi chong than. id. can chong. do bat ca, giong cai vot ma lon.

mau, nham le. chong vanh. mau man, nhe nhe. chong kip. mau gap. cho chong. cho gap, (tieng hoi thuc). cai chong chong. do that bang la cay, phan ra nhieu kien, de ra gio thi no xay, no chay vo vo. chong mat. bat phai chang vang; xay xam.
don xeo nay bang sat. cai chong. id. cung nhu chong. cung lam.

(chong). long chong. bo loc choc, nhut la tai chon cang khong deu. cho chong. id. te chong gong. te chui xuong, gio gio len. chong dau. chuc dau xuong; dong dau xuong. chong cang. gio cang len, gac cang len cao. chong cang ma ngu, thi chang lo so su gi.
cai giuong nho. cai chong. id. giang chong. id. (tieng doi).

do mut nhon de ma tram, cho nguoi ta di khong dang, vat gi noi len gio giam, nhon dau, hoac co gai goc. chong gai. do mut nhon, hoac co gai nhon. bo gian hiem; dang chong gai. tha chong. rai do mut nhon ay. dong chong. dong do mut nhon ay xuong cho nao. phan bui dinh vao vat gi lau ngay lam cho vat ay gio giam. ve dong chong. ve dong phan tra tau dom nhieu lop, nguoi uong tra lay lam qui. noi chong gai. noi loi cham chich, lam cho ke khac phai dau don. chong trai au. chong dom tu trai tron. chong hoa cui. chong dong vao truc dai de ma lan xuong. hon chong. cu lao o gan ha–tien.

ngan, chiu lay, choi lay, do lay, xo ra. chong choi. id. chong do. id. chong tra. danh tra, mang tra, kinh dich khong chiu thua. kinh chong. kinh gan, kinh nghe khong chiu thua. noi chong. noi nganh, nguoi ta noi mot the, minh noi ra the khac, khong chiu mot y. chong nanh. tay choi vao hong; xap kien tay bo lay hong. chong cua. lay cay chiu lay kien cua ma do len hoac chong ra. be nang chong troi. lam chuyen dai, chang luong suc minh. chong thuyen. lay sao ma day thuyen di. chong ghe. id. chong tri. nong tri, khong chiu thua tri. cheo chong. va cheo va chong. sao chong. dung sao ma day thuyen. hai chin chong nhau. hai suc bang nhau, khong ai thua ai. chong gay. nuong gay ma di (gia ca). chong tay. lay bang tay ma choi, ma chiu. chong noi. chiu noi, do noi. chong dua. chong ngang khong co toi su gi; day phut, day mot be. chong con mat ma coi. mo con mat ra cho lon ma coi. tieng noi lay, da sang mat chua.

chat dong, sap de nhieu lop; tieng goi nguoi trai co vo; tieng vo xung nguoi don ong cua minh. chong chap hoac chap chong. chat dong, sap dong vat nay tren vat khac. chong dong. id. nam chong. nam sap dong sap lop tren minh nhau, hoac tren vat gi. sap tu chong. sap tu lop, tu dong. mot chong. mot dong sap theo thu lop. chong tru. gia nhap hoac tru ra, ay la hai phep toan dau. chong ngu. bo con toan hiep nhieu so vo mot. vo chong. tieng keu chung don ong don ba da co ket ban cung nhau, don ong la chong, don ba la vo. lay chong. chiu lay nguoi nao lam chong. gai ngoan lam quan cho chong. gai khon hay lam lich su cho chong. dao vo, nghia chong. le buoc ke lam vo chong phai giup do cung thuong yeu nhau.

dit tro len, dau dong xuong. chong gong. gio hai gio len nhu cai gong. chong mui. vac mui, thuong noi ve ghe cho nang lai, dau mui phai vong len. chong lai. vong dau lai, thuong noi ve ghe cho dam phach dau lai phai noi len. don can vac chong. can vac qua. chong chong mong. dau dong xuong dat, dit tro len troi. te chong chong mong.

cai chot, cai ngon; toc chua de giua dau; nam bat, lay. chop chai. chinh cai chot, cai moi chai. cai chop, cai ngon, (tieng doi). chop non. chi, long ket tren chot non. nam chop. nam dau, nam chom toc chua giua dau. chop dau. nam dau. chop quach. bat quach. chop di. hot di, lay di, lay khong ai hay. thang lom chop. thang diem dang, luc tac. chua chop. cao toc chung quanh dau, ma de mot chom chinh giua. de chop. id. gioc chop. phan toc chua giua dau ra tu lon nho cung danh treo lai voi nhau.

nhang ra; tach ra, xuoc ra gan muon gay (thuong noi ve cay). troi chop. troi nhang sang. sam chop. sam noi co lua nhang ra. chop nhang. lua sam loa ra. con mat chop lach. con mat hay nhay, hay danh chop lach, nhu khi thay chop ma nhay. ba chop ba sang. loa let, khong to ro. ngu moi thuc day, con mat ba chop ba sang. cay chop. cay muon tach muon gay. co chop. co dau muon gay; co ti tich, da co mac su gi truoc roi. chop hop. muon hop lay, muon giut lay, bo tham muon thoi qua. chop canh. nhip canh ma bay, xam ram muon bay; danh nhip hai canh.
chop rop. ron rang, am uc, nao nuc.

cai ngon, cai chop, cho vot len, cho thon von, cho rot. chot vot. chinh cai ngon o tren het. chot nui. dinh nui, chop nui. chot cay. ngon cay. chot sung. cho sung tot ra. chot mui. cho mui gio len. sau chot. sau rot. hoc do o dang sau chot. duoi chot. duoi rot. id. do chot. do lam, do tham. chot mieng. nhon mieng, hay noi, khong biet giu mieng. chot mieng noi hon.
dam giot. dam chot. id. chot thoc. dam thoc, gia thoc. chot chot. dam giot nhe nhe; dao boi nhe nhe, lam doi. chot chot coi gao doi nao cho trang.

do nem, do khoa lo ho. chot cua. cay vac tron de ma khoa cua. chot ghe. cay vac tron de ma dong kem lay be ghe. dong chot. dong cay tron ay de ma kem ma khoa. nem chot. id. day chot. de dat, can than. loi noi day chot. loi noi can than, co ngan nap, co chen dung. noi chot chat. noi xang, noi nang ne vo phep, kho nghe. ca chot. thu ca song co hai nganh ma nho con. cha ke luc chot. hieu nghia la nguoi hen ha, nho mon.

cai cong, cai cot; nhot nhac, ruc rich. chot cay. chinh minh cai cay. chot bong tai. cai cong bong tai. lon chot hoac nho chot. lon cong hoac nho cong. chot y. nhot y, mat co. chot da. ruc rich khong yen trong da, muon di ngoai. chot bung. id. chot ban. ngo ban, re ban dam len. chot nua. goc cay nua, minh cay nua. ran chot nua. ten ran doc.
noi khong sua, noi nhu con nit. cha chot. noi giong nhong nheo khong chinh dinh. chut chot. noi da dot. noi chot. noi dot. id. trai be chot chat. noi khong sua, khong chinh tieng.
giot, mac nuoc ma phai phai mau, khong dam mau. tieng tro tu. chot da. tray da, giot nuoc da. chot vo. tray vo. trang chot. trang bac, trang nhe, mau trang chet. chot nhin. liec xem, vung ngo thay.

thu dat do bam nguoi ta hay dung lam nuoc ve theo dang voi to. nuoc chu. mau do bam. tho chu. thu dat do bam; ten nui. chu dat. id. chu sa. chau sa. chu cham. cham chi, sieng nang, y tu. chu chu cham cham. id. con chu chu. loai chim giong nhu bo cau, ma lon.

tieng xung ho, em cha, hoac nguoi nho tuoi hon cha, hoac vai nho hon cha, hoac la em minh, nho tuoi hon minh, vai nho tuoi hon minh. chu kia. nguoi kia (tieng keu nguoi nao trong vay). cac chu. tieng nguoi annam goi nguoi trung quac, nhin la ba con, nham vai em cha minh. chu nghi. tieng keu choi, hieu la no, ten ay, chu ay. chu chang. id. chu va. id. chu no. tieng keu nguoi nho hon minh ma noi voi. chu may. id.
dan giai, cat nghia. thuong doc theo van binh, nhu noi chu cai thi hieu la chu lon; chu con thi la giai nghia chu nho. chu giai. id. tap chu. nhom chu con.

tru em theo dao thay phap. phu chu. tru em, do em. bua chu. id. em chu. phep lam cho ta ma phai xa lanh, hoac de ma khuay nhau, hai nhau. doc chu. doc than chu, doc loi phu phap, goi la chon ngon. niem chu. id. than chu. loi chu, loi truyen cua thay phap lay lam linh thinh, he doc toi thi hoa phep.
chuot chu. chuot xa.

ke lam dau, ke cai quan, ke co phep rieng mot minh. chu gia. nguoi lam chu nha, nguoi co phep rieng cai quan trong nha. chu nha. id. chu dat. nguoi lam chu dat, ke co dat. trai chu. nguoi cho vay. chu no. id. cung hieu la nguoi mac no. chu thu. chuc coi kho, coi tien luong. dien chu. chu ruong. te chu. ke lanh viec te, ke dung te. tho chu. thanh hoanh, chua xu, cung hieu la cai mieu nho lap ra ma tho chua xu. moc chu. bai vi de ten nguoi chet, de ma kinh tho. than chu. id. tan chu. ke lam khach, ke lam chu nha, nguoi ngoai va nguoi trong nha. cung hieu la khach hay la nguoi quen thuoc hoac co viec chi voi minh. thay thuoc hoi tan chu, nghia la hoi dai cac nguoi hot thuoc cua minh ma lay tien dai. su chu. ke co tai vat bi ke trom, ke cuop lay di. tai chu. chu cua, chu cho vay. 受 債 怨 財 | tho trai oan tai chu. chi nghia la ke vay hay oan nguoi cho vay. nguyen chu. chanh chu, chu cu, ke lam chu truoc. tin chu. bon dao, ke tin tuong dao (thuong noi ve dao phat). chu soai. chu tuong, dong suat ca viec binh. chu su. chuc quan nam sau pham coi viec rieng trong luc bo. nguoi lam dau viec, doc viec. chu trai. dau dang an cuop. chu khach. tieng keu chung ca chu ca khach. 先 爲 | 後 爲 客 tien vi chu hau vi khach. truoc chu sau khach, tieng thinh moi nhau. con co cha nha co chu. phai cu goc, khong duoc lam tat ngang. chu quan. ke lap quan ra ma tiep khach. chu dam. nguoi bay cuoc gi nhu dam chay, dam hat v. v., hoac la chu viec gi lon. quan tron chu. nhung dua bo chu ma di, quan khong goc. cung la tieng mang mo. quan chet chu. tieng mang dua ngang tang khong biet phep, khong biet nghe loi day bieu, cam nhu chu no chet roi khong ai day do. quan phan chu. tieng mang dua o ngo nghich, kiem dieu hai chu no. hoi chu. ke lam dau, lam lon trong hoi nao. huong chu. chuc lon trong lang. thi chu. chu bo thi, nguoi lam viec bo thi. de chu. phep de ten ho nguoi chet trong moc chu. chu ke. chu ga, nguoi co ga dem toi ma da do. chu truong. thuong hieu ve nguoi lam dau lap truong da ga. chu khao. quan truong, ke lam chu viec khao hach hoc tro. chu truong. cam quien lam chu mot minh; coi giu dieng moi, cuong tru. chu truong con co chi hang o trong. tang tam cung la chu truong trong minh nguoi ta. chu y. lay y minh bay ra truoc, chi ve truoc, xuong viec truoc; co y. chu chot. lam chu, lam dau, lam goc, cam can. chu muu. bay muu truoc, cam muu. chu tau. nguoi quan viec coi mot chiec tau.

moi, cac, tieng chi so nhieu. chu hau. cac vua chua phai tung nuoc lon. chu tuong. cac tuong giac; tieng keu cac tuong giac. chu su. cac thay, keu chung cac thay chua, thay day. chu nhu. cac thay nho. chu quan. cac quan linh, cac dao binh.

tieng hue chi nghia la bay gio. bay chu. id. rang chu. chung nao; lam sao bay gio? biet rang chu. biet lam sao bay gio. chu chu. duong luc bay gio, noi bay gio. chu bu; mat chu bu. lam mat buon gian (thuong noi ve con nit).
ghi, nho. chu da. ghi da, de da, dem vao long da. chu loi. ghi giu lay loi noi, khong quen. chu hon. tieng thuong noi giu hon, nghia la phai giu minh keo....(tieng ngam de).

hinh tich, dau diem, lam co y nghia, thuong dung ma viet, hoac ma in. chu ngai. chu viet ra cung la nghia ly, nhieu khi hieu la chu tron. hay chu. nguoi hoc gioi. biet chu. vua biet hoc ma thoi. chu chan. chu viet don, viet thiet, ngang bang, so ngay. chu dan. id. chu viet kep. chu viet ky luong. chu thau. chu viet doi, viet mau. chu thao. id. chu mat. chu nhieu net, kho viet. chu re. chu it net, de viet. chu lac mai. chu viet roi net ma sac sao. chu viet vuong. chu viet keo net ra dai lam ra hinh uon eo. chu co tu. chu viet theo dieu xua. chu le. chu viet theo dieu xua, phan ra nhieu net. chu thay chua. chu giep. chu hoa. chu viet nhu ve. chu rang. co cau chu noi rang. chu hay. chu viet tot. xau hay lam tot, dot hay noi chu. cau truoc noi vi, cau sau noi chi quyet anh dot lai muon lam mat hay chu. dai chu. tuc hieu nguoi ham hoc qua hoac hoc nhieu qua hoa ra ngay dai, cu doc sach noi chu nghia hoai. ten chu. chinh ten dat theo chu. chu bua. chu em lam ra hinh con thu. chu thiep. chu in ra cho hoc tro tap, hoac do theo hoac nham ma viet theo. chu viet thiep. chu viet co phep.

mui giam, mui trai cay ung hoac con non. lay nghia hoac viet chu nho mot ben chu lon. lai dong van voi chu chau. chua xot. dang cay, dau don. chua chat. mui chua, mui chat. chanh chua thi khe cung chua. cung dong mot loai. giam chua. mui tu nhien no. mau ghen: giam chua lai toi bang ba lua nong. (tuy kieu). cay chua. da cay ma lai chua, mui kho chiu. loi noi cay chua. loi noi lam cho nguoi ta kho chiu. chua le. chua lam, kho chiu qua. su doi chua le. tuong chua. chinh la mui tuong; tuong chua muoi man la vat an cua thay chua. nau chua. dung trai chua ma nau lon voi mon gi. chua bau. chau bau. hot chua. hot chau.

dang cam quyen sua tri trong mot nuoc, ke lam chu trong mot nha. duc chua troi. chua ca troi dat, dung dung nen troi dat. thien chua. id. duc chua ba. hieu la me duc chua gie giu. vua chua. tieng keu chung cac dung lam vua. cong chua. con gai nha vua. ba chua. id. thuong cong chua. cuoi cong chua, (tieng noi rieng). chua nha. chu nha. chua tau. ke lam chu mot chiec tau. le trieu nguyen chua. trieu nha le lam vua, nha nguyen lam chua hay mot phuong ma phai tung nha le la chanh vi vuong. chua dong. hue duyen con gai; than but giu duyen gai tot. chua xuan. id. chua moi. con moi lam chu doan. chua ong. con ong cam bay. chua doan. lam chu mot doan. trau chua doan. chua cong. tieng xung ho ke lam chu mot phe lon hoac mot xu lon, chua thanh mot nuoc, nhu keu ong luu-bi la chuu cong. lam chua. lam chu mot mien, lam vua mot xu. chua xu. ke co quyen the lon, lam chu mot xu. chua son lam. cop. chua on. qui su, chu qui, ke mat mui den dieu xau xa, cung goi la chua no. cung la tieng noi choi. chua ngu ma nuong. cot la moi chet thanh qui, thay phap hay cung. nguoi den dieu xau xa dai dot, thuong keu choi la chua ngu ma nuong.

chinh la nha tho phat. chua chien. (tieng doi) id. chua mieu. tieng keu chung, chua la nha tho phat, mieu la nha tho than. thay chua. cac thay tu dao phat. nhieu sai, khong ai dong cua chua. nguoi thi co ma cong viec khong ai lam. chua ong. nha tho ong quan-de. chua ba. nha tho ba ma-hau. chim thay chua. thu chim hay keu nhu go mo. cung chua. dem le vat ma dang vao chua. tuong chua. tuong thay chua hay an; do chay lat, thay chua khong dang an thit. dau thay chua. dau troc.

tieng tro tu, doi voi tieng da. chua biet. khong he biet; hay con phai biet. chua hay. id. biet chua. thay roi cho? biet roi cho? hay chua. id. lam chua. da lam roi cho? chua lam. khong he lam, sau moi lam. chua thay. khong he thay, khong kip thay. an chua no lo chua toi. chua du deu, chua hieu viec, hay con kho dai. chua duoc. khong duoc, bay gio khong duoc. chua he. chang he. chua tang. id. chua quen thuoc. chua at. chua chac. chua may. hay con hon nua, hay con la nua. chua thay gi. chua co lam sao, chua co dau gi.

tich tru, giau de, oa tru. giau chua. id. chap chua. giu lay, gianh lay, tich tru lay mot minh, chat de day day. thung chua. thung tich tru, thung lon lam. an co thung chua, co bau chuyen, thi la an nhieu qua. chua chan. day day; ten nui cao ve tinh bien-hoa. chua co bac. tiep ruoc; tru duong nguoi co bac ma an xau an dau. chua an trom. oa tru ke trom ma phan tang. chu chua. chinh chu tru duong, tiep ruoc ke gian nhu bom co bac, trom cuop. nha chua. id. tho chua. id. (thuong noi ve co bac). chua nuoc. de tich nuoc ma uong. ghe mai lon.

tu bo, thoi di, de rieng ra, lam phan biet. chua cai. tu bo khong dam pham, khong dam lam lai nua. chua toi. xa lanh, bo dang toi loi. chua ra. de rieng ra, tru ra. doc long chua. quyet long an nan, dut bo. chang chua. chang tru, chang bo ra ngoai; khong chua cai. chua cho. de danh mot cho. chua dang. de dat lam dang.

co thai, lon bung; dong nghia voi tieng chua. co chua. id. chua nghen. (tieng doi) id. co chua co de. co viec, lau ngay phai phat; co mot ngay mot co. cay chua. cay to ra mot khuc nao. cau chua, chuoi chua la khi co hu hay la khuc dot no no lon hon thuong. co tay chua. co tay vung sung len mot cuc nhu bap chuoi, cung goi la dau bap chuoi. chua trau. trau chua toi 12 thang. co chua lau lac ma khong de. chua lam. chua lam. chua di. chua di. chua xong. chua roi, chua xuoi.

chinh nghia la cuu vot; dung nom chi nghia la vung. chung cuu. cuu chua. cuu phan chung nich: 救 焚 | 溺 cuu ke chet thieu, vot nguoi chim dam. chung day. vung day, cho day. dung chung. dung vung. chap chung. moi tap di dung, di chua vung. noi chung. noi vung vang. chung chang. vung vang. an noi chung chang. bay chap chung. bay chua vung, moi tap bay. di lung chung. di khong vung goi.

chiu lay, chac lay, lanh lay. chuoc lay su doi. da mang lay viec doi. chuoc hai. di giay. chuoc dep. di dep. chuoc khan. bit khan, chit khan. chuoc luoc. giat luoc. hinh dung chai chuoc. hinh dung dep de.

chiu tien ma dem ve, lanh ve; mua lai. chuoc mang. mua mang song, chiu tien bac cho khoi chet. chuoc toi. chiu tien bac ma cuu minh cho khoi toi, khoi an. lap cong ma den toi. chuoc an. chiu tien ma lanh an (phep moi). chuoc ruong. chiu tien ma lay ruong lai. chuoc dat. chiu tien ma lay dat lai. chuoc do cam. dem tien ma lanh do minh da cam the. chuoc moi. mua moi, (luat cam mua, noi tranh la chuoc). chuoc day to. mua day to, chiu tien ma lanh day to. cuu chuoc. cuu cho khoi tai nan, v. v. cho chuoc. cho nguoi ta dem tien bac toi ma lanh lai, mua lai. chiu chuoc. chiu dem tien toi ma lanh ve ma den lai. chuoc cau. chuoc tim lai cho duoc. tram minh y kho chuoc cau, muon hiep no nao dang thay. chuoc tieng tot. mua tieng tot, lap the lam cho duoc tieng tot nhu cu.

rot, cham che. cham chuoc. lam cho vua. chuoc cho. cho khoi, tha thu; chuoc cho mot phien xau; chuoc cho khoi lay. chuoc lieu. lieu the nao. tinh cho vua. chuoc luong. id. chuoc nghi. nghi the nao, nghi cho vua. chuoc tuu. rot ruou.

muu mo, cach the bay ve, de ma lam su gi. chuoc moc. id. muu chuoc. muu ke, dieu nghi khon kheo hay lam cho ke khac lam. lam chuoc. lam muu, gia ke. gia chuoc. gia do, bay ra mot the, lam ra mot the. kiem chuoc. muon the gi, tim co gi. kiem chuoc di choi. noi chuoc. noi leo lac, qui quai; lap the gat gam. toan chuoc. toan lam chuoc gi, ke gi. bat chuoc. lam theo mot the. mac chuoc doi. bi ma qui am vao; co ta. ba muoi sau chuoc chuoc dao la hon. trong 36 chuoc, chuoc tron la hon. di dao vi thuong sach 以 逃 爲 上 䇿. chuoc hiem, muu sau. muu ke hiem sau.

cai duoi, cai chot, cai tay cam. chuoi cay. cay cong noi theo bap cay, de lam tay cam ma khien cai cay. chuoi tranh. hieu chung la cai cay: chuoi la tay cam, tranh la khuc cay co ve, lai co mot dau nhon ma giat luoi cay.

thu cay suon, minh nuoc, nho be up lai nhieu lop lam ra mot cai cot, moi chot be co tau dai, la dong 2 ben. cay chuoi. cay minh nuoc ay. chuoi cay. chinh minh cay chuoi. la chuoi. la dong hai ben tau chuoi. be chuoi. nhung vo dai dong nhieu lop lam ra cay chuoi. tau chuoi. cai tay cay chuoi, hieu tu chot be cho toi ngoai beo. buong chuoi. cai cuong chuoi trai no dong xay quanh, phan ra nhieu nai. quay chuoi. id. nai chuoi. mot lien trai chuoi dong theo nhau. dot chuoi. cuon la chuoi moi tro. bap chuoi. bup trai chuoi moi tuong. dau bap chuoi. chung dau sung bap tay giong nhu cai bap chuoi. day chuoi. day lam bang be chuoi, tay chuoi. chi chuoi. chi thua lay trong be chuoi. mem nhu chuoi. bo mem mong, khien the gi cung duoc. dan mem nhu chuoi. chuoi cau. thu chuoi nho trai mong vo ma thom , ai nay deu chuong, chinh la vat dung ma di le. chuoi com. thu chuoi day vo lon trai hon chuoi cau, ma nhao thit. chuoi la trang. thu chuoi thuong, den khi chin lai trang vo. chuoi la den. thu chuoi thuong, den khi chin lai den vo, do thit. chuoi vong. thu chuoi lon cay, chinh la tho san ba-ria, trai no vuong vuong. nau chin lai ngot hon. chuoi hot. thu chuoi lon cay xanh be, la no thuong dung ma goi banh, trai no day nhung hot, hay dung song, it an chin. chuoi chat. cung la chuoi hot, trai no con song co vi chat nhieu, hay dung ma lam goi. chuoi va huong. thu chuoi lon cay, dai trai, chin roi vo cung con xanh, ma thom cung bo thit. chuoi nga. thu chuoi thap cay lon trai ma dai, giong cai nga voi. chuoi tieu. thu chuoi nho cay nho trai ma dai, mau tieu, khong doc, ke co binh nen an. chuoi va lun. thu chuoi thap cay qua, trai dai lon ma co mui chua. chuoi nanh heo. thu chuoi cay vua, trai nhon giong cai nanh heo, cung la chuoi thom ngon. chuoi sen. cung la mot loai voi nanh heo, nai no dom giong cai la sen. chuoi nuoc. thu chuoi hay moc duoi nuoc. chuoi non nuoc. cung la mot thu chuoi lon trai ma it ngon. chuoi su hoac chuoi xiem. thu chuoi lon trai ngot man, nguyen la tho san nuoc xiem, thuo moi co, ai nay deu lay lam qui. chuoi mat. thu chuoi lon trai, den khi chin lai nhao thit, nguoi ta hay dung ma gay giam. chuoi lua. thu chuoi trai vua, den khi chin vo no lai do nhu mau lua. an chuoi khong biet lot vo. que mua, dai dot, khong biet deu, (tieng noi choi). chuoi dut mieng voi. voi hay an chuoi, dut bao nhieu cung het. chang biet phai cho an toi chung nao. chuoi non. trai chuoi con song, chua toi ky gia. chuoi dong voc. trai chuoi moi day no ma chua gia.

day dai, duoi dua, dua day. dam chuoi. dam ngay, xo ngay theo. xo chuoi. id. chay chuoi. chay xuoi, chay mot be. day ghe chay chuoi. chuoi theo. dua theo, day theo. chuoi vao. xo vao, day vao. noi ve cay cot day vao trai. tron chuoi. tron lam, co the dua day dai. cay thoa mo tron chuoi. nam chuoi. nam dai, nam duoi. chuoi ra ma nam va. com chuoi. thu com lam don nhu com giep.

hot xo xau de ma deo tay hoac deo co. day xo tien. chuoi hot. cung la hot chuoi xo xau. vong vang chuoi hot. chuoi vang. chuoi hot vang. chuoi ho. chuoi hot ho phach. chuoi tay. chuoi hot deo tay. chuoi co. chuoi hot deo co. chuoi lac. day danh bang lac de ma xo tien. chuoi tien. day xo tien; tien da xo vao day. mot chuoi. mot quan. nua chuoi. nam tien. chuyen chuoi. dung chi bang thep giun noi cung tra hot vao, nhu chuoi lan hot. that co chuoi. bon sen. chuoi hot bo de. chuoi hot lon thay chua hay dung. chuoi sau. nhung doan tham sau noi theo nhau nhu chuoi.

noi deu xuc pham, dung loi tho tuc ma lam nhuc nang. chuoi boi. id. chuoi rua. da chuoi ma lai tru eo. chuoi mang. noi loi xuc pham. chuoi cha mang me. chuoi lon. chuoi tra cho nhau. chuoi the. noi loi tho tuc ma the. ngoay tai ma nghe chuoi. tieng noi lay, rang tai minh lam quay, nguoi khac moi chuoi. chuoi nhu tach nua. gia mieng chuoi. chuoi nhu go thoi. id.
nhanh nhoc, cha boi. cha chuom. id. co cha co chuom. nhanh nhoc be bon, lom chom. tha chuom. tha cha ma nhu ca.
(chum). mot minh it dung. chuom chim. chum chim, min cuoi.

con chuon chuon. loai trung dau duoi giong cai dinh ma hay bay; he no bay nhieu la dau troi muon mua. chuon chuon lay nuoc. no hay bay sat nuoc cung lay cai duoi ma vay nuoc len, cho nen goi la lay nuoc. ca chuon. loai ca bien hay bay sa sa tren mat nuoc. canh chuon hoac kien chuon. than phan yeu duoi. nghi minh phan mong kien chuon.

do duc bang dong giong nhu cai chup de ma lam hieu linh; bon phia vuong vuc bang nhau. chuong vang. chuong duc bang vang. duc chuong. nau dong thau ma do cho ra cai chuong. rung chuong. khua dong hay la luc lac cho chuong keu. (thuong noi ve chuong nho). tieng nhu tieng chuong. tieng thanh the, tieng rat tot. danh tieng lon. dong chuong. dung chay ma thich vao nuom chuong, cung la cach danh chuong. danh trong dong chuong. kieng ne vi so dong lay, doi voi cau but may dong rung. chuong chang danh chang keu. viec co do dang, nguoi ta moi biet, doi voi cau den khong kheu khong sang. chuong chan, (tieng doi). vuong tuong. chuong bien sac canh. ca bien canh deu vuong tuong sac sao. (thuong noi ve do moc). do chuong. do lay be vuong vuc. chuong nhieu. mot thuoc nhieu do vuong. mot chuong. mot kho vuong vuc, (nhieu).

lay lam qui, lay lam trong. kinh chuong. kinh trong. yeu chuong. yeu dau. chuong dung. yeu dung, trong dung. chuong cau. lay lam qui, cau cho duoc. chuong dao. men dao, mo dao, trong dao. chuong be dao duc. trong be dao duc, lay dao duc lam hon. chuong nguoi hon chuong cua. trong nguoi hon cua; khong lay cua lam hon nguoi.

cho cam nhot thu vat. chuong trai. id. (tieng doi). chuong trau. cho lam ra de nhot trau. chuong bo. cho nhot bo. chuong ga. cho nhot ga. chuong heo. cho nuoi heo. chuong bo cau. long nuoi bo cau. chuong cu. chang ngan vuong vuc tren cot co, cot tau co the dung ngoi de ma coi chung nhu cai thang trong. ga vao chuong. troi khien toi, chung gan toi. chuong ngua. tau ngua. cam chuong. nhot lai. tha chuong. tha ra.

mot doan, mot bai; sang lang, ro rang. van chuong. bai vo dat theo phep hay; nguoi hay chu. tu chuong. nghe lam van. lap loi noi theo dieu van chuong. ban cuu chuong. (coi chu ban). nguoi van chuong. nguoi hoc hanh gioi, lam van hay. hoc tu chuong. hoc nghe lam van, lam giay theo viec quan. chuong sach. mot doan sach, mot bai sach. chuong cu. cau sach, bai tho. mot chuong. mot bai. giai chuong. bai hay, tho hay. binh chuong. tuoc quan te tuong. dong binh chuong. te tuong thu hai. chuong pho. ao chau.
sinh len. com chuong. com gao nau xau lua, noi len ma khong chin. sinh chuong. sinh noi len. (noi ve thay ma, thay thu vat).
sinh day len. sinh chuong. day len, noi len. binh chuong. id. chuong bung. sinh bung, to bung.

khi doc; ngang nguoc, trai thoi. lam chuong. khi doc o tren non nui. son lam chuong khi. khi doc dia. id. chuong khi. id. nguoc chuong. mac binh ret vi khi doc; ngang doc, nghich doi. ky chuong. ngang nguoc, di ky. ngang chuong. id. ngang nguoc, khac thoi, la doi. chuong qua. ngang qua, di ky qua, cung la tieng lay lam la. gio chuong. gio thoi canh dong bac. noi chuong. noi ngang, noi tuc. choc chuong. choc gan, choc gian. hoi chuong. hoi phi ly, hoi tuc, hoi ky cuc. choi chuong. choi ky cuc, khuay choi tuc minh.

trinh, ra mat. chuong thua. trinh thua. chuong mat. trinh dien. di thua ve chuong. di thua cho biet, ve trinh cho hay, ay la xuat tat cao phan tat dien. 出 必 告 反 必 面 chuong thay. trinh thay, thua voi thay. chuong ong. trinh ong, thua cung ong. chang chuong. to ro, to lo, trong trai.

cam giu, sua tri. ban tay; tuoc quan lon hay mot xu. ong chuong. tuoc quan lon hay mot phuong. lam nhu ong chuong thi la lam the dien quan lon. chuong co. chuc quan vo hay mot co binh. chuong ve. id. chuong thuy. chuc quan hay binh thuy. chuong dinh. chuc quan hay mot dinh binh. chuong ly. chuc doc lanh cuoc gi, so nao. minh nhu chi chuong. ro rang, minh bach. di nhu phan chuong. de nhu tro tay, de ot, de nhu choi.

bao got cho tron. chuot cay. bao danh cho cay tron. chuot chi. cao vo cay ma lay chi, nhu chi thom , chi chuoi. chuot dua. vot tre hoac vot cay gi lam dua. trau chuot. trau gioi. chuot ngot. noi loi khuyen diem, noi cho qui. bao chuot. id. chuot gia. noi cho qui gia.

loai thu nho con hay khuay, hay gam. chuot bo. id. tieng doi. chuot cong. chuot lon, chuot so. chuot lac. chuot nho lam. chuot xu. chuot nhieu long. chuot dong. chuot ruong, nguoi ta hay an thit. chuot xa. chuot hoi. chuot ca xoc. loai chuot lon con, hay dao hang. mang dua lac xac thay lay, noi la ca-xoc. lam bo chuot. ly lac, vuc vac, lien xao khong nen net. lam mat chuot. lam mat vuc vac. chim chuot. tieng noi cho dua hay lao xuoc, hay kiem chuyen lam cho sinh su bat hoa. duoi chuot. re cai hay moc cham xuong dat, cung co nghia la duoi nho, chop nho. dut duoi chuot. dut re cham ay. quan thoc chuot. tieng mang nguoi hay sanh su, hay chi choc viec vo can. rang chuot. rang nho ma nhon. chuot gam. chuot can khuoi, can lan. chuot cap. chuot lay rang ma nao. chuot khoet. chuot can lung, khoet lo. dua chuot. loai dua an song; nho trai goi la dua chuot, lon trai goi la dua leo. ot cut chuot. ot nho trai giong hinh cut chuot; thu ot rat cay. cay duoi chuot. loai cay nen thuoc, nguoi ta lay re no ma tri chung phong bai.

nhay xong ma bat, hai tay dua toi ma nhan xuong. cop chup. cop nhay xong toi ma chup. cho chup. cho nhay xong toi ma can. chup ech. bat ech, cung la dua hai tay toi ma chan con ech. cai chup. do bat ca giong hinh tam bung, nuoc lon treo len, nuoc rong ha xuong ma chan ca; do day. chup day. trum lai, day lai. chup nom. dung nom ma chup ma chan con ca. troi giong nhu cai chup. hinh troi khum khum. lup chup. lat bat; lat dat, khong ky cang. lup - da den thang lam lup chup thi la lam voi va.

it lam; chau bon doi. chut dinh. mot phan nho mon. chut xiu. mot thi, mot giay, mot nhay mat. doi chuc xiu. mot chut. mot phan, mot it. chut loi. mot loi noi, mot tieng noi. chut chot. noi da dot (nhu con nit). chut hoi. mot phan hoi; hoi tho phuong phat. con mot chuc hoi. mot chut nua. mot lat nua. chut chit. con chut chit, do con nit choi. (coi chu chit). chut cong. cong nho mon (thuong la tieng noi khiem). chut viec. viec nho mon. chang chut chi. chang mang chi. bieu chut. noi voi mot loi. lai cho tao bieu mot chut. di chut. di mot lat; tieng sai bieu di dau, trong mot giay mot lat. chut ga. keu ga. cham chut. moi dung toi, moi thu.
vung nho o dua ganh co the cho ghe thuyen nup gio. dua chut. dua ghe theo chut. chut nhachuttrang. cho nup gio o tai nha-trang ve tinh khanh-hoa. hon cai chut hoac hon chut chut. tieng hon hit manh.

co lai, rut lai, cong queo, uon cong. quanh co. cong vong, uon khuc. dang quanh co. co quap. bo cong vong, rut lai. co co. rut co lai, ngay co khong dang; cung co. co tay hoac cua tay. vong tay chiu phep, lam khong dang nua. tay co. uon vong tay ma chiu lay do nang. nhu chang co vung tay co, muoi phan cung dap diem cho mot vai. co cu. cu mau, co mau, thay kien. co mau. id. co cuong. hay chong ly su, hay cai di cai lai, cung coi. co ro. (com rom). bo rut lai, bo com rom, bo tien tan. co chon. het the di dung. thut chon lai. co gio. co xep cai gio.

ca qua ca lai, tuong cham; cau dap ta dau de ma viet van; do duong bang nang giong nhu cai xieng. co nhau. ca lay nhau, dung lay nhau. cay co. viet dap bang tre, do con nit tap viet van. dap co. dung tre nhanh chat doan, dap cho to dau ma lam ra cay viet. viet co. viet bang doan tre dap ay; moi tap viet. co co. bo co co run vai, vi ganh do nang; bo ran suc chiu viec nang ne. cai co. do duong bang tre, may de dung do di dang. co ke. dua dam, co nghia dinh ben it nhieu. nghe no co co ke… co via. dua ke, da dong, nhu dua dui, dua ve nhau, lan la cung nhau… chang trung cung co bia. trom trem; chang xa su that.

san danh, hien tai, lam chu, doi voi tieng khong. giau co. day du, san sang. nha co an. nha kha giau. it co. hiem hoi khong may khi co. hiem co. id. cau co. kho bieu, cau rau. co chang hon khong. it nhieu, xau tot ma co thi chang hon la khong ngay. co than co kho. co minh ra thi phai chiu cuc; o doi phai chiu cuc. co kho moi co nen. muon cho nen nguoi thi phai chiu kho. co tai. san tai rieng. co tri. duoc tri rieng. co chi. doc lam cho duoc viec; y huong mot be; san long. co hoc. von da hoc biet. co cot. co goc: co goc hoc hanh; co nguoi cam cot. co duc. o nhon duc, khong hay lam hai. co phuoc. huong phuoc, nho phuoc, may man. co nghe. chuyen mot nghe rieng; san biet nghe vo. co cong. da lam nen cong, hay chiu kho, dung cong nhieu. co tien. giau, khong ngheo. co cua. id. co the. dac the, huu the, co cho nuong dua. co lung. co nguoi che cho, co cho cay dua, co nguoi lam xuong song. co suc. manh me, giau co. co oai. hay lam cho ke khac kinh so. co an. hay lam an. co tuoi. gia, lon tuoi. co viec. mac viec. co cong chuyen lam hoai. co cha co me co hon, khong cha khong me nhu don dut day . con mo coi thuong phai chiu cuc. co com an, co cong viec lam. ay la an com chua, mua toi ngay; phai lam cho dang hot com. co vay co tra. co lam no thi phai tra no; du co du tra. co gian co ngoan. co qui quai moi lam nen viec gian; lam duoc viec gian thi phai co qui quai. co an co chiu. cam long vi viec minh lam; so e co khi khong an ma co chiu. co troi. tieng the, keu troi lam chung. co nguoi khuat mat. tieng the, keu nguoi da chet hoac keu qui than lam chung. co nuoc dong nuoc song moi nhay. phai nuong the nhau moi duoc day du. co cay day moi leo. tai viec nay moi sinh ra viec khac. co thanh co suy. co luc thanh co hoi suy, het hoi xau toi hoi tot, chang phai son long. co tien tien hay mua. co tien lam viec chi cung dang. co than phai lap than. ay la dau ai chi nay; moi nguoi phai lo lam cho nen than phan. co phuoc co phan. so co phuoc lam sao cung gap phan phuoc. co con nho con, co cua nho cua. ay la phan nho cho moi mot nguoi. co thanh thien bach nhut. tieng the, chi co troi xanh, mat troi sang to long minh. co ngon den lam chung. tieng the rang minh lam quay noi quay thi tat theo ngon den, cung co nghia la co ngon den soi long minh. co cot co vac. da ganh lay viec thi phai lam luon; lam on phai cho trot. co sanh co tu. co song co thac, ay la dang di cho moi mot nguoi. cay co coi, nuoc co nguon. co ong ba cha me moi co minh, con nguoi khong nen vong bon. co tai co tat. lay theo thuong su: nguoi co tai lam sao cung co tat, la tat ben tanh net, ay la ngoc lanh co vit. khong sanh co duong dao dong. cong nuoi cung bang cong de; nghia lam con phai nghi cong on, tho cha nuoi cung bang cha de. co vinh co nhuc. thuong noi ve cuoc lam quan hay treo len sup xuong, sang chung nao nhuc chung ay; khen lam at co che lam. co quien co duyen. duoc the quyen qui thi nhieu nguoi yeu chuong, nhieu nguoi ua. (thuong noi ve ke lam quan dat vo). co dau co duoi. co truoc co sau, du goc tich; dau co duoi phai co. co truoc co sau. co thu lop, du dau duoi; truoc co, sau phai co. co ly. nghe duoc, hieu duoc, dac ly. co an. da pham phep hoac mac lay toi gi hoac da bi thua kien. co ti. da bi viec gi, mac lay vit gi. co nhap. khong sach se, da bi quo phat vi viec gi, da mang lay tieng xau. co toi. pham luat phep, pham cang thuong dang cho nguoi ta lam toi. don ba lam minh cung xung la co toi. co loi. lam viec gi; lam khong nham phep. co chop. chop la co dau muon gay, chi nghia la da mac lay su gi nguy hiem cho nen con phai so hoai hoai. co vit. co ti tich, hoac co dau khong tot, hoac ve ben tanh net, hoac ve than the. co tich. co chuyen cu, co su co, co dau tich, khong phai la chuyen dat de. co tich moi dich ra tuong. co sach. chuyen ro rang, khong phai dat bay; chuyen thiet de lai. co huong. xuoi theo diem du, hay xuoi theo chuyen hung du. dung noi chet dich ma co huong. co noi. noi theo chuyen du, noi theo kiep du (di doan). cha chet troi, con cung chet troi. ay goi la noi. co noi chet chem v. v. (cat nghia la co noi cung thong). co long. that long. co tinh. that tinh, biet thuong nhau ma giup cho nhau; co y rieng; dua co tinh rinh dua co y. co y. hay xem xet, nghi suy. co chuyen. co viec, co cong viec. co loi. nham loi, nham viec, nham nghia ly, doi voi tieng vo loi, chi nghia la khong an thua vao dau. co phep. da co luat phep, lam theo luat phep, cung la tieng khen nguoi o khuon phep, biet le phep. co bo. co cach phet, co bo tich de coi. co danh. co tieng don, tieng khen. co tieng. nguoi ta da nghe tieng, biet tieng, (chang ky tot xau). co an co hau. an o trung hau. co hieu co nghia. an o thao thuan, ngay lanh. co net. hay giu net hanh, nghiem tranh. co hanh. id.

su co; cu cang; quen thuoc; chet. co cuu. nguoi cu, nguoi quen thuoc. co tri. da biet nhau truoc, ban cu, ban tri am. tha huong ngo co tri: 他 鄉 遇 故 知 toi dat la gap ban cu, ay la mot cuoc vui mung. co giao. ban cu, nghia cu. co huong. to quan, xu so minh. co ly. xu so minh sanh de. id. co tri. nghe cu, muu chuoc rieng, tri rieng. co nhon. nguoi quen thuoc, ban cu. on co. hoc don bai vo cu. on co nhi tri tan: 温 故 而 知 新 hoc don bai da hoc cho nho lai nhu moi. duyen co. duyen do su co. su-. id. ong co. ong cha me minh. ba co. ba cha me minh. da co. nhieu chuyen. dai moc luu giang bat dat hoi co. cay ca troi song chang ve chon cu; su the luu lac khong trong tro ve. the co. chuyen doi, su doi. nhon tinh the co. 人 情 世 故 long nguoi cung su doi bien sinh nhieu the. cung la tieng than. di co. chet roi. binh co. mac binh ma chet. co mang hoac mang co. chet.

nghia muon la co the, keu xin khong thau. lanh co. on quach, so phai chet chem. nghe noi bat lanh co. thuong co. doi xua kia, lau doi lam. thai co. id. huong co. chuc lon trong lang. chung co. tron doi. du uon chung co, 餘 殃 終 古: de hai doi doi. co lai. xua nay: xua qua nay lai. co kim hoac kim co. xua nay, tu xua nhan nay; lau doi. kim co ki quan. hieu sach noi ve su tich la xua. thien co. ngan thuo, cung chi la bac tot. giau thien co, thi la giau lam, giau trong doi. ki co. di ki, la doi. co kinh. sanh soi, cung cat theo dieu xua, (van chuong). co dong. do duc bang dong xua. lu co dong thi la lu xua. tuc lai hieu chu dong la lam cao, gia nhu noi co dong thi chi nghia la noi dong, noi lon loi, noi cho keu. co van. van chuong doi xua. co thi. thi phu doi xua. co tich. su tich xua, su tich cu. co ngu. loi ngan ngu xua. treo co. treo trac cai co, xay tro khong dang. moi co. moi co trong doi; doi cho lau lac. mac co. mac xuong hoac mac do an can co. ham an mac co. co nhon. nguoi doi xua. cuoc choi nhac tich nguoi doi xua, cung muon hinh 36 con thu. co le. le phep xua. co tuc. thoi xua. co phong. thoi xua, phong tuc tot. con co co phong. co tu. chu xua. tung co. doi theo phep cu, nguoi xua. nhon tam bat co. long nguoi chang giong nhu xua, nghia la da hoa xau xa. trung co. chung bay su tich cu; tuc noi lac la chung co. co rua. co van qua. co lai. co dai ma nho. co ro. co lon qua. co trau. nuoc cot trau gio ra. do nhu co trau, thi la do bam. co dien. ten xu thuoc tinh van-nam. non co dien, thi la non thung. tap co. noi theo xua, an cap chuyen cu. trau day co. trau map beo, co no to. thuong noi ve trau duc, khi ay no boi suc, manh bao bang hai. co khoang co. giong co co vanh trang noi co. co do. do ve xua, kieu ve xua. co do bat buu. dia co do. co lich. ten khuc song o tai vinh-long; he khuc song nao giong co con lich cung deu goi mot the. bung co. van uon theo khuon cua, o phia tren. khoet co ao. khoet nua vong tron, hoac khoet tron nhu cai co ao. co hu. bap cay dua, cay cau, chinh tai cho no tro buong. map co hu: co hu no lon. co bong. do dung eo co, giong cai bong. mam co bong. co ve. khuc tron o duoi bap ve, dua dau goi. co tay. khuc tron o ngoai bap tay. co cuom. cung la khuc tron ay, chinh cho deo vong, deo cuom. co chon. khuc tron o duoi bap chon, cuom chon. co song. chinh cho trong quai cheo, (noi ve cay cheo).

do don dai, do an. do dung ma sap don do an, nhu mam ban; tieng keu xe co. co ban. id. don co. don dai lon, dai tiec. dai co. id. ngoi co. an do don dai. an co. id. co xoi. mam xoi. co banh. mam don cac thu banh; don dai bang banh. co mut. don dai bang mut; do don an bang mut. thuong co. thuong tien don co. phep cuoi vo lay chong, nguoi ta thuong dai co, an uong roi ho trai hoac ho gai muon cho lich su phai dem 5, 10 dong bac ma thuong. co trau. mot doi trau xe. co xe. cai xe.

co su. co su hoac su co. id. vo co. khi khong, khong co le su gi. co chi hoac co gi. le gi, le su gi. co nao. do nao. co sao. id. co ay. le ay, boi viec ay. lam co. bay deu, lam guong truoc. tim co. tim cach the, tim viec. co co. co tich co, co moi mang, co ly su. nhieu co. nhieu le. duyen co. su co, duyen do.

con coc; biet. coc nhai. con coc, con nhai. noi chung ve mot loai con trung. ran rit bo vao, coc nhai bo ra: the khong chung lon duoc; manh yeu phai xa nhau. coc kho. khong co gi, khong ra su gi. (tieng noi khinh bac cung la tieng noi choi: co coc kho! lam coc kho! coc rac. id. no co coc rac gi, chi nghia la no khong co chi het. cay coc. ten cay, vo no giong nhu da coc. day coc. day san co rut lai. mot thu day hay moc bo song, co ke lay la no ma lam thuoc ret, vo lay nuoc bo muoi ma uong chan cu. coc ken. loai day coc. day no hay danh xa leo, lay do ma dat ten. mut coc. mut chai hay moc ngoai da tay, da chon, chun no co soi van van nhu soi vai. ghe coc. mot thu ghe co mun nam den nhu da con coc. bao coc. bao xoi nho. tay coc. tay da nho ma ngon lai van. tay do. bung coc. bung lon ma minh om; bung oc noc. hinh nhu con coc. ngo thay nhung bung, bo do day. chay loc coc. chay lom xom nhu coc nhay: loc coc chay theo. coc di guoc. an ban khong xung. bo lung cung kho coi. doi voi khi deo hoa. voi bo coc. thu voi nho con. chang coc. chang hay biet. chang biet coc gi. chang biet gi. coc. hay, biet. — vui dao thanh, su doi chua le. coc nghien rang. coc mai rang. tuc hieu: no co khua mai rang thi co troi mua. gan coc mat cong. giong doc, thuoc doc. phinh bung coc. ran suc ma chiu. ram thang bay coc nhay lom xom. ram thang bay nuoc lon, coc thay nuoc thi nhay mang. tho coc. tho nhu coc. bo met nhoc, tho nhat hoi. bat coc bo vao dia. de bat nhu choi, muon bat chung nao cung dang. thuong hieu ve nguoi de bat ma cung de tron. bat nhu bat coc.

(tieng ke chung cac loai trai trang). coc dao. hau mon, dang di dai. coc khi. com gao, do an vao bung, hay lam cho co khi luc. coc vu. tiet coc vu; tiet mua mua nham ngay 22 avril. (coi chu tiet).
tho tuc, kich, nong nay, cuc xuc. coc can. id. an noi coc can. tinh coc. id. viet coc. viet cun, viet to net. chu coc. chu bam, to net. chim thang coc. chim hay lan nuoc ma bat ca.
