doi, ca va thien ha; 30 nam; mot doi nguoi. the gian. ca va thien ha. the giai. ca va trai dat. the nhon. nguoi doi, nguoi ta. the su. viec doi. the tinh. long nguoi, chuyen doi. the thoi. id. cach thoi o doi. the phuc. phuoc loc o doi. the loc. loc doi; loc cua cha de lai cho con, noi doi an loc. the quan. noi dong lam quan. the tu. con cac chu hau. the giai moi. mot phuong lon o ben kia trai dat, moi tim duoc, hon 400 nam nay. rotthe giai. cho cung duoi dat nay. nguoi the. giay in hinh nguoi. ke the. ke cho, nguoi luat phep, khon ngoan; ke ta, khong phai la moi. sinh y nguoi the. ao ve, hinh nhon in vao giay, de dot ma cung vong hon. tren the. tren doi, trong the gian. the thuong. id. duoi the. duoi doi, cung la o doi nay. tai the. o doi, con o doi. o the. id. tien the. doi truoc, kiep truoc. hau the. doi sau, kiep sau. lai the. id. tai the. id. tan the. het doi, het thien ha, van vat tieu tan. khi the. bo doi, chet. ta the. gia doi, cung la chet. giang the. xuong the, ra doi, sinh ra trong doi. xuong the. id. anh hung cai the. anh tai hon ca thien ha; lam du mot minh. tuc trai la anh hung ke the. the thebat tuyet. doi doi khong dut. khac-la doi. di ki cuc, quai go. the dai tram anh. dai mao nhieu doi, dong doi lam quan. the gia. nha lam quan nhieu doi. tay thua the. tay khon qui trong doi.

be the khong tot. thua-. nhon khi co the, muon quyen luc ai ma lam su gi. het-. het cho cay trong. dia-. cach cuoc dat dai, dia cuoc. huuthe bat kha y. co the than, chang kha y thi. -gap. su the buc xuc, xem ra ngat ngheo. -ngat. su the buc xuc, xem ra ngat ngheo. -tien. co the lam, gap dip tien, duoc phuong tien. -thi. vay thi, the vay. -hiem. cach bay ra hiem tro, nghe ra hiem. -buc. xem ra buc ngat. -xem. xem ra cung tung, khong con cach the gi khac; chang con suc luc gi. -no gian. nghe ra no gian, coi y no gian. trong-. co khi, hoac la; lay theo cach ay; uoc chung. dinh-. dinh deo, uoc chung. phai-. nham cach, phai cach, an o lich su, tu te. thanh-. noi tieng, lam ra be the lon. do-. le su, lam mat lon, mat gioi. -nao. cach nao, the nao. -ay. the ay, cach ay. ga-. ga biet leo lac, hay nup hay dut, lua cho nhuoc ga khac ma da. sinh-. bien ra cach the gi, bay ra manh loi gi. lua-. lua dip, lua khi, lua cach gi. lan-. lan nuoc, duoc nuoc hon, chiem nuoc tren, chiem thuong phong. biet-. biet cach the, biet leo lac, biet tuy thi. cay tai cay-. cay tai tri, cay suc luc. giu-. giu lay the minh, giu leo lac, giu can than dung cho ho be gi. don cothe mong. ngheo kho khong co ba con, khong ai do vot. gia-don han. nha ngheo kho. con nguoi hu-. con nguoi hu toi the ay. den-. den the ay. mot-. mot cach nhu nhau. lam thinh lam-. lam thinh, lang lang.

minh voc, khi chat, cach the. than-. minh voc. tu-. bon voc, dau minh tay chan. su-. cach the bay ra. -thuc. cach thuc, thuc le nha nuoc truyen ra. -cach. cach the. -nao. cach nao, the nao. -ay. cach ay, the ay. nhu-. nhu la, duong nhu. gia-. gia nhu, gia su. duong-. duong bang, chang khac gi. vi-. vi nhu. khac-. chang khac gi, duong nhu. xem-. xem bang. nhon-. luon dip, nhon dip. trot-. id. lien-. id. mot-. mot cach, mot the, mot trat. nhieu-. nhieu cach thuc. -vay. cach lam nhu vay. the lay. xet lay, lam cho phu hiep. ca the. trong lam, lon lam. the thong. bo oai nghi, sang ca, gieng moi, thu lop, dieu the ca. lap the thong. lap cho co gieng moi, thu lop; lam cho co oai the, cho ra su sang giau. the ca. dieu dai cai, gom tom. the le. thuc le, dieu le. the dien. may mat, ve trang nghiem, danh gia. lam the. lam the dien, lam cach dieu, lam be the. nen the. xung dang, nen than, phai cach. dai the. dieu the ca, su the lon. oai the. co oai the, co the dien. dich the. bi voi bac tren, khong chiu thua; muon cho bang bac tren. hon bat phu the. bat tinh nhon su. tu thothe chu. sach tu tho co giai nghia. the gia tethe da. chu the ay chi nghia la bang minh vay, mot the dien nhu minh vay. vit tich gi bay ra ngoai da. co theo. co vit tich ay. theo mat. tren mat co vit tich. deo theo. danh deo, lam cho phai roi ram.
tieng tro tu. theo leo. banh trai, do an uong nuoc, (tieng trieu-chau), chinh chu la 茶 料 tra lieu. theo leo. nhay mieng, hay leo mep; chuyen nguoi nay dem hoc voi nguoi kia.

vat cat ra tu reo, tu mieng dai. cat theo. cat ra tu mieng mong ma dai; cat tu reo. mot theo. mot reo. tu theo. tu reo, tu mieng dai. theo cau. dang cau van cot theo dang cau lon. that theo. bo teo top, bo doi khat.
mot vanh, mot mep. thep lon. vanh am ho. thop thep. nhay mieng, hay noi quay.

thu cung hon sat, sat luyen; chi thau, sat; cay chuot mong dai nhu cai luoi ga, de ma dong kem theo mi van lua cheo hom ruong. keo thep. dung ban lua keo ep dong thau lam ra nhu chi soi. che thep. cap thep theo do sat nhu dao rua ma lam cho no sac. thep thau. chi keo bang thau. thep sat. chi keo bang sat. thep cong. dong thau keo ra soi lon. day thep. day thep luyen hay truyen dien khi. danh day thep. goi tin bang day thep luyen ay. tin day thep. tin goi bang day thep. thep bung. thu sat luyen deo minh, co uon no thi no day, no bung ra. gia thep. tot thep; nhieu thep thep non. thep xau; it thep. non thep. it thep, che thep khong vua. thep tre. tre che nho ma giep, thuong dung ma lam ep lep. dat thep. dat ep lep. dong thep. dong ep lep, dong thep danh mong lam nhu chay dang vien.
an thep. an nho cua ke khac. bu thep. bu nho sua ke khac. noi thep. noi nho theo, nhon nhip ma noi. hoi thep. hoi rieng ngoai.
giam mau sac gi. quang thep. son nuoc vang nuoc bac (lam cho sang). thep vang. giam nuoc vang. thep bac. giam nuoc bac. son thep. son giam nuoc ve. thep den. do dung tret tret, de do dau ma thap den.

dot nuong, luyen cho rong. mang thet. mang den, mang dua. hoi thet. hoi thuc toi, hoi riet. lam thet. lam thuc toi, lam hoi ha. thet toi. thuc toi. thang thet. mot be thang rang, miet dai. ngu thang thet. ngu miet dai; ngu da suc, da them. nguoi con thet. nguoi con ngu, (noi cho quan truong). nang thet. nang gia gian.
(det). lon thet. lon det, lon dai. thet thet. id.
(thiet). thet dai. dai dang, tiep ruoc tu te. thet khach. dai khach. son thet. son thep.

dung chi sac hoac chi vang bac ma dinh mat hang gie lam ra bong hoa. theu det. id. dat chuyen them. noi theu det. noi dat deu, noi them that. theu bong, hoa. theu giam lam ra bong hoa. theu tiu va may. cong viec gai to, cung goi la nu cong. cai theu. do dung giong luoi xuong ma lon. theu leu, meu. cheo meo, theo meo. o ngoai theu leu. o ngoai cho cheo meo, o ngoai chot. hang theu. day nha lam nghe theu thua cung la ten duong pho. gam theu. gam dung chi sac ma dinh vao, doi voi gam det. tho theu. tho lam nghe theu dinh. chi theu. chi dung ma theu.
theu thao. so luoc, khong ki cang, khong gon ; hoi hot. lam theu thao. lam khong gon, khong ki.
theu thao. roi rong, hoi hot. y theu thao. y lang lo, choi lo, khong chat chia. nguoi theu thao. nguoi roi rong qua, choi lo qua.

thay. than thi. id.cung hieu la than the. thi than. ba con voi nguoi chet, voi cai thay. tu thi. thay ke chet, thay ma. truyen thi. binh ke chet lay sang, nhut la binh lao ton. truyen thi lao trai. id.

than vi ; hinh nguoi chet, nhu hon bach. thi chu. id. than thi. nguoi song gia lam than vi, trong luc cung te. thi vi to xang. lanh chuc phan ma chang lam nen su gi, lam quan o khong ma an loc. tam thi. cung la tam banh, thuong thi, thanh-co la banh- cu.trung thi, bach-co la banh-chat, ha thi huyet co la banh- kieu.(coi chu banh).

dua tai, dua suc, thu cho biet hon thua ; chiu khao hach trong su hoc hanh cho biet ai cao ai thap. khoa thi. cuoc khao hach ve viec hoc hanh. di thi. di chiu khao hach ve viec hoc. truong thi. cho lap ra de cho hoc tro thi. de thi. de, bai thay ra cho hoc tro lam. vo thi. vo hoc tro lam. thi cu. dua tranh trong su hoc hanh. thi tai. dua tai, thu tai. thi huong. cuoc thi tai tinh thanh. thi hoi. cuoc thi chung tai kinh do, lua nhung bac dau cao. hoc tai thi phan. hoc dau co tai, ma dau rot la tai so. hoc tro thi. ke chuyen hoc cho duoc di thi. thi cai. thu cho biet ai lam cai, nghia la bat bai thu, (lam nhu bat tham). lam thi. lam thu cho biet ai hay ai do, ai mau ai cham, dua cong viec lam. chay thi. chay dua. doc thi. doc thu cho biet ai thuoc ai khong, ai mau ai cham.

dung, ra, cho ra. thi an. ra on, lam on. thi nhon. ra nhon, lam nhon. thi hanh. dung theo, lam theo, lam cho thanh viec. hang phuong thi. (coi chu phuong). tay thi. ten don ba doi xua, dung nhan dep de di thuong. vo ke kha thi. het ke khong lam chi duoc.

(tho)van tho, loi noi lam theo dieu van chuong. kinh thi hoac thi kinh. sach ke nhung loi ca vinh theo phong tuc. thi tho bat doc, tu ton ngu. (coi chu doc). thi nhon. nguoi lam van tho. thi ong. nguoi co tai trong su lam tho. thi tap. tap bien cac tho tu. co thi. tho nguoi van vat doi xua lam. thi phu. tho tu lam theo dieu van chuong. lien nhut thi nhut hoa. lien can xen, khoan de mot bai tho, khoan ve cay co bong hoa. cam ki thi hoa. don, co, tho, ve la bon nghe choi phong luu ; ai biet du bon nghe ay thi goi la phong luu tai tu.

cay, nho. tu thi. cay minh, y minh. y thi. y than, y the. huu thi vo khung. co cho nuong cay, thi khoi lo so. bang thi. don bang, giay cap cho, to giay lam chung. to thi. to giay lam chung, to trat, giay cap rieng. gia bang gia thi. gia bang cap ; gia giay lam chung ; gia don bang.

bao, rao bao. cao thi. giay rao bao. yet thi hoac at thi. giay quan dan ma rao bao. quan ra yet thi. quan day dan giay truyen rao su gi. bieu thi. loi quan truyen bao. du thi. id. chi thi. chi bao, chi bieu.

xem, thay. giam thi. xem xet, doc ap. thi su. chung su ve viec gi ; chung ve viec xu doan ; quan thi su. thi thieng. lam chung, nhan that, (to khe). thi chung. id. thap muc so thi. cho muoi con mat ngo thay ; truoc mat thien ha. moi lang thi. moi lang chung kien, (ve viec ban chac v.v.). thi to thuc, to mai. lam chung trong giay thuc, giay mai. can thi. con mat thay gan ma chang thay xa. vien thi. con mat thay xa ma chang to gan. ho thi. nhin nhau nhu cop ; kinh chong, khong nhin nhau. nhut thi dong nhon. thay xem dong mot long nhon ; noi ve vua quan dem long thuong dan, khong cho tay vi. thi thuong. xem thuong, lay lam de. thi nhau. khong ke nhau (tieng moi). truc thi. ngo ngay mot be ; con mat dung trong.con mat truc thi, thi la con mat gan chet.
chuc hau. noi thi. noi hoan, quan hoan. thi lang. tuoc quan trong sau bo, duoi bac tham tri. thi ve. ve quan hau gan hoang de. thi doc. tuoc quan han lam. thi giang. id.

cho. thanh thi. cho do hoi, dat dinh lieu ; cho thien ha o dong dao, biet phep an o khon ngoan. noi thanh thi. id. chon thi thieng. id. thi tu. cho cho bua cho o dong dao, nham phuong huong tot. chon thi tu. id. thi tinh. cho dong nguoi o, dat dinh lieu. khai thi. cho moi lap, qui ban hang nhom. tra thi. chuc viec giu gin tai cho. lay thi tao. lay tien quet cho, nghia la lay cua ban hang it nhieu cho du ma quet don tai cho. bon thi. nhung nguoi o hai ben cho, bon pho.
thu cay co trai giong nhu trai hong ma vang. cay thi. id. trai thi. id. cay tram thi. thu cay min thit ma tham den, cung ve mot mon cay rat ben.

thiet, phai, ay. qua thi. qua chac. chi thi. chin thiet, von thiet. thi phi. phai chang, phai hay la chang phai. loi thi phi. loi noi khong bang cu. dien thi boi phi. (coi chu dien). cac thi ky dao. ai ai cung lay dao minh lam phai. khau thi tam phi. mieng phai ma long chang phai, mieng noi tot, ma long khac xa ; ay cung goi la khau tam bat nhut, chi nghia la mieng noi cung long da chang in mot. di loi thi do hoac thi vu. chin co deu bat loi la lo, chi nghia la vu co mot deu loi ma thoi. ly vo nhi thi. le that khong co hai, (noi ve mot viec). quyet vo thi ly. chac khong co ly, chac khong phai nhu vay. duyet thi. ten den hat.

ho, dong ho. tanh thi. id. danh thi. ten ho. thi ria. (coi chu ria). cau thi nghe. ten cau qua lang phu-mi, o gan thanh cu gia- dinh ; lay tuoc mot ba lam nen cau ay ma dat. nguyen thi. dong vua duong tri vi. le thi. dong vua truoc nha nguyen, bi tay son cuop nuoc.
ham an, (coi chu thuy).

thu, thi, dua tranh. giam thi. quan giam khao, doc viec thi khoa. ung thi. di thi. khao thi. khao hach, hach hoi (hoc tro thi). thi sung. thu sung. liet hoa thi kim, gian nan thi duc. lua do thu vang, gian nan thu duc ; dung lua moi biet tuoi vang, co gian nan moi biet long nguoi. hoi thi. hoi thi chung, tai kinh thanh. dinh thi. thi trong den vua, giua cho nguoi ngu, (noi ve bac tan si). thi sai. sai thu, cho lam viec thu.

cho lam phuoc ; cho khong, lieu bo. bo thi. cho chac, lam phuoc cho ke ngheo. cung thi. cung dang lam phuoc. thi cho. phat cho, lieu cho. thi cong. lam viec lieu cong, khong ke cong, lam viec cong khong. thi cua. dem cua ra ma cho khong. thi thuc. cuoc bo thi chung, dem vat an ma cho nguoi ngheo kho. thi re. id. thi xac. lieu minh. danh thi xac. danh bo minh, co chet thi thoi. thi di. lieu di, bo di. thi chu. chu lam phuoc, chu bo thi. phat thi. phat hot, chat hot phia tren ma bo di. mot thi. mot giay, mot phut, mot it. hat thi. hat cho nguoi ta coi ma khong doi tien gian.
giet. soan thi. (coi chu soan). thi gai. chat tuot gai dau mua ma bo di. thi nhanh cay. chat bot nhanh cay, tia, rua nhanh cay.
(coi chu the). thi phat. cao dau, got toc, lam thay chua.
vi, sanh. thi nhu. gia nhu, gia ti. thi du. id. thi du. id. thiet thi. noi ti, noi gia the. noi thi. id. thi chang khac. vi chang khac, cung nhu. ti thi. so sanh, giong di giong lai.

(thoi)gio khac, ngay thang ; thuo, luc ; co hoi ; duong khi, khi ay, luc ay, chung ay, the ay. thien thi. thi tiet trong nam ; co khi hieu la dich khi, dong voi chu thi khi. tu thi. bon mua trong nam, la xuan, ha, thu, dong. binh tu thi. benh cam trong luc mua mang thay doi. thi su. su doi, viec doi ; viec xay ra trong mot luc. thi the. su the, cach the bay ra. thi van. van han, so van. thi tiet. mua tiet. thi khac. gio khac. thi khi. van khi theo mua tiet ; mua tiet doc dia. dac thi. duoc van lam an ; gap nhip, gap co hoi. kip thi. id. gap thi. id. phai thi. phai ngay gio, phai mua tiet, nham nhip, gap van. that thi. that van, loi thoi lam an, that co hoi. lo thi. lo van, lo co hoi. tuy thi. tuy theo van, theo buoi, theo loi. theo thi. id. do thi. do qua vay, tam vay. qua thi. id. thi van bi. thi van xau. thi suy. luc suy vi. thi co can. thoi doi kho. thi dang dung. luc tao loan, cuop giac. thi giac gia. luc giac gia. thi thanh hoac thanh thi. luc duong thanh loi, lam an duoc. thi xuan xanh. luc con tre mo, duong tuoi tre. dang thi. id. binh thi. luc binh thuong, luc vo su. tuc thi. bay gio, lap tuc, khong hoan duoc. thi sao. ay hoi co nao ; co su lam sao. thi phai. nhu vay la phai. thi thoi. nhu vay du roi, chang con lam chi nua. cho thi. vay cho. the thi. the vay, ay vay. khong thi. bang chang. thi com. dung com, an com, (tieng noi cho quan truong). thi tra, che. uong che. thi ngu. ca chay. thi may. mac may, nham luc may. rui thi. rui ro, vo phuoc, nham luc rui. het thi. het luc may, het van tot. chet thi lam mau. tieng the rang co chet cung khong nhin thua. thi troi han han. nham luc troi lam han. thi dong ken. nham luc mat an, thien ha do kho. thi ly loan. luc tao loan, that tho vong huong. thien tai nhut thi. ngan nam co mot thuo ; noi ve su gap go phi thuong. thi ho bat tai lai. tieng than co hoi qua roi chang trong tro lai. khi thi. co khi, co luc, co thuo ; khi the nay, khi the khac, khong nhut dinh : khi thi chiu, khi thi choi. phan thi. phan ben nay, phan ben kia, (tieng chi nhieu phia). noi ba thi bang mot. chuyen khong co ma noi mot hai rang co.

ten ; quyet long, the. cung thi. cung ten ; do binh khi. thi chi bat di. doc mot long, chang he doi doi. thi the. the, lap loi the. chi thi thien nhut. chi the co troi, co mat troi chung minh; the thot chac chan. thi chi tai huyen bat dac bat phat. (coi chu huyen). chon thi thach. (coi chu thach).

dau, dau het, truoc het, moi. thi chung. truoc sau, dau duoi. chung thi. id. thi mat. goc ngon. huu thi vo chung. co truoc ma khong co sau ; khong ben do. thi chung nhu nhut. truoc sau nhu mot. thanh thi thanh chung. truoc sau tron ven. vo thi vo chung. doi doi hang co, (duc-chua-troi). dau thi nghi. dau het. ong thi to. ong to dau het. tac su tat muu thi. lam viec phai tinh truoc ; co tinh truoc moi lam nen viec. so thi. hoi ban dau. ki thi. nguyen truoc het. vi thi. lam dau het. vi thi. chua he.
tieng tro tu. tham thi. noi lam tham, noi trong mieng. than thi. hoac than -.nan ni, than van. than than thi thi. nan ni, y oi. thu thi. nan ni nho tieng, keu nho tieng.
da ca thia thia. cho ca thia thia da lon voi nhau, cung la cuoc choi an tien. cai thia. ten rach o ve tinh dinh-tuong.
the thia. tieng ban hang gap moi hang, gap may, lay lam mang ma la len ; cung nhu noi rang gap via vang tot.
tieng di dong duoi dat. thich thich. tieng di dong giap. di thich thich. di dong keu ra tieng giap.

ua, vua, xay, qua. thich y. vua y, ung bung. mac thich. mac y muon. thich dep. ua muon. ua thich. id. so thich. cho minh hao, lay lam ua. thich tung. di theo, theo. thich trung. vua chung, khong lon nho. thich trung. xay nham, may ma nham. tha thich vi phi. qua dang khac ma lam deu chang phai, thuong noi ve su xin giay di lam an, lai di lam quay. nhon sinh qui thich chi. con nguoi sinh ra, gap go nhu y minh thi la qui, au la phai duoc nhu y minh.

buon, ba con khac ho. than thich. ba con. thich ly. xom ba con, chi noi ve nhung nguoi ba con cung hoang de. thich thuoc. trong vong ba con. quyen thich. ba con, than thiet. moc thich. moc meo qua. uu thich. lo buon. tu di y thich. chac lay su tham cho minh. tu minh de deu buon tham. huu thich tuong quan. chung cung trong cuoc buon vui. du dong huu thich. id.
thich lich. sam set. thich lich thach. da tam set.

mo ra, giai nghia ; ten ho. dao thich. dao phat. thich giao. id. thich gia. ten ho phat. thich ca. id. thich thi. id. thich nghia. giai nghia, cat nghia. thich phuc. thoi ban do tang. phong thich. tha ra (toi nhon). khai thich. cho khoi toi, tha ve.

cham chich, dam, khac. phung thich. dung loi cham chich ma can gian. thich sat. dam giet, giet di. thich huyet. chich, cat ma lay mau, (lam viec the nguyen). thich tu. khac chu, ay la hinh si nhuc, hoac khac tren mat, khac tren kien tay nhieu the. toa tac kich thich. ngoi xuong, dung day, danh, dam, (phep danh giac). thich khach. gia khach, hoac gia dang ma di dam giet ai. quan thich khach. gia khach, hoac gia dang ma di dam giet ai. hanh thich. lam viec dam giet len ay. dau thich. goi thiep, goi giay de ten ho ma xin ra mat. thich mot cai. dam mot cai, dam mot cai.

loai kim trang, nhe minh, de duc. thiec la. thiec da danh ra la. thiec cao-bang. thiec tinh cao-bang o bac-ki, la mot thu tot. thiec phan. phan thiec, thuoc xuc tac, rat manh. giao thiec. thiec xu malacca. do thiec. do dung duc bang thiec. binh thiec. binh bang thiec. hop thiec. hop bang thiec. tho thiec. tho duc thiec. hu thiec. hu dung ma dat ruou, co eo hong lon.
them. thiem dinh. de con trai. thu thiem. ten cho o cach song saigon, doi voi saigon, nguyen thuo xua o do co mot phan thu keu ten ay ; (hoac la ten nguoi lap phan thu).
coc. thiem thu. id. nguyet ly thiem thu. hinh con coc o trong mat trang. thiem to. mu co con coc, vi thuoc tri ung doc.

doc hiem, khong chiu lam on cho ai, khong biet thuong ai. nguoi thiem. id. lam thiem. lam hiem, an o gat gong. thiem thuoc. doc hiem, bat nhon. thiem doc. id. thiem ac. id. thiem qua. doc hiem thoi qua ; it qua.
huoc, tieng xung minh. thiem chuc. chuc mon, chuc hen (tieng minh ha minh, khong dam xung la chuc lon).

troi, phep troi, coi troi, quien tao hoa, phep an bai ; le tu nhien ; ngay. thien thuong. tren troi. thuong thien. troi xanh. huyen thien. troi tham. man thien. troi che cho. hieu thien. troi cao. thien mon. cua troi.(coi chu moc). thien y. tuoc ba chua-ngoc. -su. su troi ; su hoang de trung-quoc. thien ha. duoi troi, ca va the gian : chinh nghia la ca nhon dan trong nuoc tau. thien van. phep coi do so cac vi tinh tu tren troi. thien van sanh. nguoi chuyen hoc phep ay. thien tuong. cac vi tinh tu tren troi. tuoc troi cho, loc troi nuoi, tuoc loc tu nhien. thien sinh nhon, ha nhon vo loc?. thien tam. long troi, y tao hoa. thien y. id. thien tu. tu chat sang lang tu nhien. thien dinh. muc chinh giua troi, ngay dau minh ; muc thien trung. thien binh. can thang bang. kim thien. ngay nay. minh thien. ngay mai. nhi thien. hai ngay ; troi thu hai. cuu thien. chin tang troi, chin troi.(coi chu tieu). thien quan. chu te tren troi, ong troi ; tuoc trung te, tuoc quan lai bo. thien nan. song giang ha, ngan ha. thien ha. id. thien truc. ten nuoc, chinh cho phat sinh ra. tay thien. id. thien tu. hoang de. thien trieu. trieu hoang de ben trung-quoc. thien nhan. mat mui hoang de ; hoang de. kinh thien dien. den tho troi. thien dia tuy dai, nhon do huu so ham. (coi chu ham). hon thien nghi. (coi chu hon). thien uyen. troi cao, vuc tham, chi nghia la xa cach muon phan. uyen thien. nhieu lam, vo so. thien xich. phep lay do tren troi ma biet dang di duoi bien. thien do. do so nguoi ta bay ra ma toan viec tren troi, dang cac tinht u chay. thien huu bat trac chi phong van, nhon huu dan tich chi hoa phuc. troi mua gio khong chung, hoa phuc nguoi doi cung khong chung ; som may chieu rui chang ai biet duoc. thien du nhon qui. troi cho, nguoi ve, noi ve dang lam vua chua phai co long troi cung nho long dan tung phuc. dan di thuc vi thien. dan lay an lam bon mang, lam truoc ; lam sao cung phai nuoi dan, (vua chua). thien bat qua mang mang nhut thai hu. troi ay la khi khong khong ma cho. thien oai. oai troi, oai sam set. thien phao. chung duong moi, nang qua, an cho toi tren dau. thien hoa. trai giong, dau. thien mu. ten chua lon o phu thua-thien. thien linh cai. so con gai dong trinh, co ke noi luyen so ay thi la de ma lam cho ke chet roi hoa ra nhu song thiet.so ke chet. thien van. van tuan huon, cuoc troi dat xay van ; sach tinh ly noi 360 nam la mot van. can dia vien thien. gan dat xa troi, gia ca gan mieng lo. thien tru dia luc. troi giet dat hai, (tieng tru, tieng chuc du). thien ly su nhien. le troi khien nhu vay. lao thien lao dia. noi lao qua, lao khong sach vo. thien truong dia cuu. troi dai dat lau, (tieng chuc cho nhau suc khoe lau dai cho duoc thay nhau). thien tinh. gieng troi, cho chua trong giua nha chu mon, san giua nha chu mon. thien thi, thanh. bong thanh thi chieu tren khong. xuanthien thao. co dau mua xuan. thu thien. mua thu. thien quang. ngay sang. thien luan. dao can thuong. cuu thien huyen nu. ba chua-tien. thien tien. cac vi tien tren troi, doi voi dia tien la tien phai doa. thien ngoai thien. canh nhan lac o ngoai troi. thuathien. phu lon o tai kinh do nuoc annam. thien truong. ten phu o tai tinh nam-dinh. dinh thien man dia. day day, vo so. thien dieu. chung phong nang lam cho con nit nay ngua ma ngo len troi, nghia la troi cau.
mot chuong sach, mot doan sach, mot bai sach. thien sach. id. truong thien. mot bai tho, bai sach dai.

mech. thien tay. bat cong, hay tay vi. thien ta. vay vo, khong ngay thang, (nguoi). tinh thien. tinh khong ngay thang, hay co chap, hay nghe bay. thien thinh. hay nghe mot ben, khong xet le cong. kiem thinh tac minh, thien thinh tac am . gom nghe thi sang, rieng nghe thi toi. nghe nhieu nguoi thi ro, nghe mot nguoi thi khon thong. con mat ban thien meo dau. con mat le xien xeo, ( thi long cing xien xeo).

doi, doi. thien ti. doi dem di cho khac, cung nhu day, (an thien ti). cai ac thien thien. cai du ve lanh. thien di cho khac. doi di cho khac. thien nham. di nham cho khac, doi di lam quan cho khac. thien khai. khi ay, thuo ay, (it dung). bien thien. doi doi. bat thien no, bat nhi qua. chang gian lay, chang loi hai lan, (nhan-hoi). rach thien. ten rach o ve hat quang-hoa.

gan, muoi tram. mot thien. mot ngan. thien thien van van. vo so. tam thien. ba ngan.lay tam thien thi la lay nhieu qua. thien ly. ngan dam. thien son van thuy. dang non song xa cach ngan trung. thien khe. thuong hieu la nhieu lam. tam thien the gioi. ba ngan the gioi, (noi theo dao phat). thien trung. ngan trung, ngan lop ; xa cach qua chung ; dong dao qua. dinhthien luy van. nhieu vo so. thien lua. lay theo o muoi, muoi o vao mot gia ; mot ngan o la mot tram gia, chinh nghia mot thien lua la mot ngan o. thien co. ngan xua, lau doi lam ; lam, qua chung ; tot thien co, hay thien co, deu chi nghia la tot lam, hay lam. thien ly nhan. (coi chu ly). thien tai nhut thoi. ngan nam mot thuo, cuoc gap go phi thuong. thien tong. tuoc quan vo hay mot tram quan. thien thu. ngan nam.cung la tieng chuc cho hoang hau, dong nghia voi thien tue.

lanh, tot, hay. luong thien. nguoi tot, nguoi hien lanh ; nguoi chuyen mot viec lam an. tu thien. hien lanh, nhon duc. huu thien. thiet nghia. thien nhon. nguoi tot. thien tai. co tai, gioi viec tai nghe. thien nam tin nu. trai co long dao, gai hay tin dao (phat). thien hanh. hanh lanh, co net hanh tot. thien tam. long lanh, long tot. thien tinh. tinh tot, tinh lanh. thien hau. kheo lieu ve sau. thien nghe. tinh chuyen nghe nghiep, co tai nghe ; so truong ve nghe gi. khuyen thien. khuyen bao. tac thien phung thien. lam lanh gap lanh. thien nhon, bat thien nhon chi su ; bat thien nhon, thien nhon chi tu. nguoi lanh la thay nguoi chang lanh ; nguoi chang lanh la cho nho cho nguoi lanh. gia ngon thien hanh. loi noi khon ngoan, viec lam nen guong cho nguoi ta bat chuoc.
bo va. thien ta. viet lach, sao chep.
chuyen, lam ngang, trom phep ; cuop gianh. thien vi. gianh ngoi. thien quon. gianh quon, chuyen quien. thien hanh. lam ngang, lam tu, lay y rieng ma lam.
do an ; thit tha, do ngon. ly thien. nguoi coi viec don an. thuong thien. nguoi coi viec don an cho vua, cung la chuc quan. phung thien. nguoi coi viec don an cho ba hoang hau.

cat cho mat giong ; cat hot. thien dai. cat cho mat dai. -heo. cat cho mat giong heo. heo thien. heo da bi cat the ay. ga thien. ga bi cat the ay. thien mong. tech.cat hot mong, tech (ga trong). thien nhanh. cat nhanh, tia nhanh, rong nhanh. bo thien. quan hoan.

phep phong thien, don nen te le ; nhuong lai. thien thich. dao phat. dethien de thich. hai kieng chua hu trong nuoc cao-men. thien su. hoa thuong, thay ca dang dao phat. thien vi. nhuong ngoi vua. thien lien. loai ngai thap, la lon trai tren mat dat, cu no co mui thom gat, chu goi la tam nai 三 奈 vi thuoc mat.
dep de. dieu thien. ten mot nang nhan sac doi tam-quoc ; vo lu-bo. thien quyen. dep de, lich su.
con ve ve. thien thoi, thoat. xac con ve. dang lang bo thien. (coi chu dang).
lich thinh, than linh. linh thieng. id. thieng thinh. id. thieng lieng. (coi chu lieng). thieng sang. thong sang. thuoc thieng. thuoc mau, thuoc linh nghiem, thuoc than.
thanh. thieng thi. thanh quach, cho bua, cho do hoi. chon thi thieng. chon do hoi, dinh lieu (doi voi nha que). thuan thieng. (coi chu thanh).

chong, le ; duoc tran. bat thiep. nham le, mau man. man thiep. lanh loi, sang lang, nham le. thiep kinh. dang tat. thiep nhu anh huong. le nhu bong, nhu tieng vang ; chong qua, mau lam. hong ki bao thiep. co dieu bao tin thang tran.
giay nho nho, thuong de ma moi nhau. thiep moi. giay moi. thiep nam moi. giay do chuc nam moi. goi thiep. goi giay do ay.

kieu thuc. chu thiep. chu viet co phep, chu lam kieu cho minh tap theo. do thiep. do theo chu viet co phep. hanh thiep. giay bua di bat dao pham, chi nghia la nguoi co toi ma tron. but thiep thuc. tay viet chu hay, viet chu co phep. thiep thu. co cach dieu, diu dang, co phep co tac. chu viet khong co thiepthu. chu viet khong co phep.
yen. ninh thiep. binh an, yen on. thoa thiep. yen on, xong xuoi. nam thiep thiep. nam khong cu cua, nam xuoi lo.

hau, vo be, tieng don ba xung minh. the thiep. vo(tieng doi). tieu thiep. vo mon. tien thiep. vo hen (tieng don ba xung minh). dong thiep. dung con gai nho lam xac dong, de ma lam phu phep. danh dong thiep. phep sai hon di xuong am phu.gia nhu sai di tim ba con; truoc het phai bat nguoi muon di tim ba con, nam yen mot cho, roi thi lam phep sai hon,; cho toi doi ba bua, nguoi chet gia ay moi tinh day, ma hoc chuyen minh ngo thay lam sao.

cat, gat, chat, ca thay. do an mat chi thiet. do an mat lam. noi thietyeu. noi chuyen ngat ngheo, dinh ninh can ke qua. nhut thiet. ca thay, nhut la. tham thiet. tham lam. buc thiet. buc lam. thiet ngai, nghia. co tinh nghia voi nhau lam, gan gui nhau lam, thuong yeu nhau lam. co han thietthan. doi lanh qua; ngheo kho qua. thiet phien. cat mong, cat ra tu mieng mong.

dat, thet. thiet lap. lap ra.thiet lap mot xom, mot phan ho. thiet ke. lam muu ke, bay ra chuoc gi. thiet thi. dat vi du, vi du. thiet dai. thet dai. thiet yen. bay yen tiec. tran thiet. bay ra, don ra, chung ra lam cho trong su the. do tran thiet. do dung ma truong ra, cho de coi, cho trong su the. tan thiet. moi lap.lang tan thiet.

sat. thiet bang. bang sat, thuoc bang bang sat; sat tam ma dai. thiet chuy. dung bang sat, roi sat. thiet toa. xieng sat, xich sat. thiet tuyen. chi bang sat. thiet tien. roi nho bang sat. do thietkhi. do dung bang sat, nhu dao rua…. ki thietkhi. ki do sat, khong ua do sat. thiet lim moc. go liem, thu go rat ben ma nang, (tho san bac-ki). thiet kem. kem bang sat. thiet khau. mieng bang sat, (do gan mieng noi hut nha phien). thiet dinh. dinh sat; ben vung lau dai. thiet mac. cay mac. gong thietdiep. (coi chu gong).

luoi\:dung nom thi la tham ton, bi luy, thua sut, mat phan nho. thiet hai. tham ton, bi luy. thiet thoi. id. thiet than. luy toi minh, hu hai cho minh, mat phan nho. thiet minh. id. thua thiet. thua sut, chiu thua sut, mat phan loi ich. chiu thiet. id. thiet day ma co ich gi den ai. day da mat nho, ma do lai nho chi (tuy-kien). hon thiet (tu deu) so do tu chut; bung da hep hoi. . so hon tinh thiet. id. nguoi khau thiet. nguoi mieng luoi, nhieu loi noi. mac khau thiet. mac loi an tieng noi, bi ke khac dat dieu ma noi xau cho. trao tam thon thiet. cheo ba tac luoi, hay noi, hay khua mieng. phu nhon truong thiet, vi le chi giai. dan ba dai luoi, nghia la gia ham loi khau, thi la moi du (lam cho phai hai). quit thiet. liu luoi, tieng noi liu lo. 人 -nhon. thong ngon (it dung). don than co thiet. dan moi danh luoi, hay noi thoi, hay nghi luan chuyen ke khac. nhieu thiet. hay noi. 柔 常 存 齒 剛 則 折 -nhu thuong ton, xi cang tac chiet. luoi mem hang con, rang cung thi gay, vi du con nguoi mem mong thi ben, cung coi thi phai lam vap.

(that) chac. -tha. chac chan, cu muc chac chan, khong biet qui quai. it oi thiettha. chat phac, que mua, it an it noi, khong biet dua tranh, khong hay lam hung du, lam qui quai. -nhu dem. that tha lam. -muc. thiet chung, giu mot muc. -tinh hoac thiettinh. long that, long ngay, chan tinh, chan tam, chang co su chi gia doi, phinh pho. -long. id. -bung. id. viec thiet. viec co chac, viec ro rang. su thiet. id. -su, viec. chac chan, han hoi, lay theo su that, qua that. -thi. chac la. noi thiet. noi chac chan, khong co dieu gian doi. lam thietsu. cu viec ma lam, lam chac, lam han. noi choi sinh thiet. tieng noi choi lam cho sinh viec cai lay, duc mang. von thiet. von la, thiet la, so la. ki thiet. lay theo su that, qua thiet.

dung lua ma dot, lam cho chay. -di. id. -dot. id. phan thieu. id. -hoa. dot cho chay tieu. -huong. dot nhang, thap nhang. -vang bac. dot giay vang bac. len gian thieu. len gian hoa ma chet (hoa thuong). chet thieu. chet trong lua, bi chay ma chet. bi hoa thieu. bi lua chay. do thieulieu. do kham ve bang nuoc men, nuoc thuoc. lai thieu. ten rach o ve hat binh an(thu-dau-mot).
oi; bai ban tap nghe vo. -tri. hieu vua hien-to. hoc thieu. hoc bai ca danh vo. co cau thieunghiep. noi nghiep ong cha.

hut di, co it, khong du so, it, nho. -thon hoac thieuthon hut di, tung roi. . khiem thieu. id. -dung. khong du dung. -mat. khong co mat. danh thieu. bat va vi su thieu mat. bat thieu. bat loi vi su lam khong du le. con thieu. chua du so. chang thieu. vua du, du roi, kham roi. -chi, gi. hiem hiem, du dat, du ra. chang lay chi lam du thieu. co cung vay, khong nhung cung cho; chang lay lam can kip. thuoc thieu. thuoc khong dung le. -thuoc. khong du thuoc tac. can thieu. can non, can khong du. an thieubua. an khong thang bua, hut di, an bua doi bua no. -mot chut nua (no te xuong song). con co mot chut ma thoi; can qua, buc qua, cheo neo qua. -mot deu lay no. nan ni het suc, noi het suc, con thieu co mot deu la lay no ma thoi. -an thieuban. ngheo kho khong du an ban. thieu no. mac no. thieu tieu. id. tung tien, khong co tien. tien thieu. tien lam khong du quan, du so. chang thieu mat nao. co du mat; ai nay deu tuu hoi. thieu luong. khong du luong tien, khong du an.

hac vua thuan. tieu thieunhac vo. mua nhac thieu. thieu quang ha de hai lan tai sao. tuoi xuan xanh qua roi, chang tro lai, ay la xuan bat tai lai. thieu hoa. xinh tuoi, ruc ro. ca thieu. thu ca bien lon lon con, da tron va co nganh; ca nau chua hay la nau ngot.

it, nho. thieu tri. it tri, it khon, tri mon. thieu tai. tai mon, it tai. thieu luong. it luong, khong co luong thuc cho du (luong quan linh). thieu binh. it binh, binh so co it. da thieu. nhieu, it. ban thieu. hep hoi, nho mon (bung da). thieu an. nguoi khac bac khong hay lam on. vua thieungu. gan nham mat muon ngu. thieu nien. nho tuoi, tieu nhan, dua khong biet le nghia, dao ly.

tieng xung ho vo chu minh, vo thay minh, xung dan ba nho tuoi, vo nguoi nho tuoi, vo em minh hoac vo minh, thuong xung ho rang thim no, thim bay tre. chu thim. chu cung vo chu. ba thim. tieng xung ho dan ba da gia ma nho tuoi hon ba minh, hoac la vo chong ong chu, vo ong thay. thim. tieng goi dan ba con nho tuoi. thay thim. ong thay ba thay (xung ho). thim thay. tieng xung ho vo thay thuoc hay la thay day hoc.

chu thu 5 trong 12 chi (coi chu ti) sua sang, ran, giu. thin lai. ran long, sua minh, sua tinh net. thin tu. tu hoa, dam tham, hien lanh. khang thin. nam giu, ben long, (khang thinh hai chu hieu trung).

(thanh). tieng. thinh am. tieng tam. hoa thinh. bon ca nhac o kinh thanh. trinh, ve chi thinh. tieng dan ca hay lam cho nguoi ta me dam. ho that thinh. ho tat tieng. khoc that thinh. khoc tat tieng. thinh ne. dam tham, khong hay noi. lam thinh. nin lang, khong len tieng. rong thinh. rong lon, rong menh mong. lon thinh. lon phia trong ra ngoai, chi noi ve duong vat, ve cho. thinh khong. khi khong, hu khong, tinh co. lien thinh. hoi tieng tiep theo nhau, nghe tieng lien lien, chang khi ho. ong truyen thinh. ong noi.
(thanh). thinh tinh. trong sach, sach se. -bach. trong suot, sang suot, khong dung bon nho.lam quan thanh bach, thi la lam quan thanh liem, khong da dong cua ai.
(thanh). lam an thinhloi. lam an duoc lam, co loi nhieu. noi con thinhno. noi con gian du (vua chua).
ha viec quan, nha khach. -su. nha ngoai, le dem quan cuu ra nha ngoai.

ghe, vang theo. -lenh. vang lenh, nghe hieu lenh. -mang. vang, nghe loi day. linh thinh. linh thieng than hieu, hieu nghiem. -thuyet. lam bo thiet yeu, lam bo lo lang cho nhau; lay lam quan trong, nghe noi.

gao bap rang ra cung dam nho, thuong de ma uop ca mam. -gao. thinh bang gao. -bap. thinh bang bap hot. rang thinh. rang gao, bap ma bo vao mam. dam thinh. dam gao, bap da rang cho nho. -mam. dung thinh ma rai ma uop mam. mam thinh. mam da co rac thinh.
-len. sinh len. -linh. tinh co, xuat ki bat y. lon thinh. lon lam.

xin moi; ruoc; tieng tro tu. -moi. moi, khuyen moi. -toi. ruoc toi, moi den. -khach. moi khach, ruoc khach. -sac than. rac sac vi than nao. -kinh. ruoc kinh sach phat. lam nhu di thinhkinh. di cham chap, chuyen che qua, di khong dam ruoc. -phat. chiu tien ma ruoc cot phat. -tuong. ruoc tuong gi (cu tieng mua). thung thinh. cham cham vay, buon buon vay. -thoang. lan lan, mot hai khi. -ky. le trinh gio, hen gio cho ho hang den, dam cuoi. -di. ruoc di, lay di, dem di. tuc thinh. kinh moi. huu thinhhuu lai. co moi co den, doi voi cau vo thinh vo lai chi nghia la khong moi thi khong den (theo phep lich su co viec thuong phai moi nhau).

vua, xap (noi ve nuoc). tham thip. tham thap, uot deu. do nuoc cho thip. do nuoc cho vua tren mat, cai toi dau, nuoc toi do, dung do ngap. an chua thip. an chua no du, chua vua suc, an chua het bao nhieu. danh chua thip. danh chua tham, chua toi dau la dau. thua chua thip. thua chua het bao nhieu.

vat mem lon mau dinh theo xuong, lam nen than the con nguoi cung thu vat. -minh. than minh, than xac, minh may. -xac, mau thit, xuong thit, da thit. id. -nac. thit chac khong co mo. -mo. thit co nac co mo lon (goi chung). -tha. thit (tieng doi). -song. thit chua nau, nuong. -chin. thit da lam chin roi. -luoc. thit dung nuoc soi ma lam chin. -kho. thit nau voi nuoc mam. -ham. thit ninh lam cho bo. -quay. thit heo ram dot ca con. -ram. thit chien nuong tu khuc tu mieng lon. -nuong. thit ho ben lua ma lam cho chin. -xao. thit xat nho ma xao lan voi vat khac. -muoi. thit xat muoi ma lam cho khoi thui. thit xe kho. thit xe ra ma phoi kho. phan thit. thit chia ra tu phan de ma cho chac v.v. thit bat. lap the bat thu vat tren rung. thit san. di san ma bat thu vat rung. thit xe. mo xe thu vat ma lay thit no. thit uop. dung muoi hoac dung hanh tieu nuoc mam ma gia vi trong mieng thit. con thit. con thu tren rung nhu nai huou la giong minh hay san ban. cuc thitthua. cuc thit du dinh theo minh, muon rut ma bi thi so dau, de vay lai them cuc cho minh; loi vi du con cai hay lam cuc cho cha me. hum du chang an thitcon. (coi chu hum). mot mieng thitlang bang mot sang thitcho. cua lang vi tinh ma cho, dau it cung la qui. pham thit. pham phep kieng thit, khong giu phep kieng thit. lam nhu hum mai thit. lam ham ham, lam du qua. cang da xe thitchi duoc. co lot da ma cang, co xe thit ma phoi cung khong lam chi duoc, thuong noi ve no het the doi, con kho day. danh tui thit. tieng ngam de. cho an thitcho. ba con tro lai hai nhau. nich thit. an thit, bat ma an di. cay thit. xac cay, chinh minh cai ay. cay min thit. cay nho so va de dat. dat thit. dat khong co cat soi xen lan. ruot thit. mot mau mot thit, ba con ruot. tuong mat thit. tuong mat it khon, it lanh. thit thom. thit ngon thom, thu du ngo thay lien muon an; tieng noi choi, nhat nguoi khong so cop, nguoi di duong rung. het thit. thit bien di het, hoa ra om o, gay mon. chac thit. da thit san chac. thit san. thit san cung, khong beu khong nung. thit bay nhay. thit lan voi gan mong, thit nhot nhat. lat thit. cat hot tu mieng thit. thit hien. da thit tot co bi thuong tich, cung mau lanh. doc thit. da thit xau, co bi thuong tich thi hay sung hay lam mu cung lau lanh. non da non thit. da con mong, thit con mem.

de cach dem, co mui, (do an). com thiu. com de cach dem co mui. do thiu. do an de lau qua cung co mui. buon thiu. buon ba qua, vang ve qua. buon ngu thiu. ban than muon ngu. nam moi thiuthiu. moi nham con mat, moi ngu.
ban thiu. bung da nho mon, hep hoi, lung tung. moi thiungu. moi nham con mat, moi ngu. den thui, den thiu. den lam.
tieng tro tu. thom tho. thom, co mui thom. mi tho. ten xu o tai tinh dinh-tuong. ca day tho. loai ca sat lon con. tho lo. bo co ro.lo tho duoi khep vao tron (luc suc tranh cong).

vang chiu, lanh lay, chiu lay, da mang, bi luy. tho mang. vang lenh loi truyen day. tho sac. id.(vua chua). tho giao. vang loi day bao, chiu nghe theo; chiu lay dao nao. tho phai. (coi chu phai). tho che. bi ke khac hiep che, de tang. tho trai. mac no, chiu vay hoi. tho tai. chiu lay cua ai, an cua ai. -tai nhu thotien. chiu lay cua ke khac thi cung nhu chiu lay mui ten. tho le. chiu lay cua le, an le vat. tho hoi. an cua hoi lo, cua lo lot. tho tang. chiu lay cua tang. tho lanh. lanh lay; bao lanh, chiu lay. tho thuong. chiu thuong. tho hai. bi hai. tho tu. chiu chet. ngay tho tu. ngay ki, khong nen di dang. tho benh. mang binh. tho toi. nhin lay toi, thu toi. tho phat. chiu trach phat; phat ta. tho hinh. chiu hanh hinh, chiu hinh kho. tho phuoc. duoc phuoc, huong phuoc. tho an. chiu lay on ai. tho hue. id. luong dau tho dich. hai dau chiu giac; mot minh chiu hai mui giac; lung tung nhieu be. cam tho toi. cam long nhin lay toi, loi. tho nap quan thue. chiu nap thue cho quan, chi nghia la cho nha nuoc. tho thai. co thai, co nghen. tho nhuc. chiu xau ho.

trao, cho. tho nghiep. trao nghe nghiep, lanh viec day do. tho nghiep su. thay day hoc, thay truyen nghe. giao tho. (coi chu giao). than tho. trao tay, minh trao. that tho. trao chinh thuc. lanh thiet tho. lanh chinh chuc.

song lau. tho yeu. song lau, chet yeu. truong tho. song lau. tuoi tho. tuoi song lau. huong tho. song, o doi. thuong tho. bac song cho toi tam chin muoi tuoi. trung tho. bac song tu bay muoi tuoi tro len. ha tho. bac song tu sau muoi tuoi tro len. dien nien ich tho. dai nam them tuoi. (tieng chuc). le tho. le chuc tho. phuoc loc tho. co phuoc, co loc, song lau. phu tho da nam. giau, song lau, nhieu con trai. coi tho. coi tien, coi huong phuoc. van tho qua. trai a-phu-dung, trai thau. bong van tho. thu bong vang vang co mui cay, nguoi ta hay trong choi. tho cach. cot cach song lau. sach tho the. bo sach day viec lam thuoc, sach nghe cac thay thuoc. ngay van tho. ngay sinh hoang de. ngay thanh tho. ngay sinh hoang thai hau.
cay coi; trong, lap, lam. tho moc. cay coi. tai tho. trong cay. co tho. cay lau doi. tho dang. lam phe dang. cay dai tho. cay lon lam, cay cao lon.
hinh dang, voc giac, bo tuong. nho tho. nho voc, nho nguoi. lam tho an may. lam bo an may. danh tho. danh roi, (it dung). dat tho. dat set (it dung). (coi chu tho).

thong, dua, tron vao. tho dau. thong dau, dua dau vao; chun vao. tho tay. tron tay, dua tay vao. tho lo. lo ra, dua ra. tho lo. lo ra qua (tieng tuc). tho chan. dua chan vao. tho mieng vao. dung mieng vao; noi den, noi chen vao. tho gao. thoc gao, dua gao vao.

loai thu nho, dai tai (coi chu tho). tho bac. mat trang. tho ngoc. id. bong tho. bong trang. trai bao tho lan ac ta, ay mo vo chu ai ma vieng tham. (tuy- kieu). kip hon tho chay. noi ngay gio chong qua chong het. tho gion trang. tho hay nup lom, gion bong trang.

to, kich, khong thanh canh, tieng ly. tho tuc. kech com, que hen, khong thanh nha, khong biet le phep. tho kech. id. tho thap. to tac, kho coi. tho lo. que mua, ngang doc, khong biet le phep. tho hen. que mua, hen ha, kech com. tho nguoi. nguoi to xuong hoc, kech nguoi. tho kieu. kieu lon qua, khong co thanh. tho chi. to chi, chi khong co min. tho dang. dang to ma xau. vai tho. vai to chi. che tho. che xau, che do, che to cai. kieu ve tho. kieu ve to, khong co thanh. tho nan. nan duong kech qua, nan khong dien ro duong tho nan. ro duong nan to qua. loi tho tuc. loi noi que kech, chat chua khong co thanh bai. an noi tho tuc. an noi que mua, cung coi, khong co thanh canh.
thung, gio (tieng trieu-chau). che tho. che nguyen bao, nguyen thung. tra tho. id.
dat, de. cu tho. xu tri, sap dat, lam cho yen. tho tu. noi nang, lap loi noi. vo so tho thu tuc. khong cho de chon tay, khong cho nuong dua.
an tho. dat yen, (thuong noi ve su chon cat). tong chung an tho. chon cat yen bai: khi muong thac tong chung an tho: (luc-suc tranh cong).

lam. tho ngo. lam loi. that tho. bat y, map mo. coi that tho. coi thoang qua, bat y coi, coi khong tuong tat. cai tho. do da bat, thuong dung ma dung com, tren co nap day. mot tho com. mot cai bat dung com co nap day ay.

loai thu nho, dai tai, moi sut, dit co chin lo, de dang mieng; tuc tin don ba co thai an thit tho, de con phai sut moi. trong mat trang co bong con tho, cho nen cung goi mat trang la tho. ngoc tho. mat trang. bach tho. id. thanh long xich tho. (coi chu thanh). tho tu. hot day to hong, vi thuoc bo. giao tho tam quat. con tho qui quai lam hang ba cho, (tieng noi nguoi qui quyet hay lap nhieu the giu minh).

dat. tho dia. dat dai. than tho dia. than dat dai. dat tho. dat giong, dat thit. tho nghi. vat dat dai ua hap ma sinh ra. thuy tho. dat nuoc, tinh dat nuoc hien du the nao. tho khi. khi dat. tho mo. dat mo ma, mo ma. co tho. dat cu, que huong. huong tho. id. tho than. than tai, than bon mang, bon xu. tho cong. id. tho chu. id. ho hon dien tho van co chi thu. viec nha cua, cuoi hoi, cung viec ruong dat, hay sinh oan sinh thu cho den muon doi. tho gia. dat mia. vu dau tho. dat trong khoai dau. tho phuc linh. loai day cu, thit no vang vang, chinh la vi thuoc tri sang doc. nguoi dang tho. nguoi cao-men, nguoi moi. that tho vong huong. luu lac, bo xu so. hoaitho tu huong. men kieng nho que. nhap tho. xuong duoi dat, mac lay hoi dat; mot nguoi mac phong te nam duoi dat, thuong la nhap tho, lay lam kho cuu. dientho van co nhan. viec ruong dat phai hoi nguoi co cuu. dong tho. phuong dong. trung tho. nuoc trung-quoc. tho nhan. nguoi sinh san tai cho nao, thuong hieu ve men, moi. tho truoc nhon. id. tho quan. quang dang tho, quan moi; le nuoc annam co cho moi lam quan ma hay lay nhau. dong tho. (coi chu dong).
mua ra, xung ra. tho lo. xung ra, noi het, to het su tinh. ban than ban tho. nua nuot nua mua; khong chiu khai ngay. autho. ua mua.

(thi). chu nghia, hoac loi noi dat ra co cau co van, theo dieu van chuong. tho phu. id. van tho. bai van chuong, lam ra co cau co van, doi dap. tho bai. id. bai tho. id. lam tho. lam loi van tho co cau co van doi dap. dat tho. id. ngam tho. ca ngam bai vo da dat theo dieu van chuong. tho ngu ngon. tho nam chu vao mot cau. tho tuyet cu. tho bon cau. tho bat cu: tho tam cau. . co tho. tho bai cac nguoi van chuong dat thuo xua. tho buc. bai van ke duc tinh nguoi chet.

sach; giay gui tin tuc, giay gui loi tham; chuyen, van. van tho. sach vo, van bai, giay gui cho nhau. phong tho. gan tho, mot buc tho da phong roi. de tho. de chu de ten cho biet tho gui cho ai cung o tai dau. dang tho. dang tin nguoi ta gui. di tho. dem tho ma phan phat. chay tho. id. de tho. dem tho, dua tho di. trao tho. giao tho cho. coi tho. coi doc loi noi trong tho. nha tho. nha chuyen viec thu phat tho tu. do tho. sach vo, do tich. tho toan. chuc hay viec tinh toan. tho lai. chuc lanh viec bien ky, bay gio hieu la nguoi lam bien trong quan linh. tho thu. nguoi viet chu tot, lanh viec bien viet. tho ta. viet lach. tho sinh. hoc tro. dai tho. viet the, viet gium. tho tich. sach vo, bo so. tho tuong. truyen dat co ca van, de cho nguoi ta doc, hoac dung ma ca hat. hon tho. sach bien viec cuoi hoi da lam theo phep. noi tho. doc truyen nguoi ta da dat co ca van. tu tho. bon thu sach nho, la dai-hoc, trung-dung, luan-ngu, manh-tu. tho kinh hoac kinh. bo sach ke loi noi viec lam cac vua thanh doi xua. tho bat tan ngon. tho noi chang het loi. nay tho. tieng ket dang sau tho, noi rang ay la tho. lai tho. tho tra loi, viet tho lai. phuc tho. id. chieu tho. loi vua truyen du. tan tin tho bat nhu vo tho. tin het sach, chang bang khong co sach. sach co dieu dang tin, ma cung co dieu khong dang tin; neu tin het thi phai lam lac, tha dung co sach la hon. quac tho. tho nuoc nay gui cho nuoc khac. ha chien tho. (coi chu chien).

nho tuoi lam, con nit. tho dai. nho dai. tho ngay hoac ngay tho. id. tho yeu. con nho dai, con yeu duoi. con tho. con moi sinh, con nit. vo yeu, con tho. dan ba yeu duoi, con kho dai; su the khon cuc. tuoi tho. tuoi con be tui. tho than hoac than. bo di lo lang, khong co cong chuyen man, khong ai noi toi. di tho than. di ra di vo mot minh. that tho (that thuong). bo doi khat, di dung bo vo. tho ro. xo ro, thua thot, nhu cay mua dong, nhanh la xac xo. tho tho. id. can tho. ten xu o tai huyen phong-phu, (an-giang).
chi gai. tieu tho. gai nho. hoan tho. ten vo thuc-sanh (tuy-kieu).

mut doc. ung tho. id. tien hung tho hau phat boi. mut doc phat truoc nguc, keu la hung tho, sau lung goi la phat boi. quan khau tho. chung nong me man, tuc goi la ban cua, coi sau thanh cat ngang lung quan, co gan mau noi len giong con cua, hoac giong mieng con chim, phai chich no di thi nhe.
mo ra, noi ra. tho thoi. mo rong, thong tha, khoi lo, vo su. tho suong. rong rai, rong thong.

ke lap cuoc co tri, ke lam nghe, tay kheo leo, che tao ra vat gi. lam tho. ra cong che tao, chuyen nghe co tri. tho troi. dung tao hoa; dung dung nen troi; cuoc tao hoa. tho ca. ke lam dau mot bon tho, chinh tho lam nha. tho dung cai. chinh tho lanh cong viec cat (nha). tho chanh. chinh tho, tho lam dau. tho phu. tho giup cho tho chinh. tho ban. id. cung goi la tieu cong. thay tho. ke lam thay chi ve, cung ke lam tho, (goi chung). tho thung. tho, (tieng doi). chanh tho. chanh la nguoi tung trai trong viec lam tho, tay kheo leo. tay tho. id.
bo han han vui ve, bo xanh tuoi(cay co). tho tho. id. tho lo, lo, lo. bo lo lang, xo lo; mac mop.

kinh trong, ton trong, het long cung kinh, hoac lap ban rieng ma ton kinh. tho troi. lap ban rieng, le phep rieng ma kinh trong vi phep tac o tren troi. tho chua. kinh tho chua troi dat, nhin biet dang cam quien thuong phat. tho phat. kinh tho phat, giu dao phat. tho than. kinh trong vi than nao. -vua. het long lam toi vui, kinh trong duc vua. tho cha kinh me. giu bon phan lam con, kinh yeu, phung duong cha me. tho nghia than. id. ban tho. ban lap ra de ma lam viec tho phung. den tho. nha tho lon. mieu tho. mieu tho than. phu tho. nha tho lap rieng de ma kinh le ong ba hoac vi quan nao. giang tho (chieu trai). giang chieu bay ra giua nha de ma kinh ne ong ba nhu khi con song. nha tho. nha lap ra de ma lam viec tho phuong. tho vong. tho cach buc, lam le kinh tho nguoi xa cach, nhu o xa ma tho vua. ban tho vong. ban lap ra ma tho vong. toi ngay tho chua, gai tho chong. toi ngay phai het long lam toi vua minh, gai khon phai het long kinh yeu chong minh. tho o. vo y, xuat ki bat y. bo tho. leu lao, so luoc, khong can than. cay tho troi. kham nho dung truoc san de ma tho troi, cung la ban tho troi.

hit hoi vao, dua hoi ra; lay hoi ra vao cho thong trong minh. hoi. hoi tho ra hay la hit vao. tho than hoac than tho. than van, nan trach. tho ra. lay hoi ra: run long, thoi chi. tho vao tho ra. lay hoi ra, lay hoi vao; buc tuc khong an trong long. tho dai. tho dai hoi; lay lam kho chiu. tho van than dai. khong yen trong long cung la than tho. tho hao hen. tho nhat hoi qua, met nhoc qua. tho nhu trau cat co. tho doc. tho khe khe. hoi tho vuong dam khong thong. tho e e. hoi tho ra tuc toi. tho e ach. id. tho len. bat dem hoi len. -ca. tho khong ra hoi, lay hoi len. tho hoi hop. hoi tho yeu qua, con co mot chut hoi. tho khong ra hoi. met nhoc qua. tho nhat. tho hoi nhat thuc, bat phai tho giap. tho tuc. tho tuc toi. nin hoi tho. nin hoi, khong tho. het hoi tho. khong con tho nua. da tho. da suc gian, da viec oan thu. lam khong kip. lam cong chuyen luon luon, lam khong ho tay, cuc kho lam. mat tho. khong con tho nua. tho hhe. moc ghe, khi doc trong minh phat ra lam ghe.

lay tay ma ra qua ra lai; xuc phet do dau mo, boi bet vao. thoa thoa. ra qua ra lai. thoa phet. lay tay ma thoa va phet thuoc gi. thoa boi. id. thoa bop. va thoa va bop cho dau. thoa dau. lay tay tham dau ma thoa. thoa thuoc. lay thuoc ma thoa, ma boi vao cho dau. thuoc. thuoc dung ma thoa. thoa voi. boi voi. thoa nuoc son. boi nuoc son. thoa muc. boi muc, lay muc nuoc ma boi. thoa lo nghe. lay lo nghe ma bet vao, lam cho phai lam loi. thoa tay. thoa tham vao tay; vay vo trong tay, lam cho mat, xai pha coi nhu khong. mot chuc dong bac du cho no thoa tay. lam nhu thoa tay. lay di het, lam mat tang mat tich. moi de cai giay bac no lam nhu thoa tay, chi nghia la no lay di mat.
dong che voi vang; dong xung. dong thoa. id. vong dong thoa. vong dong xung. hoa tai dong thoa. hoa tai dong xung.
bang an, vua van, xuoi xa. thoa thiep. yen on, em tham. da thoa. da yen, da xuoi. di thoa. di (tieng doi).
gio. thoa ma. mang nhiec nang. thoa khi. ong gio.
diem. thoai khi. diem lanh, khi tot. thoai thao. co la, co bay diem la. tuong thoai. diem tot, may man.
(thuan). thoan y, long. xuoi theo mot long, mot y; ung y. thoan thao hoac thao-. thuan hoa.thao kinh.
(soan). thoan vi. cuop gianh ngoi bau. thoan thi. cuop giet, gianh ngoi vua.
(xoan). ngoc thoan. thu ngoc sang suot.
(thuan)nhuan nha. thoan thuc. da lap, da quen, da sua tinh y. thoan hau. hien hau.hoa huon. -tanh net. da sua tinh net, hoa ra diu dang.
(thuyen). di thoan. di thuyen. hanh thoan. id.
thap thoang. thoang qua, di qua, di xot ngang; khong thay no thap thoang, chi nghia la khong thay no den bao gio. thoang qua. id. ngo thap thoang. ngo thay bong, ngo khong to ro.
thap thoang. leo hanh, di xot qua. thoang qua. id.
lia, lia. lam thoan. lam lia. di thoan. di lia.
nho nhenmanh vuong, co mot thi. nho thoang. nho xiu. chi thoang. to manh.chi nho to manh vuong, ( noi ve ?).

khoi, xay khoi, ra khoi; vuot khoi; vut di; coi, lot; chong qua. thoat khoi. xay khoi. thoat vong. ra khoi vong, lanh khoi vong (giao hiem). thoat ra. dem minh ra.tron ra. thoat di. vuot di, bat khong duoc. thoat vao. tuot vao, len vao. thoat nan. khoi (ban in sai " kkoi") nan, lanh khoi nan. thoat trung vay. khoi trung vay. thoat nguc. khoi chon giam cam. thoat than. lanh minh. dao thoat. tronn khoi, tron mat. tau thoat. chay khoi, chay mat. do may thoat khoi tay tao. tieng ngam rang: lam sao may cung phai tay tao. xa thoat. vo ran lot. thien thoat. xac ve ve. thoat chuc. bong chuc, thinh linh. thoat thoat. qua mau qua. kim thien thoat xac. ve ve lot vo; ay la chuoc doi thay ao mao ma tron. thoat nhuc. rut het thit, con xuong voi da. thoat ho khau. cho ke tay ngon cai voi ngon tro, khong co trai chanh. tham thoat. mau qua, chong qua.ngay gio qua tham thoat. thoat giang. loi giang mon.
thoat chuc. bong chuc, tuc thi, lien. tham thoat. chong qua. phu sinh tham thoat. song chang bao lau, song do chet do.
(tieng tro tu). vung, thinh linh. thoat di thoat ve. di ve khong chung doi.

hot lualoai ngu coc: con vo goi la thoc, het vo la gao; tieng tro tu. lua thoc. (tieng doi). gao thoc. gao, tieng doi. thoc thach. hay luc lao, kiem tim, hay khua khuong. thoc thach lo mieng. nhoc nhach, hay an; nhay mieng, hay noi, co chuyen gi khong nin duoc. thoc thach kiem tim. luc lao, kiem tim. lo thoc theo sau. lam dam, lup xup chay theo sau, (nhu con theo me). chay loc thoc. chay lup xup.

dam choc, chi choc; dung tau chon hoac vat gi ma dong cham, dam chich. thoc vao. dam vao, dua day vao, dong den. dam thoc. xui giuc, cham chich, dam dau nay thoc dau kia, lam cho sinh chuyen bat hoa. nguoi lam the ay thuong keu la luong dau tiem, 兩 頭 尖 nghia la nhon hai dau. thoc nach. chi choc, dam dot, met thot; chuyen nguoi nay dem hoc voi nguoi kia, lam cho hon gian nhau. thoc chuot. id. dam bi thoc thoc bi gao. dong mot nghia voi tieng dam thoc. thoc gay. lay dau gay ma dam ma thoc. thoc xuong. dam xuong (thuong noi ve cay, gay). thoc trai cay. dung cay dai ma dam choc, lam cho trai cay rot xuong. thoc tay vao. tho tay vao, da dong den. thoc mieng vao. xo mieng vao, noi den. thoc co. tho ngon tau vao hong ma choc mua, lam cho mua. thoc huyet heo. dam hong con heo cho chay mau ra, cung la choc huyet.

an bam nhu heo, nhu cho. thoc cam. an cam; cam kho cho an hay sac, an tap khong dang: noi ve nguoi ta thi chi nghia la do tai chang lam chi dang. bon bon thoc. tieng vo cai bong, cach vo bong. thoc cho. troc cho, keu cho.
(then). thoen sat. then bang sat. cua dong thoen gai. giu cua chac chan, cam cua nhat.
(thet). mang thoet. mang den, mang cho mot cap. lam thang thoet. lam han hoi; lam luon luon. lam thoet di. lam cho mau.( tieng bao).

do tho cui dung trao chi qua lai giong nhu chiec xuong nhon hai dau; vang do ra tu cay nho noi chung nam luong; dam mo. thoi cui. do tho cui dung trao chi qua lai. thoi det. id. dong thoi. danh hieu mot thu dong. ngay xuan, con en dua thoi. ngay xuan qua mau nhu cai thoi det. noi nhu go thoi. noi keu qua, lien qua. thoi mot cai. dam mot cai; mo mot cai. thoi vao nguc. dam vao nguc. thuyen thoi. thuyen nhon hai dau ma nho, giong cai thoi. chim thoi. chim mo. thoi con mat. mot con mat.(chim). loi thoi. loi choi, loi thoi. thoi thop. tho hoi hop; bo lo buon qua.

cach the, le loi da quen thuoc; phong tuc; loi toi. thoi doi. cach the nguoi doi da quen theo. thoi nuoc. cach the, thoi quen trong mot nuoc. thoi dan. cach the dan su da quen. thoi chung. cach thoi chung cho moi nguoi. thoi cu. thoi quen da lau. thi thoi. cach an thoi o trong mot thuo. thoi phep. cach thoi an o. cach an thoi o. id. thoi que. cach thoi que mua; cach thoi nguoi o nha que. thoi xau. cach thoi xau xa. thoi hu. cach thoi xau xa lam cho con nguoi phai hu, phai mat net. thoi du. cach thoi an o hung du. theo thoi. tuy theo phong tuc. giu thoi. giu theo cach an o the nao. quen thoi. quen cach thoi. phai thoi. cach an thoi o phai le; nham cach thoi. khac thoi la doi. di thuong, di ky cuc. khac thi thoi. lam ngang doc, khong theo thi the. thoi toi. thuc toi, loi toi.
tieng tro tu. thiet thoi. (coi chu thiet). chiu thiet thoi thoi. chiu thua sut, chiu thiet hai.
(theo). thoi dat. mot theo dat, mot dai dat. thoi thit. mot mieng thit cat hot ma dai; mot theo thit. -dong. mot tam dong cat reo; mot theo dong. thoi vai. reo vai. thit thoi. thit cat ra tu theo.

doi, lay lam du roi; dinh lai, bai di, loi di, khong lam chi nua. thoi vay. du roi. thoi di. bai di, dinh lai, dung chi nua, tieng bieu. thoi viec. bai viec, khong lam nua. thoi hau. bai viec chuc hau (viec quan). thoi an. dut di khong an nua. thoi phut di. do di, dut di, bai di tuc thi. ma thoi. co ngan ay, chung ay, tang ay; khong co chi nua. thi thoi. thi da du, tieng cam ngan, bieu dung lam chi nua; nguoi ta khong cau, thi thoi. het cach, qua the. anh noi thi thoi; no co dai o dau? chi nghia la anh noi qua, no co dai bao gio. thi thoi the! du roi, chang con chi nua, (tieng trach). thi thoi the, anh noi vo lam chi! anh toi lam chi! the thoi. the ay ma thoi. thot thoi. (coi chu thot). nghe thoi. nghe roi, nghe ra. thoi doan. roi doan, roi thi. thoi nghe, hu, he. tieng hoi co vua chua, du chua. thoi he. tieng bieu phai thoi. thoi thoi. dung dung; vua roi, du roi, chung ay ma thoi.thoi thoi buong ao em ra. thoi di, khong cau. dung di, bai di, khong cau, khong muon nua. mot thoi. mot chap. mot thoi hai thoi. mot dung, hai dung, (tieng bao lam sao cung phai dung). thi thoi di cho roi. thi dung co cho roi; thi cho co lam chi. muon thoi thi thoi. thoi khong mac y. loi thoi. phan phan khong ra be nao, nhung nhang. thoi thuc. giuc gia, thoi thuc, doi hong. thoi te. doi mot luot, doi du mat. toat, to, giay, phieu thoi. giay to quan ra ra ma doi ai.

lui, thut lui; tra lai; thui tha. thoi chi. nga long, run chi, khong phan chi. thoi lui. tro lui, thut lui. thoi lai. lui lai, tro lai cho nao. thoi thuc, (thoi thuc). hoi, giuc. khong biet dang tan thoi. khong biet dang toi lui; khong biet phai di nga nao, lam the gi. tan vi quan, thoi vi su. toi lam quan, lui lam thay, (hieu ve thay thuoc, thay day hoc). tieng khuyen hoc, co duoc thi di lam quan, khong duoc thi ve lam thay.cung duoc danh phan cung no am. cao thoi. lam don xin thoi, thua thoi, xin thoi. tinh be thoi. tinh be lui, khong con lo chi nua, (thuong noi ve binh nang, het phuong cuu chua). thoi hoi. tra lai, lui lai. thoi lai. id. thoi tien. tra tien. thoi di thoi lai. tra di tra lai. thoi hoi bon quan. tro ve xu so, que quan.
dui. ban thoi. ban toa. hoa thoi. dui heo muong say kho.
thoi thop. dong nghia voi tieng hoi hop.

chum mieng dua hoi ra; lam cho khi khong khong chuyen dong, lam cho noi gio; lam cho chay ralam cho long len, lam cho dac y. thoi hoi. chum mieng dua hoi ra. thoi lua. chum mieng dua hoi lam cho lua do; dung cach the lam cho noi gio cho lua chay. thoi quyen, dich, sao. chum mieng dua hoi lam cho ong quyen, ong sao keu ra tieng. troi thoi nom. tro ngon gio nom. thoi na, bay, hoet. thoi manh qua (gio). coc thoi. coc xit hoi ra, nguoi ta noi no thoi nham tay chon ai thi phai sung lien. lo thoi. lo duc, (coi chu lo). don thoi. bon danh nhac, tai tu. thoi den. thoi cho den tat. ong thoi lua. cai ong thong hai dau, nguoi ta dung ma thoi cho lua do.(thuong dung ong tre).
thanh thoi. ranh rang, thanh nhan, thong tha. loi thoi. loi thoi, nhung nhang, keo dai. binh loi thoi. binh dau dai hoi. thoi roi. thua thot, roi rot.
ca, (coi chu thai).
thanh, (coi chu thai). bi thoi. thanh suy; van bi van thoi. tho thoi. ranh rang; khoang khoat, khong co tu tung; nhe lo, de tho.
(xoi). dat thoi. dat xop, dat nhe minh. thoi loi. xoi loi, rong rai.
(cung la chu thi, mac quoc huy, ma doc trai). thoi thoi. thi thoi. thoi com. an com (noi cho quan). thoi thot. roi rot, roi rong, (noi trai).
(thom)ten cho. xu thom. id. con mat thom lom. con mat mo trao trao, con mat hay dom ngo.
som, bo khom khom. lom thom. bo lum khum, lom khom; bo gia ca, khum lung. om thom. om som. thom vai. xe vai, xuoi vai qua, vai rua.
lom thom. bo cum num, so set.
hom vao, (coi chu hom). thom vao. id. com mat thom lom. con mat mo, con mat trao trao.

mui diu dang, hoi bay ngot ngao, nguoi ta lay lam ua. thom tho. id. thom thom. thom it it; co mui thom. thom lung; ngat, phuc, phuc phuc. thom lam. rau thom. loai rau co mui thoi. trai thom. thu trai lon co nhieu mat miu, chu goi ba nhan le. chi thom. chi chuot bang la cay thom. cu thom. cu cay thom, vat nguoi ta hay dam cho nat bay ma lam trang lua hang. danh thom. danh tieng tot. thom danh. dang tieng tot. thom thit. nguoi hay bi cho can, (tieng noi choi).
tieng tro tu. thang thom. thang bang, khong co cho nao dun, khong co cho nao gio giam.
lom thom. bom xom, khong ven kheo. bom thom. id. thom tham. so luoc, khong ki cang.
thon von. cheo leo, nguy hiem, gian nan.
nhon nhon. thon cam. nhon cam, cam co mot chut; lem cam. mat thon thon. mat top lai, nhon nhon; mat om ma nho.

xom, lang. thon truong. ke thay mat trong lang, lanh viec suu thue. nhut thon vi truong 一 村 爲 長 lam lon trong lang, vi co mot minh thon truong chap bo ho danh. thon dich. chuc viec lang. cai thon. chuc lon trong lang. dong thon. dong mot lang.

tac; thieu; thuc toi, danh thau vao. thon thieu. thut mut, thieu di, hut di. thieu thon. id. nhut thon tho nhut thon kim. mot tac dat mot tat vang; dat mac tien. xich thon. thuoc tac, do do. dong thon thon. tac lay noi minh, la mot long xuong ngon giua. (do do ma cham cuu). bo thon. cho coi mach, o noi cuom tay. dong thon. dong thuc, dong nhan, dong loi. thon toi. thuc toi; day toi, dong thuc toi.
lo luong. thon dac. dan do; lo luong; dac chung; uoc chung; phong chung. thon do. id. thon thuc. buc tuc, ay nay; ngu khong duoc.
don vao, nhan vao. thon vao bao. don vao bao bi. thon vao lung. nhet vao day lung, lon lung. thon vao bung. co bao nhieu an het bay nhieu; an nhieu, an day bung. thon vao day. bo day, nhan vao day.

thong; nhay phong. thong dong. thong tha, khong co cong chuyen man; khong phai nhoc nhan. thong tha. id. thong ong dieu. cai ong nho dai de ma hut thuoc. cay thong hong. (coi chu thong). nhay thong. nhay ngang qua, nhay phong, (nhu nai). thong qua. phong qua; nhay phong qua. cay mac thong. cay mac dai can.

dui xuong, dong xuong, dua xuong; tha xuong; xu xuong. thong thong. xu xuong, xuoi xuong, do xuong; phe phet; dong deo, ton ten, co duoi, con dinh dap, chua dut. long thong. id. viec con long thong. viec chua thanh, hay con dinh dap, hay con dai. thong xuong. bo day xuong, lay day cot vat gi ma dui xuong, tha xuong; xu xuong. thong day. bo tha mot dau day; xuong mot dau moi day. treo long thong. treo hong, treo ton ten, treo nhieu cho. ngoi thong chon. ngoi bo chon xuong hong heo. thong dau xuong dat. de dau dong xuong dat. mui dai long thong. bo do day, bo o do. vo con long thong. co vo, co con nhieu, mat thong tha. thong voi. bo voi xuong, dua voi xuong, (voi rong).
cai vo nho. cai thong. id. chinh thong. deu la do bang dat: chinh nho mieng to hong, thong rong mieng dung trai. thong mam treo dau gian. su the hiem ngheo, khong chac chan.
thong thua. o ho, vo y, khong hay coi truoc giu sau. thua thong. id. treo long thong. treo hong, (coi chu thong).
sang lang, thong hieu. thong minh. sang lang, minh man. thong minh de tri. nguoi thanh tri, tri hue lon, thuong tri. thong mon. lo khap sanh, lo thop.

chung, khap; thau dao, khong co cai chi cach tro. thong thai. thong minh. thong thuoc. thuoc biet, thuoc ve, chung cong. lau thong. thong biet ro rang. tinh thong. id.dao ly tinh thong; vo nghe tinh thong. thong thau. hieu thau, thau den. quan thong. dem tin tuc, thong dong cung nhau. bat thong. chang biet deu; khong thau den. hoc thong. hoc kha, hoc gioi. noi thong. noi co ly su; noi gioi. an noi bat thong. an noi phi ly, khong biet deu. bat thong su ly. khong hieu su ly. thong suc. suc ra, truyen ra khap cho. thong tin. goi tin cho nhau; cho nhau biet. thong bao. truyen bao khap cho. thong cho nhau. dem tin tuc, cho nhau biet. thong nghia. hieu duoc nghia sach. thong cong. chung cong. thong luu. thau den nhieu cho, (dang nuoc). thong hanh. di thong tha.giay thong hanh thi la giay phep di duong.mai ngoai, mai hien. thong hoi. hoi ra thong tha, khong bi lai; lam cho boi thong. thong gio. co gio thoi mat me. thong dung. dung nhieu viec. ngon thong luu. ngon rach di thau nhieu cho. thong ngon hau bo. bac thong ngon, con doi cho bo. di thong thuong. di buon ban; di khap cho. tu thong. co tinh y rieng. giao thong. thong dong voi nhau, lai vang cung nhau; lam bang huu. thong than. linh di, thau den linh than. mo thong. mo cho rong rai. khai thong. id. rong thong. rong rai, khoang khoat. thong suong. tho thoi, rong thong. chang thong noi. chang chiu noi. chang thong lam. chang chiu lam. thong dam. dam tron, de khat. thong trong co. khong co vat gi ngai trong co. dai tieu bien bat thong. dang dai, dang tieu khong xuoi xa. quan thong. suot thong. thong dong (voi giac). mot long voi giac, tin qua tin lai. am thong. len luc thong dong. thuy tiet bat thong. nuoc chay khong lot, (noi ve su vay giu). thong phan. chuc lam dau nha to, lam dau trong mot ti, quan viec tu han; ta nhi tinh vien. thong lai. ke lanh viec bien ki o cac phu huyen, tho thu. thong chanh su ti. ti chu viec thau lanh so sach, van tho. thong binh. ten rach o ve hat chau – doc. vinh thong. ten kinh noi theo kinh vinh – te (thuoc an – giang).
(tong)thu cay deo dai nhe minh, cung co nhua thom. van thong. van cay thong, nguoi khach hay dung ma dong tau.
hanh. thong dau. cu hanh. thong bach. id. thong lanh. ten nui.

moi, gieng; tom ve mot moi; cai quan. chanh thong. chinh moi gom tom; chinh vi vua. nhut-. dem ve mot moi, gom lam chu chung. tong thong. chuc quan vo gom hay mot dao binh, chuc quan gom hay mot phuong. do thong. id. the thong. oai nghi, su the lam cho nguoi ta kinh vi; dieu the ca. thong doc. chuc quan lon gom hay mot xu lon. thong lanh. chuc quan lon tom hay viec binh. thong hat. tom ve mot phep cai tri. thong binh. tuoc quan vo. thong suat. id. thong tong. gieng moi. thong tu. moi mang, moi manh. nhut thong chi. sach su bien viec nuoc lam ra mot moi, bien viec mot dong vua. quy nhut thong. dem ve mot moi (cai tri). thong xat. chuc quan lon xet hach cac an tu.(chuc moi). thong su. chuc quan lon lam dau cac cong su, trong mot so bao ho.

dau nhuc. thong kho. dau don, kho so. thong so. id. thong hoi. an nan, trach minh. thong tich. dau tiec, tiec lam. thong thiet. dau lam. thong tam tat thu. dau long, nhuc dau, lay lam cay dang kho chiu. dau thong. nhuc dau, van dau.
thop thep. nhop nhep, nhay mieng, hay noi. thop thep lo mieng. id.
thoi thop. hoi hop, ay nay, khong yen trong da. lo thop. lo khap sanh.
boc manh, nam manh. thop nguc. boc nguc, nam tai nguc, (ma bat ai). thop quach. bat quach, nam quach.
lot ngay, dam chuoi, thoc xuong (tieng tuc). dam thot. dam quyet xuong, thoc xuong. chay thot. chay chuoi, chay phoc, chay lot ngay.bo trai buoi vao ong khoi no chay thot.

teo lai, rut vao, lam cho top vao. thot vao. hot vao, hung vao, sup vao trong. thot bung. nin hoi lam cho cai bung hot vao, top lai. thot dai len co. tieng che nguoi nhat gan. nhay thot. nhay gon, nhay tuot len.nhay thot len vao giua. thot len ngua. nhay phut len ngua. keu thanh thot. keu tieng thanh bai, lanh lot.

noi, noi nang. noi thot. id. thua thot. thua goi; thua kien. the thot. the. biet thi thot, khong biet thi dua cot ma nghe. tieng trach dua hay noi leo, noi hot. cay thot not. loai dua rung, co trai nho nho, nguoi cao – mien hay lay nuoc trong bap no moi tro ma lam duong, mot cach nhu duong dua ta. duong thot not. duong lam bang nuoc cot cay thot not. thot not. ten rach o ve long – xuyen.
thao thot. lam roi rot, do thao khong ven kheo. lao thao lot thot. id. lot thot. roi rot, lot dot.

tam van nho de ma xat thit, lam ca; mot phien, tieng keu ke. tam thot. id. thot coi xay. mot phien coi xay. thot tren mon thot duoi cung mon. noi ve coi xay: phien tren mon phien duoi cung mon, vi du hai nguoi kien thua, deu phai thiet hai. thot voi, tuong. con voi, con tuong.voi lon nhieu nguoi khong no keu bang con. thot be. mot phien be. thot vuon. mot mieng vuon, mot day vuon. thot cau. mot liep cau trong dai. lung bang tam thot. tieng mang dua lon lung ma lam bieng.

mua lua chin, ke mua ha truoc mua dong. mua thu. id. trang thu. trang to rang. troi thu. troi yen mat cung la mua thu. may thu. may nam. thu hao vo pham. may long khong pham.(chim den mua thu thi thay long, moc nhung long mang). mui long thu. mot may long. thien thu. ngan nam; tieng chuc tung hoang hau. gio thu. gio tay, gio mat. xuan thu danh thanh. con duong xuan xanh, con trai trang. trung thu. ram thang tam. banh trung thu thu. banh an ram thang tam. xuan ky thu bao. (coi chu bao). thu tham. xet an lai; an cac tinh dang ve, hoang de thuong phai xet di xet lai nhieu lan (nhut la trong mua thu). thu quan. tuoc quan thuong tho bo binh.

thau. thu thap. gop nhop, thau vao. thu tru. thau tru, tich tru. thu vao. than vao. thu lai. thau lai cho vao, bot di lam cho vao. thu khong. chung bai cong viec buoi chieu toi. trong thu khong. trong bai cong viec, hoi gan toi. thu duong. ruoc lay ma nuoi. an thu phan. (coi chu phan). hau thu. day cot yen ngua choang sau duoi ngua. gia thu. (coi chu gia).
loai ca bien, khong vay, chinh la thu ca ngon. ca thu. id. thu au. thu ca thu nho con. thu la. thu ca thu giep minh.
(coi chu tho). truong thu. song lau.

y huong, y vi, cach thoi, bon phan, su the lam an. thu vi. y vi, phai cach the. tu thu. bon the lam an, la ngu, tieu, canh, muc, nghia la bat ca, lam cui, cay cuoc, chan nuoi. thu que. cach thoi nha que. thu nao vui thu ay. bon phan nao vui theo bon phan ay. quen thu. quen cach thoi, quen su the. theo thu. theo cach thoi, theo su the minh. chi thu. sieng nang, can kiem. chi thu lam an. lo mot su lam an. huu thu. co cach, co y vi, lich su. mot thu. khong biet dieu, bat lich su, khong co y vi, vo doan. vo thu. id.
chiu dau phuc, chiu toi. dau thu. dau phuc, (noi ve nguoi tron lanh). xuat thu. ra ma dau phuc. ra thu. id. chiu thu. chiu ra ma dau. thu phat. chiu phat.
gu tai bien thuy, giu bo coi, o theo don luy xa. linh thu. linh bo di canh gac cac noi, nhut la ngoai bien thuy. di thu. di ngu don luy ngoai bo coi. khien thu. day di ngu bien thuy, o theo linh thu.
chuc quan. thai thu. (coi chu thai).

loai chay, co bon chan. cam thu. loai bay, loai chay, ke chung, hieu ca cac thu thu vat. dieu thu. chim, muong. thuong cam, ha thu. loai bay tren troi, loai chay duoi; loai thuong cam, loai ha thu, thuong hieu la con chon doi.

cuoi. hon thu. le cuoi, phep cuoi hoi. so hon thu. so bien viec cuoi ga. gia thu bat kha luan tai. phep cuoi gai chang nen tinh tien cua, tinh tien cua thi theo thoi moi ro. thu the bat tai nhan sac. cuoi vo chang vi nhan sac, dung be duc hanh la hon. minh hon chinh thu. cuoi hoi ro rang theo phep nuoc.
vi, san-. tuan thu. le vi thien tu ngu xem cac nuoc chu hau.

ke nghich tac, oan han, quyet long lam hai nhau. ke thu. ke nghich, ke lam du voi minh, ke minh oan han. thu oan. oan han, ghet bo, toan lam hai cho nhau. hiem thu, hoac thu hiem. tich lay su gian hon, toan lam du ma tra lai. gay thu gay oan. gay oan, gay deu gian du. bao thu. tra thu, tra oan. thu vat. oan han, thu han ve chuyen nho mon, thuong hay lam chung nhu cho can trom. lam nhu giac thu. khong con nhin biet nhau, lam hung du nhu gap ke thu. thu khich. (coi chu khich). thu lu. ten cho. trai thu lu. thu trai tron tron ma mup dau nhu dau nut ao; vat chi tron ma mup dau nghia la co hoi nhon, thi goi la thu lu. dau gay thu lu. dau gay tron va nhon it nhieu.
tra. thu ta. hau dai nhau, on nghia qua lai. vang lai thu tac. on nghia qua lai, hau tinh.
con nhen. tri thu. id. thu vong. luoi nhen, vang nhen. thu tu. chi nhen.

dau. khe thu. cui dau lay. don thu. id. hoi thu. day dau lai. thu vi. dau duoi. thu tuong. quan chu tuong. vi thu. lam dau, doi voi chu vi tung, nghia la tung theo. nguon thu. vua, chua. thu lanh. chuc lam dau trong mot ti, kinh lich. thu hap. chuc lam dau trong mot phong nha to, (thay thu, bac hap). thu vi bat tuong co. dau duoi chang doai nhau, (noi ve su ra tran, danh ca hai phia, lam cho ben giac khong tien cuu nhau dang). thu pham. dua chinh pham, dua chu muu trong su lam du.

giu, giu gin. tran thu. quan tran mot phuong. thu thanh. chuc giu thanh tri. thu trai. giu trai. thu ngu. chuc quan giu cua bien.don thu tai cua bien. tan thu. id. thu ba. giu gin, cung hieu la phan thu. canh thu. canh giu. don thu. don lap ra ma canh giu trom cuop. trai thu. trai cua lang lap ra de ma canh giu tren bo. phan thu. cho lang lap ra ma giu duoi song. ho thu. vang ho, gin giu, (noi ve cua cai gia tai). bao thu. id. thu the. giu the than.(keo phai luy den minh), co y, can than. thu than vi dai. giu bon phan, giu minh la viec lon, (dung de vuong mang su gi). thu le. giu le phep, co khuon phep. thu tin. giu deu tin, khong that uoc. thu tiet. don ba goa, khong chiu cai tiet. thu nghia. giu nghia cung nhau, giu deu tin nghia. thiep thu. co cung cach, giu ne nep: an mac thiep thu, thi la an mac co cach, co phep. phap thu. co phep, biet giu phep. phung cong thu phap. kinh viec quan cung giu phep. co thu. ben giu, giu chat. thu bon. chuc viec coi giu tien bac cua lang; giu lay can bon, giu lay cua minh. thu khau nhu binh. giu mieng cho kin, loi noi phai cho de dat, can than.

tay. thu tuc. tay chon. thuc thu. bo tay, (khong co viec ma lam); bo tay chiu toi.chiu phep, khong dam kinh chong. huynh de nhu thu tuc. anh em duong tay chon, co dut di khong noi lai duoc, nghia phai thuong yeu nhau, giup do nhau. than thu. chinh tay minh. du thu du thuc. dua an choi vat ma. tien ha thu. xuong tay truoc, ra tay truoc, (noi ve su chem giet). quoc thu. tay lam thuoc hay trong nuoc, tieng khen thay thuoc co tai. doc thu. tay du tay doc, co dong toi dau thi hu hai toi do, nguoi doc hiem.

lay, chiu lay, ruoc lay. thu xa. dung lay, hay la bo di. sach thu. buc say ma lay, doi ma lay. trach thu. chon lua ma lay. thu thu. gop lay, thau gop. tho thu. chiu lay. trong thu. thau gop nang. noi thu thi. noi nho nho, noi ru ri. thu hoa chi dao. la dang ruoc lay hoa hai, lam cho minh phai khon. di mao thu nhon that chi tu-vo, di ngon thu nhon that chi te-du. lay dien mao ma chon nguoi thi lam noi nguoi tu-vo, vi ong ay xau nguoi ma bung da tot; lay loi noi ma dung nguoi, thi lam noi nguoi te-du, vi ong nay khong co khoa ngon ngu ma nghi luan hay.
coi chu tho. thu phong. tho bao lai, mot phong tho. thu kiem. guom sach, thao sach buoc cay guom nho, do tu buu, do choi.

cai, mai, (noi ve cam thu). thu hung. duc cai, trong mai, bat cap, xung doi cung cap. thu hoang. vang reo, vang gia. phep thu. phep lam cho vat gi vao trong bung nguoi ta, lam chi phai dau om ma chet; noi ve phep men, moi, co oan thu ai thi lay vat cung nhu mot mieng giam hoac da trau kho, v.v.doc phu chu cho no nho lai bang con bo mat, roi thi sai no bay vao do uong; ke no thu an con bo mat vao bung thi huong lai tam giam.v.

ke lay hang nhut, ve bac hang nhi; phien, lan, tam bay, tieng keu ke; cho dong dinh, cho ghe, quan xa. bac thu. ke lay bac nhut, bat ke sau. thu hang. ve hang vua, hang nhi, hang ke sau; lop lang, so hang. thu tu. lop lang, tang bac. thu lop. id. tang thu. id. ngoi thu. cho dung, cho ngoi, tang bac. phan ngoi phan thu. (coi chu phan). thu nhut. bac nhut. thu nhi. bac nhi. thu may. va hang nao, so may. thu rot. hang rot, bac duoi chot. cu thu. cu theo thu lop, cu theo hang, cu theo phien. thu thu. id. nhut thu. mot lan, mot phen. tiet thu. nhieu lan, nhieu phen. lu thu. id. quan thu. cho dong binh. tan thu. ben do. thu tram. chuc thu hai trong tram. thu xa. do cac vi sao di dung. do thu. cho ghe doc dang. ba thu. ba vua thu hai. thu phi. id. thu mang thao. loai co, vi thuoc. thu gi. giong gi, vat gi. thu nguoi. giong nguoi, hang nguoi.thu nguoi xau xa den diu. thu tot. giong tot, hang tot. thu xau. giong xau, hang xau. tue thu. so nam ve chua nao trong so muoi hai.
bien ky, nha quan, lanh lay. thu phan. thu la ky ten, phan la de ngay. thu bo chanh. quien lanh chuc bo chanh. thu du. khoai mai.

chung, dong, ngo hau, gan, vo hau. thu nhon. chung nhon, dan nhon, ve hang dan. vo thu. vo hau. dong thu. dong hau doi voi dong chanh. con thu. con hau, con dong thu. thu co. ngo hau, gan, hoac la. thu cat si. chuc quan trong vien han lam.

dung, tha; rong luong; ngoan nguy. tha thu hoac thu tha. dung tha. nhieu thu. id. dong thu hoac thu dung. id. thu cho. tha cho, dung cho. thu mang. dung cho mang song, khong giet, thu tha cho. thu toi. tha toi. thu tinh. nghi tinh, rong dung. thu tay. noi tay, bot tay, khong lam du, khong danh dap. tao thu tay cho may. tao bot tay khong danh may. nho on tha thu. nho long rong hay tha thu. trung thu. trung hau, ngoan nguy. hay suy ky cap nhon.

dung cach the ma uom, ma lam cho biet viec ra the nao. thu long. uom thu cho biet long da the nao. thu tinh. id. thu y. uom thu cho biet y lam sao. lam thu. lam truoc mot hai lan cho biet viec. noi thu. dung loi noi ma uom thu. hoi thu. hoi cho biet viec the nao. coi thu. coi cho biet viec lam sao. xem thu. id. thu thuoc. thu cho biet thuoc ra lam sao. thu sung. ban truoc cho biet sung tot xau the nao. thu vat. lay vat gi giau di cung hoi cho biet la vat gi, (cach thu bong, thu thay phap). thu tai. thu cho biet tai luc ra the nao/. thu suc. thu cho biet suc manh yeu the nao. nem thu. nem mot chut cho biet mui the nao. an thu. an cho biet vi ?..ra lam sao.

ay, ay. bi thu. nay kia; lam tai hay, phan doan, su khon su dai. kheo bi thu. kheo lam tai hay, phan doan the no the kia. thu tinh. long nay. thu tam. id. thu ly. le nay, le ay. nhu thu. the ay, nhu vay. nhu thu nhi di. duong ay ma thoi.

ang. thuong thu. cam khi nang. trung thu. chung bi nang ma phai mua phai khat nuoc cua nong vui. binh thu thap. binh cam khi nang cung khi uot duoi dat, phat ra nong lanh cung dau nhuc ca minh. han thu bieu. (coi chu han).

chuot. thu thu luong doan. khong biet be nao. (con chuot trong hang muon chun ra, thi hay quay dau vao, tro dau ra). tho bach thu. tho noi ve chuyen con chuot bach. thu niem tu. hot muong, vi thuoc ghe, cung goi la nguu bang tu.

kem, sut, it, khong bang nhau, that loi. thua kem. id. thua sut. id. thua tri. thap tri hon ke khac. thua tai. it tai, khong bang ke khac. thua suc. it suc hon. thua the. sut the than, khong co the cho bang. thua mieng. id.khong co tai nghe cho du (noi ve nghe vo). thua hoi. thua su the lan luot be ngoai. thua thiet. chiu thua sut nhieu be. thua lan. mac lan. chiu thua chiu thiet. chiu thua thiet nhieu be. dang thua. hon hay la thua. hon thua. id.so do, phan bi, khong chiu sut hon. nho thua. nho hon. nhe thua. nho hon; it thua, (co bac). an thua. (coi chu an). dinh an dinh thua. lo do, dinh dap; con mac trong vong an thua, (co bac). thua het su nghiep. thua co bac phai mat het su nghiep. thua thi thua me thuacha, ca sinh mot lua, ai ma thua ai. vi le phai ma nhin, chi nhu su o doi mot trang mot lua, ai ai cung dau den mau do, chang phai nhin thua ai.

ket chi them, lam cho de coi, lam cho co hoa dang. theu thua. theu (tieng doi). lam bong thua. lam vay va, lam cho hu viec. chi voi bong thua. chi roi ram. no bong thua. no tray, no tret (noi ve bong hoa). thua lua. loi loi ra, vay va ra, (noi ve ghe choc).

tieng noi, tieng tra loi voi ke lon, nhu la kinh noi, kinh tra loi. thua trinh. thua goi, trinh bay, (cung la tieng doi). thua chuong hoac chuong thua. id. thua thot. gio noi; kien cao su gi. thua qua. chuong thua truoc mat ai; goi noi so qua. thua bay. chuong goi, bay to. thua don. dem don ma xin su gi. thua kien. id. thua gian. cao gian.cao khong thiet. thua doi. id. thua man. noi gian doi, co y doi ke lon. thua leo. kiem dieu leo lac ma thua. thua kheo. id. thua mieng. noi mieng, khong co lam giay ma trinh. thua thiet, ngay. goi noi that tha, ngay thang, khong dam noi doi. thua that, thet. ho khoan, khong khit, khong day. thua rech, rich. thua thot qua. vai thua che mat thanh.
