(coi chu mat). cong chuyen lam an thua thot. leu lao khong chin chan, it biet cong chuyen lam an. thua nhu ro sao. thua thot qua; khong chin chan, khong biet chuyen lam an. dung nhu hang rao thua. dung do, dang cho co nguoi coi chung doi, (nhu cho nguoi ta o chung quanh nha minh ma giu gin cho khoi dua gian). thua cong chuyen. it biet cong chuyen, leu lao, bo tho. thua moi hang. buon ban it dat, it ban hang.

chi thit, thit co chi co so nho nho. chi thua. id. da thua. da thit, (thuong hieu la lop thit gan da). thua cay. so cay, thit cay co chi co soi. thu thua. cat de vo y, khong can than, khong ven kheo. de thu thua. id.

du ra. thua ra. id. thua thai. id. thua lua. id. du thua. id. thong thua. leu lao, o ho, vo y.lam thong thua. thua ua. du dat, dung khong het, bo ra. do thua. do du, do bo. an thua. an do ke khac an khong het, an do bo. an com thua ca can. an nhu toi moi, an do bo. tao thua ra. tao biet chan; tao khong them noi toi; tao bo ra ngoai. moi thua lua. moi tre ra qua. chang ua noi thua cho bo. (coi chu bo). -vu. du dung; tieng noi ve heo con de ra nhieu, vu heo me khong du cho moi con bu; noi choi ve nguoi ta, goi rang ki luc thua vu thi la ki luc du so, con chuc cho bo. thua moi. du moi, bay moi ra, (moi chi, moi day.v.v). thua trong nha, moi ra be ngoai. viec chi trong nha xu roi moi toi nguoi ngoai. thua noi chi ngoai. id.cu ben noi la ben cha lam trong hon ben ngoai, la ben ho me.

vang, chiu, nuong. thua mang. vang lenh day, vang deu truyen day. thua lenh. id. thua hanh. vang lam theo ideu day bieu. -chi. chuc quan trong vien han lam. thua lanh. vang lanh, lanh lay. phung thua thua (minh giao). kinh vang theo loi truyen day. kham thua. kinh vang theo. thua tuyen bo chanh su. tuoc quan bo chanh, chuyen cac viec chanh, duoi quan tong doc, quan tinh thu hai. thua bien. chuc bien su (tu tam chin pham). thua thuan. dua theo, nuong theo ke khac; dua theo. thua thuong tiep ha. doi tren noi duoi, chi nghia la lien tiep theo nhau. -tran. van bung dong ngan duoi mai nha de ma hung bui. dich ton thua trong. chau dich ton phai lanh viec huong hoa cho ong ba.
dang, chiu. thua tuong. chuc quan lon, gom hay cac viec nuoc. phu thua. quan phu thu hai. huyen thua. quan huyen thu hai. tu thua. chuc nho lanh viec tho phuong trong cac mieu mon cua quan.

uong, nhon, coi. thua co. nho co hoi, nhon dip, nhon su the. thua the. id. thua. id. thua ma. coi ngua. thua xa. ngoi xe. tay thua the. nguoi tung trai, biet deu, muon tro trao the gi cung dang. thua tru. nhon ra roi lai tru di; quien cham chuoc (noi ve cong tao hoa). thua ua. tinh co. noi thua ua. nhon dip ma noi, khong co y gi; noi viec tinh co. thua nhon chi nguy, loi nhon chi tai. nhon khi ke khac phai deu gian nan tai hai, ma hai them. thua long. duyen coi rong, dep doi ban.

tieng the cho nguoi vat. an thua phan. an bon phan minh. anthua mang. an theo mang so minh. biet thua long. biet duoc long nguoi nao,. dat thua. xi phan, gianh phan, dat coc. noi dat thua. noi rao truoc, noi xi phan.

xuoi theo mot be, danh theo, hiep y cung nhau, mot long, hoa hao. thuan mot long. xuoi mot long, hiep mot y, khong cai y nhau. thuan mot y. id. thuan mot be, mot phia, mot mai. xuoi theo mot phia, danh theo mot phia, khong nghich nhau. thuan mot le. xuoi theo, ung theo mot cach. thuan tung. id. thuan thinh. nghe theo nhau. ung thuan. ung chiu. thuan muathuan ban. ung mua, ung ban, khong hiep nhau. mai mai thuan nhon tinh. danh mua thi mua, danh ban thi ban, chang ep ai cung chang cam ai. loi thuan le em. deu noi hoa nha, diu dang. thuan tien. xuoi xa, duoc the. thuan gio. gio xuoi. thuan phong. id. thuan buom xuoi gio. tieng chuc cho ke di thuyen. thuan con nuoc. xuoi con nuoc. thuan tay. nham phia de, khong co trai tay. thuan cach. nham cach ???. cua thuan. xua la cua co, nguoi ta khong muon cho no co, thi cai la cua thuan, chinh la cua kinh do nuoc dai-nam. dau thuan. han dau cung chiu phep nuoc. qui-. id. thuan tri. hieu vua thu nhut doi nha thanh bay gio. thuan canh. (coi chu canh). thuan giao. ung giao, danh giao. thuan vothuan chong. vo chong dong ung; dong co dong chong. thuan thien ung nhon. thuan long troi, xuoi long nguoi (noi ve vua chua). sinh thuan tu an. o doi lam phai, chet an theo mang troi; ay la lam lanh chet lanh. thuan dan so hi. thuan theo su dan ua; long dan thuan thi la tot. thuan phong nhi. (coi chu ly). mua thuan mua nghich. tu quang tro ra, nguoi ta lam ruong hai mua, mot mua de mot mua kho, cung goi la mua trai, mua mat. ben thuanben nghich. ben xuoi ben nguoc; gia nhu con mat sang ve ben thuan, con mat dui ve ben nghich, cung goi la con mat thuan con mat nghich.tay huu hieu la ve ben thuan, tay ta hieu ve ben nghich v.v. ham thuan. noc phu thuoc ve binh-thuan, giap dia phan phuoc- tuy (ba-ria). tu thuan. chiu lam hoa, khong kien cao nhau nua. lap tho tu thuan. lam giay chiu lam hoa cung nhau. khiem thuan. it xuoi, khong duoc nhu y, (thuong noi ve mua mang, gio, nuoc).

ten vua thanh, lam vua trung-quoc, truoc chua ra doi 2258 nam. thuan nhut, nghieu thieu. ngay thuan, troi nghieu; ay la thai binh kieng tuong. nu trung nghieu thuan. trong nhung don da, ma co nguoi duc hanh nhu vua nghieu, vua thuan. (tieng khen nu cong nu hanh). ruong thuan. ruong troi lam, co voi cay, co chim lam co.

tap roi, quen thuoc roi, sua tri roi, da ra diu dang. thuan thuc. da tap roi.thanh thuoc roi.(trau, ngua). thuan tinh. tinh net da diu dang. thuan tay. quen tay, nhuan tay. ngua thuan. ngua tap quen roi, het chung.
tron ven, tinh anh. thuan linh. that la linh thieng. thuan than. id. thuan nhut. tron ven, tinh anh, chang co xen lon. thuan duc. trong be dao duc; duc hanh vung ben.
(chuan)chac chan, that tha. thuan phong. phong tuc tot.

do do mui thuong, giong hinh cai khien ma dai; vat chi co hinh tron nhu trang ga. cai thuan. do do lan ten, mui giao. dang thuan. hinh dang tron ma dai. banh thuan. thu banh xop do ra hinh tron tron. non thuan. non tron ma dai. me thuan. thu keo me. dieu thuan. dieu giay giong hinh cai thuan.
hoc lai, ke bay, noi theo. thuat chuyen. ke chuyen. thuat lai. noi lai, loc lai. ke chi thuat su. (coi chu ke).

chuoc moc, phu phep. thuat phap, hoac phap thuat. phu phep, phep ma, phep lam nhieu su la lung, duong nhu la phep ma. phep thuat. id. tri thuat. chuoc khon kheo, tri bay ve kheo leo, (cuoc lam dong ho, tau khoi v.v.). tam thuat. chuoc long, su minh doc long, dung long the nao, lam that xau, thi la dung long xau. yeu thuat. phep ma, chuoc qui, phep ta vay chang phai la phep dung tri, (cong chuyen thay phap). ta thuat. id.

giuc gia, hoi hap, gap gap, buc nhat. thoi thuc. hoi giuc. thuc toi. toi gan qua, thet toi, buc lam, giuc toi don toi. nhat thuc. thuc toi nhat qua dong ho nhat thuc. cap thuc. gap ruc. hoi nhat thuc. hoi tho nhat, tho gap. thuc thue. giuc phai dong thue cho mau. thuc linh. giuc phai dien linh cho kip. thuc voi. giuc voi toi. thuc ngua. giuc ngua di cho mau.

bo, buoc. cau thuc. lam bo buoc, ep uong. thuc thu vo sach. bo tay ma chiu, khong con chuoc gi, khong lam khong dang. troi thuc ke. troi hau canh tay niet lai sau lung. nhut thuc. mot bo. thuc uoc. dieu giao uoc. quan thuc. coi xet giu gin.mac quan thuc thi la mac phep coi giu khong duoc thong tha. kem thuc. kem giu.kem thuc con nit cho no hoc.
luc thuc. lui cui, luc duc, xay ra xay vo trong mot cho. di luc thuc. di lam lui, di cham cham.
chu, em cha. thuc phu. id. ba thuc. chu bac. quoc thuc. chu vua.

chuoc, the roi se chuoc. thuc hoi. chuoc lai. thu thuc. chiu tien ma chuoc toi. thuc toi. id. thuc mang. chiu tien ma chuoc mang song. di kim thuc hinh. dung tien ma chuoc hinh phat. thuc gia cha mai. the ruong nhieu tien, chuoc khong noi, thi la cha ban. the thuc. the do roi se chuoc. thuc ruong. the ruong pay tien cung giao chuoc lai. ruong thuc. ruong nguoi ta the. cuu thuc. cuu chuoc, on cuu chuoc, lam cho khoi toi tinh.

chin, nau chin, thuoc. thuan thuc. (coi chu thuan). thanh thuc. hoc tap nhuan nha. ruong thuc. ruong da khai pha, da thanh dien, ruong hoa can, da lam roi. dat thuc. dat thuoc, dat da trong tria, dat da vo san. thuc dia. cu sinh dia da nau roi, vi thuoc bo. thuc doc. doc thuoc long. thuc thu. tay tang trai, nguoi biet viec. am thuc. quen thuoc.
(tuc). noi. luc thuc. lan lan, noi theo sau. thuc huyen. noi day don, chi nghia la chap noi, cuoi vo khac. tu bat kha phuc sinh, doan bat kha phuc thuc. chet chang le song lai, dut chang kha noi lai.
lanh. thuc thac. lanh du, tot xau. thuc thu. gai lanh, gai net hanh. yeu dieu thuc nu. diu dang gai lanh.
ten nuoc, ten xu o ben trung-quoc. -qui. loai hoa qui.

cac kieu, kieu vo; khong ngu; ngu day; sac dang. thuc buc. mau trang nhu bac. thuc trang. ve trang tinh. thuc trang, xanh, do, vang, den. ve ngu sac,. trung thuc. nham cach thuc. dinh thuc le. dinh the le. tan thuc. kieu moi, ve moi.xe tan thuc thi la xe kieu moi. thuc day. da ngu ma day, thoi ngu, lam cho thoi ngu, lam cho cho day. thuc no day. danh dong cho no tinh thuc. thuc giac. duong ngu ma thuc day. thuc thoi. thuc, (tieng doi), khong ngu. thuc khuya. (coi chu khuya). thuc truong. thuc luon luon, thuc ca dem. thuc trang con mat. thuc qua suc. thuc thuong xuyen. thuc hoai hoai, bua nao cung vay. tinh thuc. thuc day tinh tao, khong co bo so. say thuc. le thuc, nge dong lien thuc, khong co me ngu. thuc nhap. thuc ngu. moi thuc nam, no da toi. moi thuc day hay con nam, la khi gan sang, ma no da toi thi chi nghia la no toi som qua.

biet, hay biet. tri thuc. hay biet. ke tri thuc. ke minh quen biet. quien thuc. id. nguoi kien thuc. nguoi hoc hanh nhieu; nguoi tang trai. bat thuc thi vu. chang biet chuyen doi, chang biet thi the. hoc thuc. nguoi hoc biet nhieu.

an. am thuc. an uong. cam thuc. an, an cam chung, an cho khoi doi. luong thuc. do an, gao thoc. do hoa thuc. do dung ma nau nuong, cung la do an. thuc khach. khach an, ke kiem an. du thu du thuc. an choi vat ma, chang lo den cong viec lam. thuc duc am hoa. an duc uong hoa, cuo c thai binh, phong tuc tot, thien ha no am. tu thuc ki luc. an thua suc minh, nghia la minh lam lay ma an khong nho cua ai. trung thuc. trung nham vat an khung hap ma phai benh. thuong thuc. id. vat thuc. vat an, do an. nhon vi tai tu, dieu vi thuc vong. nguoi vi tien cua ma bo mang, con chim vi an ma phai chet. thuc ngon. nuot loi noi, khong giu loi noi. thuc nhon tai cuu nhon tai. an cua nguoi, cuu nguoi ra khoi tai hai, he an cua nguoi thi phai cuu giup nguoi. thuc thuy. an nuoc toi muc nao, (noi ve ghe thuyen). tuoc tieu thuc. thuoc lam cho vat an mau tieu. am thuc that thuong. an uong khi man khi lat, khi nhieu khi it, bua co bua khong, khong thuong. nhon mac bat thuc nhi tien tri ky vi . nguoi ai chang an, ma it ke biet mui, chi nghia la it nguoi biet dao ly. ho, nu - nhu mieu. trai an nhu cop, gai an nhu meo; trong su an uong con trai phai an cho manh, con gai an nho nhe cung cho co net. khai vi tan thuc. lam cho mo ti vi, cung chiu vat an; lam cho an uong dang. loc thuc. phan minh huog dung o doi. cay loc thuc. cay lam co nhieu nhanh co the de banh de do cung thi trong luc lam chay. ta lai thuc. ay lai ma an, chi nghia la moi an ma khong kinh.tich rang co nguoi doi qua, toi nha thi thuc, chu thi dua do an, ma khong trong tieng moi, nguoi doi tron con mat ma rang ta khong chiu do ta lai thuc, moi ra doi khat duong nay.chu thi chiu chang phai, y cung khong chiu an ma chet.
trong, vun trong. hoa thuc. lo phuong sunh loi, kinh dinh cho co tien cua.
an khuyet. nhut thuc. mat troi bi mat trang ang, hoa ra u am. nguyet thuc. mat trang bi trai dat ang, hoa ra toi tam.

muon. thue muon. id. thue nguoi. muon nguoi. thue ghe/thuyen/do. muon ghe, thuyen van van. lam thue. lam cong ma an tien. lam thue lam muon. id. o thue o muon. o lam cong viec cho ai ma an tien hay tru tien.

phan moi nguoi phai dong cho nha nuoc. thue dinh. thue bon than, thue dan. thue nhon. id. thue than (man). (man la tieng chuoi phai phu them). thue dau nguoi. id. thue dien, ruong, dien trang. (cung thap vat).thue ruong dat. (thap vat la tien bao dem phai phu them). thue dat. the tho trach, vu dau cung cac thu cay trai v.v. tien thue. tieng dung ma dong thue. thue sai du. thue le loi, thue tien dong troi; thue phu ngoai. xau thue. cong vie phai lam cho quan cung la thue quan. suu thue. id. truong thue. cho dong thue hay la thau thue. danh thue. dinh phai chiu thue la bao nhieu. chinh thue. id. dong thue. dem tien thue ma nap cho quan. nop thue. id. nap thue. id. dong thue. id.( noi ve lua gao). mien thue. khoi dong thue. tron xau lau thue. khong chiu xau thue, nguoi khong can cuoc. thue chanh sac. thue mon gi phai nap mon ay, nhu thue lua phai nap lua. thue chiet sac. thue cho dung tien hay la tinh ra tien ma nap, nhu thue lua cho tinh tien v.v. thue. (thuyet.) thue khach. nguoi muu su, bay bieu chuyen loi hai. du thue. di noi dao, lay su hoc biet, noi viec loi hai lam cho vua chua nge, ma cho lam quan tat, nhu thoi chien quoc.

dot so, dung lua ngon lam cho chay phai ngoai. thui doi. va thui va dot, cung la tieng doi. thui long. dot cho chay long. thui trau. dot ca con trau lam cho chat het long no. thui kieu. dung lua ngon ma dot kien. kien thui. kien bu, kien lop vao ma can. thui thuyen. dot so be thuyen cho khoi ha an. den thui thui. den mo, den lam. den thui. id. den tham thui, trui lam lui. bo den mo cung tro troi.

(thoi). thui thu. id. thui hoac, nac, om. thui qua. thui thui. co mui thui, thui it. thui thay. tieng mang dua hu nhop. nhieu sai thui ma, nhieu nguoi ta thui cut. nha dong ngtuoi o thi chang khoi su ray ra. day thui dit. loai co minh day, bong thui, vi thuoc tieu bo, dam la no cho ngua uong thi ngua map, cung dung ma bop sua.
danh, dam, thoi. thui mot cai. thoi mot cai, dam mot cai. di lui thui. di dui dui, di luc thuc.
thui lui. lui lai, thoi lui, thut lui;. di thui lui. di thoi lui, thoi hau. den thui thui. den mo, den lam.
la thuy. tam lot lung ngua, cap duoi yen ngua. ve thuy. ve nho.
bo coi xa. bien thuy. id. tran bien thuy. tran giu coi xa. ngu bien thuy. phong giu chon bo coi.
ham an, chu phong tang ke chet.
ai. thuy ha. ai. y thuy chi cuu. ay la loi ai.

loai kim loai mong, mau trang nhu bac; nuoc. thuy ngan. (coi chu ngan). thuy tinh. loai kim trong suot, loai chai da trong trang tinh anh. thuy hoa du. dau lua, dau hoi. dau dau cung la thuy tho quoc vuong. o dau cung la dan troi, toi vua. phong thuy. (coi chu phong). thuy than. than nuoc. thuy toc. cac loai ca tranh o duoi nuoc. ve thuy. ve quan linh thuoc ve viec thuy. quan bo thuy. quan thuong tho hay ve viec thuy. thuy su de doc. quan thong lanh cac dao binh thuy. thuy bo. viec duoi nuoc, viec tren bo, dang thuy, dang bo. thuy thung. binh sung da thit, day nhung nuoc. thuy tu. cho nuoc tu lai; ao, ho. thuy dai thuyen tu cao. nuoc lon len, tu nhien thuyen cung cao len.tang do nhau, lam cho trong su the. thuy tieu hoa. thu co dai la, hoa thom, ua ,moc duoi nuoc. thuy chi ma. loai cay co keu ten ay. chung cach thuy. (coi chu chung). nau cach thuy. cung lam mot the, ma dung lua gia hon. thuc thuy. (coi chu thuc). kho thuy. kho tru do dung viec thuy. thuy kha di tai chau, diec kha di phuc chau. nuoc cho thuyen duoc, ma cung co the lam thuyen phai up, loi vi du dan lam toi vua, ma cung co khi lam hai toi vua. nghi huyet tri thuy. kien biet cho co nuoc ma lam o, he cho co o kien thi sao cung co nuoc, ay la deu ong quan- trong nghi ra.
kha, lanh binh. thuyen binh. id. an thuyen. lanh manh. gian thuyen. dut con binh.
can phan, phan bo (noi ve vien quan). thuyen bo. id. thuyen chuc. bo di lanh chuc gi. thuyen di. bo di, nhac di.

ghe thuyen, do dong co the ma di song di bien. thuyen be. id (tieng doi). thuyen lon. id. ghe thuyen. id. hai thuyen. thuyan di bien, ghe bien. giang thuyen. ghe song. xuong thuyen. xuong duoi ghe. thuyen bac vong. mot thu ghe bien, ghe cau. chien thuyen. ghe danh giac, ghe chien, tau chien. hoa thuyen. tau lua, tau khi. gia hai thuyen. ghe bien, ghe cua. thuyen hai dao. thueyn van binh luong theo dang bien. thuyen nan. ghe duong rap bang nan tre. thuyen trang. ve nhut. thuyen ta. ve nhi. thuyen huu. ve ba.
oi; loi noi; loi day. ta thuyet. loi ta mi, dao di doan. thuyet hoang. noi lao.
cho tho ban che so bang nhanh la cay, de nup minh ma ban nai huou. ngoi thum. ngoi rinh trong thum.
mui hoi nhu mam tro, gan thui. thum thum. id. nge mui thum thum. bay mui hoi thui ay. nuoc mam thum. nuoc mam gan thui. um thum. (coi chu thung).

suc minh, co thau lai, rut lai. thun lai. id. thun mat. thut di mat. luoi thut, dai thun. luoi thut vao trong hong, dai thut vao trong minh (noi ve binh tho ta nang). day thun. thu day bang mu cay, keo dai ra ma buong ra thi no suc lai.
trun, thut vao, rut vao. thun thut. id. thun dau. trum dau; thut dau vao.
thu cay chiu lanh. thung huyen. cha me. thung duong. cha. nha thung. id. rung thung. rung; cha me. cum thung huyen. id. thung coi huyen nganh. id.
thung dung. thong dong, vo su, ranh rang. nhuc thung dung. (coi chu dung).
dun lai, dung diu, khong thang, khong sat. thung thiu. id. bung thung. (coi chu bung).

do duong bang tre may, khac mat, de ma dung lua gao. thung mung. thung lon, mung nho.cung duong mot the; cung la tieng doi. thung cai. thung lon nhut, thung chua,. thung gia. thung luong, the cho cai gia; thung dong bang mot gia. lanh lam thung lung lam me. lanh dung nhu cai thung, lung dung lam cai me hot rac.co viec dung hoai; tieng ngam dua o thao trut; khong muon lam toi. bang cai thung. tieng phong chung, chi vat la bao lon.

do dung bang cay, dong vuong hoac dong tron; co nap hoac khong co nap; tieng trong keu; mau nu; than ao. thung bong. tieng doi, chi nghia la thung. thung che. thung dung che. mam tro thung. mam vao thung ma muon thui. bat nien thung. dung day may hoac vanh sat ma bat, khep van thung cho chat (thung tron). -. tieng trong lon danh giap. thung danh cai. danh mot tieng trong lon. thung xeng, pheng. tieng trong lon cug tieng dong la danh lien theo nhau. mau thung. mau den do, mau nu. nhuom mau thung. nhuom mau nu. ao rong thung. ao rong lon, rong kich; than ao rong lon. rong thung theu. rong lam (noi ve ao). thung ruou. thung dung ruou. thung mam. thung dung khong nap. thung cham. cung la thung dung khong nap.

tai nuoc hoac tai khi, da thit sung len, day len, truong len; binh chuong. phong thung. thung khi. thung khuc. (coi chu khuc). thung mat. mat sung day (tai binh). thung chon. chon sung day.id. rot thung. (coi chu rot). ung thung. bo u tre, chat hep, thap thoi, (nha cua). tham thung. tham ton, tham bao, hao ton.
thung thinh. cham cham, dan dan, khoan khoan. thung thang. id.
(thang, thang), do dong; (muoi ba thung lam mot phuong, coi chu hoc). cui thung. id. quan thung. do dong cua quan. thung ca. gia ca, (it dung). do thung thung. do nhe nhe.
(coi chu than).

tieng chi thi, chi khi, chi doi. thuo xua. doi xua, khi xua, xua kia. thuo truoc. doi truoc, khi truoc. thuo dau. luc ban dau, lop ban dau. thuo nguou sanh. doi moi co truoc vat. thuo dau het. doi truoc het, lop truoc het. thuo truoc het. id. tu thuo ay. tu doi ay, tu khi ay. thuo binh sanh. luc o doi. thuo nao. doi nao, lop nao. thuo nay. xua nay, cho den bay gio. an theo thuo o theo thi. an o theo thi the.

chieu, cho ngoi. noitichthuong. noi dat de, noi ngang chuong noi ba thi bang mot, chuyen khong co noi rang co. tay tich. thay day hoc. nam tan tich. an chay nam dat.

sach vo, so sach. tho tich. id. bo tich. id. tich phuong, phong. bien phong gia tai ma niem lai. tich bien, ky. id. tich mot. bien phong lay het gia tai su nghiep. lam bo tich. lam cach dieu. tich quan. quan o dau, ve lang nao, gia quan. dan tich. dan bo, dan dung bo. dang tich. dem vao bo.
tich mich, mac. lang le, vang ve. tich lieu. id. sam tich. ram rap. hu vo tich diet. loi dao phat day rang: muon vat minh ngo thay deu la mot cuoc khong khong.

toi. trieu tich. som toi. tru tich. dem ba muoi rang ngay mong mot tet, dem ay phai giu cho lang le, khong nen dong dat, de ong ba ve cho yen. nguyen tich. dem ram thang gieng, co phep di dem thong tha. that tich. dem mong bay thang bay, nguoi ta noi dem ay sao nguu, sao nu qua song giang-ha cho duoc thay nhau, (coi chu thuoc).
mo. khai tich. mo mang, tu thuo nao.
phep, tru di. dai tich. hinh giet, chinh la mot hinh trong nam hinh xua, (coi chu hinh). tich coc. khong chiu an, bo an, tuyet liep, tu tien.
cuoc don dai lon, de ma an mung ve viec gi. tiec ngoc. id. tiec le. id. an tiec. an uong do don dai, bay yen tiec ra ma dai nhau.

lay lam an nan, lay lam dau thuong. thuong tiec. id. kha tiec. dang lay lam thuong tiec. tiec cua. so mat cua, khong chiu mat cua, dau don vi su mat cua. tiec viec. khong chiu bo cong viec, tham cong viec ke khac. chang tiec. chang an nan, chang ke chi, chang cau con mat. de tiec. id.
nho. tiem tat. ki luong. tiem te. id.
nhon; bot nho. cai tiem. cay mut nhon, mot dau lon mot dau nhon, thuong lam bang sat. soi tiem. soi bot nho, soi tam.
lan. tiem tiem. lan lan. tung tiem. mia mai, gan duoc.
(diem)quan, nha quan. tiem thuoc. nha ban thuoc bac hoac ban nha phien. tiem ruou. quan ban ruou. khai tiem. mo quan ban buon. chu tiem. chu nha quan, nha buon ban.
gia mao, cuop gianh. tiem ngoi, vi. cuop ngoi thien tu. tiem xung vuong. gia hieu lam vua. tiem quon, quien. cuon gianh quon chuc.

lan, giau. tiem tang. (coi chu tang). tiem muu. muu tham. tiem de. tiem tang, an dat. cai tiem. do da bat trot mieng, thuong dung ma de do nau nhu. tiem vit. nau nhu con vit. vit tiem. con vit da nau nhu.

truoc, dang truoc, qua roi. to tien. lop ong lop ba, lop truoc. tien to. id.ong da mat roi. tien quan, vuong. vua truoc, vua da bang roi. tien de. id. tien sinh. ke sinh truoc, ke lon, thay day hoc, thay thuoc, (tieng xung ho). tien hien, thanh. cac thanh hien khon ngoan doi truoc, lop truoc. tien phat. phat ra truoc; day truoc. tien ha thu. ra tay truoc. tien thuong. (coi chu thuong). tien ngon di nhap. loi noi truoc de vao (tai), chi nghia la loi noi truoc nguoi ta hay nghe hon. tien chinh. truoc het. tien chiem gia dac. ai gianh truoc thi duoc (thuong noi ve su khan dat). tranh tien. gianh phan truoc, dua tranh. lu cap hoa tien. phai lo phong truoc khi chua co hoa, dung de nuoc toi tron moi nhay.

hung nguoi tu dang phep truong sinh bat tu, cac vi than thanh. ong tien. mot vi tien. tu tien. tu dao truong sinh. dao tien. dao tu luyen cho duoc phep truong sinh. non tien. nui cac vi tien o, non bong-lai. trang nhu tien trang lam. . thanh tien. tu duoc dao tien, da hoa ra tien. day toc tien. thu day nho la ma dai, bong nho ma do, cu no thi la mach mon. tien phuong. phuong thuoc cua tien. du tien. (coi chu du). thinh tien. lam phep ruoc moi cac vi tien. sai tien. moi cac vi tien ma hoi viec gi, xin lam viec gi. chen ong tien. thu chen xua co ve hinh ong tien. phep tien. phep bien hoa la lung. co tien, tien hay mua. co tien lam cong viec chi cung dang, sai khien ai cung dang. tien phai doa. (coi chu doa). thuy tien. loai cay co o nuoc, co bong thom tho. boi toc canh tien. boi toc cao, phia sau co ve, (cac don ba). khoai canh tien. thu khoai mon lon cu ma co nhieu nhanh, ve hang khoai ngon. nui chon tien. hon nui nho o hat phuoc-tuy, tren nui co mot cuc da, co dau chon nguoi ta ma nho, tuc goi la chon tien. dang tien. chet. du tien. id. ba chua tien. (coi chu ba). trang da dai toc, to tien non bong. lich su di thuong. ma tien. tam la sen, do phu chung quanh co theu thua dep de. ao ma tien. ao co tam theu phu ay. bat tien. tam vi tien co danh thi la: lam-the-hoa, han-tuong-tu, ly-thiet-quay, truong-qua-lao, han-chung-ly, ha-tien-co, lu- dong-tan, tao-quac-cuu.
roi. thiet tien. roi sat. bo tien thi nhuc. (coi chu bo).
hen. ha tien. hen mat, rot hen. ti tien. id. vi-. id. tien dich. cong viec hen, tieng khiem xung cong viec minh la hen. tien cong. id. tien that. nha hen, tieng minh xung vo con minh.

hap, an, xuoi, co loi, co the de, duoc the(cung doc la bien). tien nghi. (coi chu nghi). tien loi. co loi, co the cung co ich loi. tien viec. nuoi viec, de viec. tien hon. de hon, hay hon, co the hon. phuong tien. deu loi ich, deu minh co the lam duoc, ma giup do ke khac. bat tien. khong xuoi, khong co the lam duoc. ha tien. bon sen, chat lot. tien tan. id. dai tien. xuat xo. tieu tien. tieu, dai. dong tien. nuoc tieu con nit. tuy tien. tuy theo the, nuong theo dip nao. nhon tien. id. can tien. duoc the gan gui, gan va co the de. thuan tien. xuoi theo mot the, co the de dang nhut cu luong tien. (coi chu luong).

dung ban xay ma tro got do go. tho tien. tho lam nghe ay. khong tien. khuong tuong co the xay ma xoi got do go, do dong v.v. ban tien. id. cau lon con tien. (coi chu lon). cat tien. cat dut nghien. dut tien. dut nghien. tien bup sen. xay got cay go lam ra nhu cai bup sen.

dang(coi chu tien sau). dang tien. id. tien vuong. loai trung co canh, cot tu con sung, con duong dua hoa ra ; duong gia hoa tien vuong ; tien vuong de trang lai hoa con duong ; thuong goi la kien vuong.
dang len. tien cong. dang len cho vua chua. thuong tien. id. tien si. (coi chu tan).

(tuyen)chi, soi ; cat khoanh. kim tien. chi boc mau vang, cung la vang soi. ro tien. ro duong nho nan ma kheo, co nuc may vot ki. cham tien. kim chi. tien mia. cat khoanh khuc mia da xuoc vo roi de ma an cho de. (tien).

truoc, dang truoc, phia truoc, o truoc. nhan tien. truoc mat, hien tai, con mat ngo thay. muc tien. id. dien tien. truoc mat. tien thanh. cac vi thanh xua. tien tich. su tich truoc. tien can. can kiep truoc. tien trai. no cu, no kiep truoc. tien xa ki phuc, hau xa dai chi. (coi chu phuc). tien quan. dao quan truoc, ca thay co nam dao la trung, tien, ta, huu, hau, moi dao co 12.500 binh ; tuoc quan do thong dao tien. tien dao hoac dao tien. dao truoc, dao binh di tien phuong. tien vang. di toi, di qua. tien nhut. ngay truoc. xa tien. cay ma de, la giong mong ngua, bot no keu la xa tien tu, vi thuoc thong dang tieu.

(tuyen)dong tien thong dung de ma mua ban, thuong duc bang kem, hinh tron ma mong, chinh giua co cai lo xo ; tieng goi sau muoi dong. dong tien. id. tien dong. id.tien duc bang dong ; cung hieu la tien cuoi. tien dieu. id. tien kem. tien duc bang kem. tien moc. id. tien bac. bac tien, cua cai. tien tai. cua cai. tien cua. id. tien thue. tien lam chuoi rieng, de ma nap thue. tien via. id. tien khuyet id. . tien le. tien le loi, du so. tien chuc, tram ngan, muon. tien bo chuc, muoi quan lam mot bo, muoi bo vao mot tram, mot tram bo lam mot ngan v.v. tien du. tien quan khong tru chuoi, du so muoi tien ; thuong tru chuoi moi ve ba dong ca thay la sau dong ; bay gio nguoi ta lam thieu bang hai, cho nen mot ve thieu sau dong cung goi la tien du. tien mat. hien tien. tien chiu. tien de thieu, chua tra bay gio. tien chiet. (coi chu chiet). thiet tien. thiet la dong tien thong dung. com an tien phat. da co com an, lai co tien tra ; buon cong chac chan. lam khong ra tien. lam an tung roi. tinh tien. tinh cho biet la bao nhieu tien. chiet ra tien. tinh ra tien la bao nhieu, may quan ; (bac dong, bac nen). tien ngay tien gop. no phai tra lan tu ngay tu thang. giay tien. giay in hinh dong tien de ma dot cho vong hon ; tuc hieu vong hon xuong am phu con phai lo lot cho qui ; dot tien giay, thi la goi xuong am phu, vong hon duoc tien ay thi duoc thanh thoi. sinh tien. (coi chu sinh). phach tien. id. tien ma gao qui. tien gao ma khong dung dang cung goi la do bien huyen. am tien. tien ma, tien bo vao nuoc khong chim, cung la tien giay. co tien lam ra tien. co von moi lam loi duoc. tien rong bac chay. thiet tien, thiet bac. tien lung gao bi. cu bi san sang. tung tien xai. khong san dong tien. tien mot dong mot chu cung khong co. tung ngat qua. nguoi ta cung thi nguoi ta, nguoi thi tien ruoi, nguoi ba muoi dong. nguoi ta noi den dau la nguoi, ma trong su dai nhau, thuong co phan biet.
cat. tien phat. cat toc, hot toc;. tien thao. phat co, cat co. tien dang. hot tim den.
ten(cung, na). phong lanh tien. ban len. lenh tien. co hieu lenh. hoa tien. (coi chu hoa).
dua ; don bua an ma dua len dang. tien hanh. id. tien biet. id.

giong noi ra, thinh am ; danh gia ; hoi huong phat ra ma dong toi tai. tieng tam. id. tieng noi. giong noi, loi noi, cach noi. tieng don. su nguoi ta noi di noi lai cung truyen di xa. tieng trong. tieng trong keu. tieng mo. tieng mo keu. tieng chuong. tieng chuong keu. tieng song. tieng song bo. tieng sung. hoi sung no. tieng sam. hoi sam ren. mang tieng. nghe don. nghe tieng. nghe noi, nghe danh tieng. biet tieng. biet danh tieng, nhin biet tieng ai. danh tieng. danh gia cung tieng tot. co tieng. co tieng don. duoc tieng. duoc danh thom. tot tieng. tot giong, tot hoi ham, co danh vong. xau tieng. giong khong tot ; mang tieng xau. mat tieng. mat danh ; het keu. khan tieng. (coi chu khan). len tieng noi. cat tieng ma noi; noi. cai tieng. id. tieng khen. loi nguoi ta khen. tieng che. loi nguoi ta che. tieng oan. tieng don oan uc ; minh khong co ma mang loi noi. co tieng ma khong co mieng. nguoi ta noi rang co an nho, ma thiet su khong co. be tieng. mat danh tieng ; tieng tam khong con trong suot ; nghe ra nhu tieng ghe ge. vo tieng. id. tro tieng. tro giong noi, lam cho khac giong, co y lam ra tieng ke sang giau. khac tieng. khac giong noi, khong noi theo giong thuong, doi giong noi. tieng thanh. tieng trong suot, nghe ra thanh bai. tieng duc. tieng nang, tieng o e, giong tho. thanh tieng. keu tieng trong suot, noi ve bac dong. nang tieng. keu tieng nang.id. biet tieng noi. biet noi tieng nuoc nao. khong tieng. khong co tieng tam, khong co ai noi toi, khong co ai khen che. giu tieng. giu danh tieng, giu bon phan. lam lay tieng. doc long lam cho duoc tieng khen ; lam goi la, lam chung doi cho qua viec. hu danh xau tieng. mat danh gia, mang lay tieng xau. mang tieng. mac tieng xau, mang lay tieng noi, mang lay tieng nghi luan. uong tieng. noi vo ich, uong tieng noi. dung noi uong tieng. tieng bieu dung noi, dung bay ve, so e nguoi ta khong them nghe. tieng nhu con. tieng don ra du qua. muon tieng. nho danh tieng ai, lay tieng ai. ban tieng. lay tieng, muon tieng ke khac ma lam loi cho minh. noi tieng. noi danh tieng, lam om som, nghe tieng om som: co no o nha thi noi tieng. noi danh tieng. co danh tieng lon, lam duoc danh tieng. ga tieng. moi hua voi nhau, moi co tieng noi rang sau se lam sui voi nhau, rang se giup do nhau v.v. de tieng. de tieng khen, che lai sau. vang tieng. bat di, khong nghe tieng nua. tieng ken tieng quyen. loi chuot ngot, ru quen, do danh. tieng to tieng nho. id. nhieu tieng. nhieu loi noi. ca tieng. lon tieng, noi lon tieng.
lien loi, lien theo nhau, (loi noi). tiep theo. y theo mot the. tiep loi. nham loi lang, nham nhip. di tiep loi. di kip, di nham nhip.

ruoc lay, chiu lay ; chap, noi. tiep ruoc. ruoc ren, chiu lay, cho ra mat. tiep kien. id. tiep khach. ruoc khach. tan tiep. ruoc ren. ho tiep. dua don, tiep ruoc, thuong noi ve su. le tiep. le ruoc ren, lam le ruoc ren. lien tiep. luon theo, ke lay nhau, luon luon. tiep theo. ke theo, noi theo. noi tiep. noi luon theo, ruoc lay ma noi. binh tiep. binh tiep cuu, binh noi theo sau, binh hau tap. tiep cuu. hiep lai ma cuu nhau, chay den ma binh bo nhau. di tiep. di toi ma cuu nhau, binh nhau. tiep day. chap noi soi day lam ra cho dai. tiep van. chap nhieu tam van lam mot. tiep ghe. luon ghe, van khep lai ma lam luon ghe. luon tiep. luon ghe chap noi khong phai la mot cay nguyen. con tiep. id.
(coi chu tuyet).
gan, dut. doan tiet. dut hai, ngan hai. tiet truong bo doan. lay dai bo van, quan phan cho deu, phep do.

et na, su an o co chung co muc, mua mang, ngay thang, khi hau trong nam. tiet nghia. long ngay thang, trung hau, su giu nghia cung nhau. tiet kiem. can kiem, biet danh de, khong hay xa xi. tiet am thuc, vien sac duc. an uong co chung, xa duong sac duc, ay la phep duong tho. cai tiet. lay chong khac, khong giu mot long tiet nghia. that tiet. mat tiet nghia, bo deu minh giu, mat net hanh, mat dong trinh. tu tiet. chet vi long trung nghia, chet vi net hanh. tam tiet. tam khi hau trong nam, la nhi phan: tiet xuan phan, tiet thu phan; nhi chi: tiet ha chi, tiet dong chi; tu lap: lap xuan, lap ha, lap thu, lap dong. tiet phuc sinh. ngay le phuc sinh. giai tiet. tiet khi tot, ngay tot. khanh tiet. le mang, tiet vui mang. danh tiet. danh gia net hanh. tiet xuan. mua xuan, troi xuan. tiet dong. mua dong, troi dong. tiet nang. mua nang. tiet mua. mua mua, thang mua. tiet muc. tu dieu, tu doan. truc tiet. mat tre. tiet dao su. tuoc quan tran thu. tieu tiet. chuyen nho mon, deu nho mon.
chay ra, xi ra. tiet lau. chay rin ra, ho ra, lau ra.tiet lau quan linh. tiet khi. bay hoi, ra hoi, hoi bay di, mat vi,.
cot troi. ly tiet. trang troi, rac rang. chon ly tiet. chon rac rang, chong lao tu. ly tiet chi trung, khoi vo hien gia chi oan. trong chon ly tiet, de dau khong co nguoi ngay ma mac nan.

tan di, hao mon. tieu di. id. tieu dung, xai. xay dung, xuat phat. tung tieu. tung dung, khong co tien ma dung. tieu khien. giai buon, lam cho khuay lang. tieu tan. lam cho tan ra, pha tan. lam tieu tan. id. tieu tru. tru di het, lam cho tuyet, (deu hoan hoa). tieu diet. id. cham tieu. lau tieu hoa, (vat thuc). an khong tieu. vat an vao khong tieu hoa. thuoc tieu. thuoc hoan thuoc tan hay lam cho tieu vat thuc, hoac cho ta biet dam danh. di tieu. di xuat xo. lam cho tieu com. lam cong chuyen, cho xoc xao, cho dang bua com. noi cho tieu hot com. noi ha rua, noi theo bua an.

eu. cam bong tieu. cam cay neu ay. ngoai tieu sai. chiu viec sai phat ma o ngach ngoai, chua nhap vao ngach ngu nao. tieu da. chuc quan vo hay mot toan binh. tieu danh. dem ten vao bang. tieu bao. yet thi, cao bao. tieu len. neu ra.

lam cho tan ra, chay ra, dung hoa (nhu dong thau). tieu mon. hao mon. tieu ra nuoc. tan di cung hoa ra nuoc, nhu muoi. tieu trinh. trinh bao. tieu the. rao the, ho the, hoi the. khau tieu. loi khai mieng. lay khau tieu. lay khai mieng.

loai day co hot cay thom, chinh la do gia vi. day tieu. id. hot tieu. id. ho tieu. thu tieu cay nguoi ta hay dung ma gia vi. xuyen tieu. tu tieu nho hot it cay, nguoi ta dung ma lam thuoc. tieu so. tieu sach vo. tieu vo. tieu con de vo. tieu thom. thu tieu cay ma lai thom. tieu hoi. thu tieu cay ma gat. tieu lot. (coi chu lot). dam tieu. dam hot tieu an cho nat. ca tieu. ca di ca lai nhu ca hot tieu an. nho ma ot tieu. nho nguoi ma to con mat, nho ma khon lanh, qui quai. tieu phong. phong, buong hoang hau o, co thoa tieu nen goi the ay. coi xay tieu. coi dung ma xay tieu an. coi dam tieu. coi dung ma dam tieu.
ong thoi doc, do nhac. ong tieu. id. thoi ong tieu. thoi ong doc ay.
cay lau. tieu dieu. tan hoang, quanh phe. su nghiep tieu dieu. su nghiep tan hoang, het sach.
thong dong. tieu dao, dieu. thanh nhan, khoai lac, vui choi thong tha. tieu sai. id.
may, tang may xanh, troi. tieu han. id. cuu tieu. chin tang troi, (coi chu tang). tieu nhuong. troi dat.

chay, sem. tam tieu. ba tang hoa khi trong minh nguoi ta, tang dau, tang ti vi, tang bung, sach thuoc goi la thuong tieu, trung tieu, ha tieu. tieu dien. ong than mat nam. tieu dau lan ngach. chay dau phong tran, chiu khon kho. lao tam tieu tu. nhoc long lo lang.
diem, loai giong nhu muoi ma the, vat dan hoa, hay chay. mang tieu. thu diem lam ra. diem tieu. diem tu nhien. phac tieu. thu diem nat. ma nha tieu. thu diem co cuc nhu rang ngua.
dem. nguon tieu. dem ram thang gieng. tieu tieu. ke trom, dua gian.
cuoi. dam tieu. noi cuoi, che cuoi. ho lo tieu. bung mieng cuoi. tieu nap. vui long chiu lay, (le vat).
tuan tieu. di tuan, di tham. thuyen tuan tieu. ghe do, tau do. tung tieu. hep hoi, lung tung, khong co tien dung.
lam phep. tieu tu, nu. lam phep cho con trai trong luc thanh nhon, cho con gai trong luc ga di. tai tieu. lay chong khac.
giong. coc tieu ki phu. giong cha no nhu tac. bat tieu, thang bat tieu, dua bat tieu. deu la tieng che con cai khong hoc hanh, khong bat chuoc theo tinh y cha.
cui. tieu phu. ke hai cui. lao tieu. ong gia hai cui.

ho, hen. tieu nhon. nguoi hen ha, xau xa. tieu nhi. con nit. tieu dong. con tre ; day to nho. tieu tu. con mon (tieng khiem xung). tieu de. em mon. tieu tho. gai nho, gai sang. tieu hau. tre hau ha. tieu sai. tay sai. tieu tam. (coi chu tam). tieu sinh. tro nho, ke nho tuoi. thang tieu qui. tieng mang dua hay khuay. tieu cau. ghe cau. tieu giai. di tieu. tieu dieu. ghe nho. tieu dau. sao dau nho. au tieu. tho au, nho nhit. cai tieu. cai hom nho, cai quach, hom chon con nit. cuu tieu. ten cua bien thuoc hat dinh-tuong. dang tieu. dang dai. dan tieu. dan dinh, tre trai. vo tieu nhon bat thanh quan tu. khong co ke nho, ai giup cho ke lon. tieu le. le phep nho mon ; cua le nho mon. tieu su. viec nho mon. bat cau tieu tiet. khong cau chap viec nho mon. tieu thuyet. chuyen noi choi, sach noi ve chuyen ngoai, chuyen dat de. tieu ve. bay ve, lam ra nhieu cach ; lam chuyen kep cong. tieu hoa dang. do hoa dang tam thuong.

cai o chinh giua, cai ngoi, cai dich. trai tim. tang tam ; long da. trung tim. muc chinh giua. trung tim. trung y ; trung muc giua, ngay muc. tim den. su kin dao trong long ke khac. hieu thau tim den. hieu biet su kin dao trong long ke khac. hong tim. cai dich, cai trong ve do o giua tam bia. phan tim. phan duong trung tim. gan tim. id. ban pha tim. ban ngay vao trung tim.

mau do tia, mau do tham. mau tim. id. sac tim. id. tim dieu. mau nau dieu. ao tim. ao mau tim,. khoai tim. thu khoai lon cu, ngoai da do tham. lua tim. lua nhuom tim. tim gan, ruot, mat. lay lam gian du ma khong to ra. bam tim. bam den. tim ngat. id. tim den. id. tim trong bung. trong bung khong yen ; hoac lay lam kho chiu.
(coi chu tiem).

theo dau, kiem hoi cho ra, cho gap nhau. tim thay. di kiem thay day (nghe nghiep). tim phuong. kiem cho duoc phuong the ; tim den cho nao. dao tim. di rao moi noi ma kiem cho duoc. rao tim. id. doi tim. id. tim khong ra. kiem tim khong duoc. tim vo, chong. di kiem, di hoi tham cho gap vo chong.

deu mach bao ; nhan nhe ; tho tu ; lay lam that, lay lam chac y, dem long cay trong. tin tuc. deu mach bao ; su nguoi ta nhan nhe ; tho tu. tin tham. loi goi tham. tin tho. tho tu. tin ca. id. tin nhan. id. tin nhau. lay nhau lam that, khong co nghi nhau. tin cay. dem bung tin tuong ma cay trong nhau. tin tuong. vi tuong, khong co ho nghi. kinh. id. dem long tin. lay lam that, chang nghi nan. that long tin. id. nhan tin. nhan goi su gi, loi gi. mang tin. nghe tin mach bao, duoc loi nhan nhe. nghe tin. id. bo tin. nhan goi cho nhau. thau tin. nhan thau ; tin tuc goi toi noi. duoc tin. dem tho, trao loi nhan bao. dua tin. dem tho, trao loi nhan goi. dem tin. id. vang tin. vang ve, it khi nghe tin. con tin. tham tu, mat tham, (it dung), ke o lam tin. long tin. long tin tuong, lay lam chac trong long. cho tin. nhan nhe, goi loi noi cho biet su gi. ban tin. id. tin di tin lai. nhan di nhan lai, tho qua tho lai. lam tin. lam cho chac y, de dau gi lam chung. tin di doan. tin chuyen mi mong, phi ly. tin ma. tin rang co ma, hay tin viec ma. voi tin. voi nghe theo, khong xet truoc. tin lanh. tin nhan, loi goi noi viec binh an, viec lanh ; dau lanh. tin du. tin noi ve chuyen chang lanh ; dau du, dau bat thuong. con ruoi dem tin hoac bo tin. khong moi ma den, tieng noi choi trong luc gap bua an uong thinh linh ; minh noi hay la ke khac noi cung duoc. het bung tin. chang con tin tuong nua. tham tin. tham cho biet viec.

tin ; ngay that, trung hau, giu mot long ngay thang ; tin tuong nhau; tho tu, tin tuc. tin nghia. su tin tuong nhau, giu nghia cung nhau. tin thanh hoac thanh tin. long ngay that, trung hau ; o het long, tin het long. chi tin. dam long tin tuong ; het da ngay tin. nhon vo tin bat lap. nguoi khong ngay that thi chang nen nguoi. khinh nac qua tin. nhe u, it tin ; u thi de, thi it thiet ; u bat tu ma khong that long. biet vo am tin. bat khong tin tuc.
do dung bang sanh, bau bung, giong cai hu ma trit mieng. cai tin. id. tin toi. tin dung toi muoi. tin nuoc mam. tin dung nuoc mam. nuoc mam tin. nuoc mam dung bang tin.

sao, dom lua. tinh tu. id. tinh than. id. than tinh. linh lac ; rai rac (nhu sao gan sang). ngu hanh tinh. nam vi sao ngu hanh la sao kim, sao moc, sao thuy, sao hoa, sao tho.lay theo huong thi dong phuong sao moc goi la tue tinh ; nam phuong sao hoa la huinh hoac ; trung uong sao tho la dien tinh ; tay phuong sao kim la thoi bach ; bac phuong sao thuy la than tinh. kieng tinh khanh van. sao sang may lanh, diem phuoc duc. cat tinh. vi sao chieu mang. hung tinh. vi sao du. tue tinh. sao choi, sao phuon. van tinh. sao bang. dinh tinh. sao dung mot cho. hanh tinh. sao chay, sao di. luu tinh. sao bang. tinh si. thay coi sao ma toan mang cung doan viec huu cuu. den tam tinh. den ba ngon. tuong tinh. tinh khi nguoi ta chieu ung 28 vi sao cung giong 28 con thu thuoc ve 28 vi sao, nhu nguoi du thi giong cop, nguoi nhat giong tho v.v. that tinh dan. cho lap ra ma cung sao, thap bay ngon nen. van that tinh. van xoi bay lo de lot day hom, co y lam cho thong hoi. nam tinh. loai cu choc, vi thuoc tieu dam. tieu tinh. vo be, hau, tieu thiep. tinh ky. ky ruoc dau. linh tinh. linh lac, phan phan, chua xuoi, chua an be nao ; viec con linh tinh thi la chua xuoi. nhut tinh chi hoa. lua mot dom.

rong, rac rong, trong sach, tot lanh ; khi luc, tinh khi, giong noi sinh. tinh anh. trong sach, ven ve, khong dung bon nho. tinh khiet. id. tinh sach. id. tinh tan. sach se, nguyen ven, ki cang. tinh thanh. het long thanh kinh. tinh tu. rong viec tu hanh, giu minh ven sach. tinh than nguoi ta o tai con mat. su chong choi, su minh man, lanh loi nguoi ta coi noi con mat thi ngo thay. tinh binh. binh rong ; nguyen ven, khong xen lon. tinh tuong. tuong tan, ro rang. tinh nghe. rong nghe. con tinh. yeu quai, tuc hieu la hon don ba hoa ra, hay hop hon nguoi ta. tinh quai. yeu quai. yeu tinh. id. hon thanh tinh. hon qua. tinh ma. yeu ma ; gian ac, xau xa qua. tinh len dang bong. hon hao qua, (tieng mang). du tinh. du qua. trang tinh. trang lop, trang lam. giay tinh. thu giay trang lang. viet-. viet ki, viet kep. bat tinh. khong ki, khong toan, khong deu, khong tot. choi tinh. choi chong, cu viec choi mai. ruong tinh nhung bac. ruong day nhung bac. an tinh nhung thit. an co mot mon thit, khong xen vat gi, an thit nhieu qua. bot huyen tinh. bot lam bang cu huyen tinh. con moi tinh. con moi, con tot lam. tinh hao. nguyen ven, tot lanh. tinh vi. nguyen ven khong ai ghi so ; sau nhiem ; nghia tinh vi. tinh xao. kheo leo lam. tinh cong. cong viec ki cang, kheo leo. tinh te. ki cang, tu te.
sang. thuy tinh. loai da trong suot nhu ngoc ; loai chai, do lam ve kinh ma nguoi ta luyen ra trong sach. ngoc thuy tinh. ngoc giong nhu thuy tinh. thuy tinh cung. cung dien ha-ba.
sach se. thanh tinh. trong sach. tinh thuy. nuoc phep. tinh tam. long chay sach. tinh vo nhut vat. khong co mot vat gi ; khong ngo.

lang le, yen on. binh tinh. binh yen, lang le. phong diem ba tinh. phang lang khong song gio. tinh trai. bang hieu nha ; cho thanh tinh. tinh that. nha thanh vang. nhut dong nhut tinh. moi khi co viec gi.nhut dong nhut tinh phai cuu giup nhau.

(tanh). thien tinh. tinh troi, tinh tu nhien. tinh troi. id. tinh tu nhien. id. tinh mang. mang song nguoi ta. tinh ly. ly luat tu nhien ; le tu nhien. tinh tot. net tot, bung da tot. dam tinh. tinh net dam tham, tri y vung vang. nhe tinh. tinh net hop top, khong de dat, nhe da. tao tinh. tinh net nong nay. nong tinh. id. tinh coc can. tinh net hay gian hay coc. tinh khi huyet. net o theo khi huyet, theo long vat duc. tinh lang lo. leu lao khong hay lo so. lang tinh. lang tri y, khong cham chi, hay xao lang, hay quen sot. quen tinh. quen theo tinh net. chua dinh tinh net. con lo lang, con ham choi, chua dinh tri y. tinh lo lang, ho hung. tinh y bo tho, khong chu tam. thay tinh net. cai tinh net, bo thoi cu. dinh tinh net. tri y dinh roi, khong con lang lo. tinh me dam. tinh me dam, hay theo long duc. tinh xac thit. id. tinh du. tinh net buong lung. khong that tinh. tri y lang xao, hoa ra nhu dien khung. khong dinh tinh. id. tinh khat khu. tinh khung khung, ngo ngo. tinh ngu muoi. dai dot toi tam. tinh hoa nha. tinh vui ve, hoa thuan. tinh hung hang. tinh net hung du. tinh lung lang. tinh net buong lung, khong biet so ai.

toan tinh, gia so nay voi so kia, bo toan dem ke cho biet so ; dinh gia ca ; suy nghi, lo lieu. toan tinh hoac tinh toan. tinh cho biet so la bao nhieu ; lo lieu. toan tinh. lo toan, suy nghi cho biet phai lam the nao. tinh lai. keu ke lai, dem lai. tinh hop. ke chung, tinh chung. cong tinh. cong ke lai, hiep lam mot noc dong. tinh tay. lay ngon tay ma dem. tinh ro. lam theo thoi moi, khong biet toan, tinh thuoc long. tinh di tinh lai. ke dem nhieu lan, lam cho chac ; suy nghi tuong tat. tinh lam. toan tinh sai lam ; suy tinh sai lam. tinh sai. id. tinh phong. tinh uoc chung, phong dinh gia ca, phong chung. tinh toi tinh lui, tinh troi tinh sut, tinh day tinh mong. tinh be loi hai, tinh du nuoc. tinh gia tinh non. id. tinh leo, leo lac, gian lan. lap muu chuoc, toan be gat gam, gian lan. so hon tinh thiet. so do loi hai. tinh loi lo. tinh cho biet loi lo. tinh rot. toan tinh khong sot nuoc ; toan tinh gia dan. tinh che. id. suy tinh. suy nghi, lo toan ; toan tinh. tinh be cao thoi. lieu be thoi lui ; nga long, khong lam chi duoc nua. tinh be lat no. lo muu ke, lap the gi cho khoi tra no. tinh khong sot nuoc. suy xet ki cang, lo lieu du the ; toan tinh chac chan. ban tinh. ban bac, uu tu ; ban toan. nhut tinh. nhut dinh, quyet y, doc long. vung tinh. xet nghi khong kheo, vung toan.
(tanh). ho, ten dong doi. tinh thi. id. tinh danh. ten ho. ba tinh. dan nhon ca thay.
tinh ruou, het say. tinh ruou. id. khi say khi tinh. say noi the nay, tinh noi the khac ; nguoi khong dinh tinh.

long, tinh y, bung da bien ra the nao. tam tinh. id. tinh y. id. tinh thoi. bung da the nao, cach o voi nhau the nao. tinh nghia. su on nghia, su lam on lam nghia. tinh ly, manh. cach the, su the, ly the. tinh do. duyen do, goc gac, su co. an tinh. on nghia cung nhau. huu tinh. co long ; co y cung nhau ; co y tu. co tinh. id. vo tinh. leu lao, vo tam, chang co bung da gi voi nhau. chi tinh. het long, that long, khong co su chi doi nhau. kieu tinh. doi gia, khong co that long. coi tinh. coi y ; xem qua, nghe ra. dac tinh. uoc chung, phong chung. coi tinh hinh. xem su the. tham tinh hinh. do tham su the (ben giac). tham thinh binh tinh. coi chu tham. that tinh. (coi chu that). tinh cu ngai xua. tinh nghia cu, bau ban cu. chang thuong cung doai chut tinh. dau khong thuong nhau, song phai nghi den su nguoi ta an o voi minh the nao. truc cao de. nguoi doi xem am lanh, tren mat doi thap cao; tieng che nguoi doi hay dua mi, vi ke sang giau, bo ke ngheo hen, coi theo ngon co, ai suy sup thi khong nhin biet. bat tri tinh. khong hay biet su gi. that tinh. nga long, that chi ve deu tuong tu.(coi chu that). bat can nhon tinh. khong biet dua long nhau, khong biet deu. thuyen tinh. gai sac, gai hay lam cho cam dong.

thanh manh, chong choi, choi hoi. tinh tao. id. tinh minh. id. tinh lai. hoi tam, dinh tinh, het con me. lai tinh. id. hoi tinh. id. moi tinh hon. moi hoi tam, moi het so, moi ngoc ngoai. suc tinh. thuc giac, thuc thinh linh, suc nho. chot tinh. id. tinh thuc. thuc day; say thuc, choi hoi, khong me ngu. tinh tuong. lam mat vo su; lang le, khong lo su gi. tinh kho, queo. lam nhu khong co viec, lang trang, khong lo, khong nhuc nhich; tinh qua. ngu tinh. ngu ngon, ngu ngay; ngu dung ngu ngoi. lap tinh. giu net nghiem trang, dam dia, khong xao dong. lam tinh. id.lam mat tinh queo. cho tinh. tieng bao phai cho bang tinh, dung lo so, dung luc lac, dung xao xien. chet tinh. chet con choi hoi, khong me muoi, chet khon ma; chet thinh linh. do tinh do say. nua tinh nua say. di tinh. di ngang, di khong ai hay. bang tinh. bang yen, lang le khong dong dia.ngoi cho bang tinh.

xet, cho dau moi viec trong mot xu lon. tinh thanh. thanh dau moi viec, cho cac quan lon, cam gieng moi quan tri trong mot xu.nguyen nuoc nam co 29 tinh la ha- tien, an-giang, vinh-long, dinh-tuong, gia-dinh, b en-hoa, binh-thuan, khanh-hoa, phu-an, binh-dinh, quang-ngai, quang-nam, quang-duc, quang-tri, quang-binh, nghe-an, thanh-hoa, ninh-binh, ha-noi, nam-dinh, hung-yen, hai- duong, quang-yen, bac-ninh, son-tay, thai-nguyen, tuyen- quang, lang-son, cao-bang.sau tinh trong keu la nam-ki; tu binh-thuan tro ra cho toi hue keu la truc tinh, cung goi la ta- ki; tu thua-thien tro ra cho toi khanh-hoa, keu la huu-ki; tu ninh-binh cho toi giap coi goi la bac-ki, cung goi la thap nhi thua tuyen. chua tinh. quan lon lam chu trong mot tinh lon; quan tong doc. tinh duong. dinh cac quan tinh. tinh phai. nguoi tinh sai. tinh vien. quan vien giup viec tai tinh. tinh sat. xet net, xem xet. than tinh mo khan. (coi chu mo). tu tinh. sua minh.

gieng. tinh dien. phep doi xua lay chu tinh chia ruong ra chin phan, tam nguoi deu lam rieng, con mot phan thu chin thi lam chung cho vua, goi la cong dien. thien tinh. (coi chu thien). co tinh. gieng xua. xay kim tinh. dung voi cat ma to duc huyet ma.
ham, hao. ham tinh dau thach. (coi chu ham).
ti vit, xau ho ; bit di. ti tit. id. co tit. co ti tich, co deu xau ho. mac tit. id. mat tit. id. tit di. nghet di, bit di.
tom tit. thu tom bien. mu tit mu tit. xa mu mu.
do duc bang dong thau, giong cai xap xai, thay chua hay dung ma tung kinh. tiu bat. cai tiu, cai bat.id.
tiu tiu. co hoi uot, hoi nuoc, muon thau ra nuoc. buon tiu. buon ba. tiu tiu. id. tuong mat tiu tiu to ho. tuong mat kho khan buon buc, om top.
theu tiu va may. cong chuyen don ba. gam tiu. gam theu. tiu ve. ve voi, lam ra nhieu cach; them chuyen. lam tiu ve. bay ra nhieu the, lam cong chuyen that mat, nho mon.

lon, tho, kich. to tac. tho kich, lon tac.(cung la tieng doi). to xuong. vam vo, lon xuong hoc. to gan. lon gan, ca gan. to bung. lon bung, bung chang bang. nho nguoi ma to con mat. nho ma ot tieu; nho ma co tri; nho ma sang truong. chi to soi. chi son. day to soi. day lon soi, lon lao. lam to viec. lam lon viec, gay ra viec lon. danh co bac to. ham me co bac, khong ke bac tien. trung to. an nhieu lam, (co bac). thua to. thua lon, thua nhieu lam.id. no to. co no nhieu. an to. an nhieu; co loi nhieu. lo to. lo het nhieu. to von lieng. co tien bac nhieu. hai to. hai lon; thiet hai nhieu. noi to nho. noi tham thi, noi rieng tu. noi to noi nho. khuyen du nhieu cach; noi am tham. tieng to tieng nho. noi rieng cung nhau, muu lop cung nhau.
to mo. bo lo mo, lan mo trong toi. di to mo. di to mo, lan dang ma di.

cay dai de ma chong co xe hoac de ma chong vat gi, thuong dung mot cap. to xe. hai cay chong co xe. sung to. sung co hai cay chong. chong to. dung to ma chong. ngoi chong to. ngoi khong vung, phai chong hai tay ma chiu; bo met nhoc, yeu duoi qua. to re. om qua, con xuong voi da; gio xuong; xep kho. om to. om qua. di nga xieu nga to. di khong vung.
to to. di theo mai. theo to to. id. to mo. lo mo, lan dang ma di. to le ti lom. id. to ti. chuyen van am tham.

bay ra, xung ra; hieu biet; ro rang, lo lo. to ro. ro rang, tuong tat, rang ngoi. to tuong. id. to rang. id. to thiet. bay su thiet, noi thiet, xung ngay. to ra. bay ra, xung ra; cho ngo thay. to long. bay long, cho biet su long, cho biet tinh y. to tinh. id. to bay hoac bay to. chi ve, noi nang, dieu tran. to loi. bay loi, noi ra. to cao. cao bao, khai bao (cho quan). to ve. noi ra, chi ra.noi to ve, thi la noi chi choc. to dau. ra dau ; bay moi. to trang hoac trang to. sang trang ; trang sang suot. to noi duc trong. hieu biet cac chuyen, khong khuat lap ; cho biet cac viec. to soi hoac soi to. soi xet, xet soi tuong tat. to xet. id. to con mat. con mat lanh lam. con mat con to. con mat chua lang, con dung duoc (ke gia). to tai. sang tai, nghe hay lam. nghe to. nghe ro, hieu ro. to lao. te lao, bay chuyen lao.

thue ruong dat, cung hieu la thue nha. to thue. id. 庸 調 -, dung, dieu. ba mon thue xua : to la thue ruong dat ; dung la thue than ; dieu la thue hang hoa. dien to. thue ruong. to tuc. lua thue, lua dung ma dong thue.

song lai, tinh lai, loai cay co ; keo nuoc thuoc, nuoc voi ; trang lot phia ngoai ; cai bat lon thuong dung ma uong nuoc. cai to. cai bat lon, thuong dung ma uong che hue. co to. id.chinh la bat lam tai xu co-to, cho nen lay do ma dat ten. o-. id. to chau. ten xu o ve tinh giang-nam (trung-quoc), cung la co-to. to moc. cay vang. to hap. thu dau thom, tho san khanh-hoa. to hap huong. id. dau to hap. id. tia to hoac tu to. (coi chu tu chu tia). tu to dat. loai co thap, giong la tia to, vi thuoc dat ung doc. to voi. keo nuoc voi ; trang voi. phong to. phong lop va to voi. to tinh. tinh lai. phuc to. song lai.

do da bat, giong cai bat, ma co lung, trot mieng. to am long. to co ve hinh con rong. to con rong. id. to gam. to ve bong hoa. to xua. to nguoi doi xua lam, chinh la to tot. to da. to bang dat trang giong nhu da. to xoi. to dung xoi.
to ra, cao bao. khong. cao thua, kien cao. cao to. id. tram to. id. to lo. lo ra, bay ra truoc mat.
dong gio lon. dong to. id. bao to. id.

von, chay, don so, khong trau gioi. to chat. minh moc, don so, that tha. phac to. id. quan tu to ky vi nhi hanh. nguoi quan tu von lam theo dang bac minh, nghia la khong co lam qua. ao to. ao may bang thu hang lang tron, co bong hoac khong bong. day to. day may bang thu hang ay. to nu. nguoi trung quoc hay dat chuyen noi la mot nuoc co nhung don ba lich su ma khong co don ong, thuong hung gio nam ma de. binh to. binh thuong, cho toi ngay nay. la to. tam nem nho phu cai yen ngua.

ong; ong dau het, ong truyen nghe nghiep; cai o. to tien. tieng xung cac ong ba cung cac lop tren. to ne. id. to tong hoac tong to. cac vi o truoc ong ba xa. ti to. ong to truoc het. thi to. id. ong to. ong truyen day nghe nghiep. to phu. ong; cha cha. tien to. ong da mat roi. to khao. id. mo to. mo ma ong ba, (tieng nguoi ta hay dung ma chuoi nhau). to su. ong to truyen day nghe nghiep. to nghe vo. cop, ong thay.(noi choi). to bom. chinh la bom bai. cao tang dan co to. lop nay dan tich lop kia, chuyen kia nhac chuyen no, khai het dau duoi, goc ngon. to duc tong cong. cong on cac tien to. to quan. que quan, dat nuoc ong ba. to chim. o chim. to ong. o ong. banh to. banh lam tu mieng tron giong hinh cai o chim. bai to tom. thu bai nhieu mon mon, lay bai toi ma lam ra.

chi con tam lam ra;nat nho cung co soi nhu to chi; con tre tuoi, con duong thi. to chi. tieng doi, cung la to. to lua. do hang lua. to manh. chi manh, chi thoang, chi nho lam. tam to. noi chuyen to nho. toc to. toc; mot may nhu soi to, soi toc. canh to chi vai. chi det bang to, chi giang bang vai. ba to. mot cuong to, mot mo to. che to. id. to hao chang chay. chang sai mot may. ong to. tuc hieu la ong than lam mai moi, dinh viec vo chong. ket toc xe to. lam vo chong, doi ban cung nhau. mat moi to quo moi vai. khong lam ban duoc voi cho sang, thi dung do cho hen, (noi ve viec vo chong). roi ram nhu to lon cuong. roi ram qua. roi nhu to vo. id. dap cho to. dap cho nat ra nhu to, (thuong noi ve thit phoi kho ma nuong). tieng to. y chi vua, loi vua phan. trai to. trai moi lon len. gai to. gai moi lon len. con to. con tre tuoi, con xuan xanh. ga to. ga choai, ga moi lon len. trau to. trau moi duoc hai ba tuoi. bo cai to. bo cai nho. cau to. cau cay con nho, moi ra trai, trai cau con to. to tuong, hoac tuong to. tuong nho hoai. to lieu bong manh. tieng ta canh xuan, (tuy-kieu). hang bac to. thu hang det nho chi.
(ti). coi, giu. nha to. cac ke lam viec tu han, trong cac phong viec ben phan, ben niet. o nha to. lanh chuc tu han, o cac nha bua viec.

giong, duong bang, hien tai. tuong to. giong nhau. miu to. gan giong. vi to. vi nhu. xem to. xem duong, xem bang. to muoi xat long. lay lam dang cay chua xot. to mat. o truoc mat. song thac cho to mat. dau song dau thac, cung cho ngo thay. xem to mat. xem thay truoc mat. to con mat. o truoc mat, cho ngo thay.

ban vuong nho co bon chon, thuong dung ma de do. to tien. to khieng tien trong khi di lam le cuoi. to gie. to de hang gie. to thit. to de thit kien bieu ; mot mieng thit suon. thit to. thit kien bieu, thuong cat mot mieng dai. kien mot to ba suon. kien nhau mot mieng thit lon co ba suon.

dua o, dua lam toi, hoc tro, toi. day to. dua lam toi. toi to. id. nguoi to. nha nguoi, cung toi. o day to. o lam toi to, o muon. lam toi to. o hau ha, lam cong chuyen kho nhoc. thay dau thi to do. to phai theo thay.

mot tam giay nguyen, va bang thang, giay bien viet su gi. to giay. mot tam giay nguyen. to sach. mot la sach. to may. tho goi. to trat. giay viec quan, giay truyen bao su gi. to the. giay phep. to khai. giay khai bao, giay viet loi khai. to bao. giay bao ve viec gi. to cam doan. giay bien loi doan the, loi giao ket. to de. giay de vo. to phan ly. id. to so. so sach dang cho vua. lam to gia. lam giay gia, noi chuyen gia mao. to bam. giay bam bao ve viec gi. tro to. chay giay bam bao. chay to. id. bien lang nhu to. bien lang trang. lang nhu to giay trai. lang trang. chiu to chiu giay. chiu lanh viec gi.
to mo. manh me, phan phat, phoi pho. to tai. to tot, tan ra. dau do cay bua to mo. dau do cay bua phan phat. lam an to mo. lam an ?….
(don)giay bien ki hang hoa hoac bien vi thuoc, (noi theo tieng trieu-chau). toa ve. id. toa thuoc. giay bien cac vi thuoc minh muon mua. ra toa. lam ra toa ve. pha toa. id.
muu lop. toa rap. lam muu lam lop, toan lieu cung nhau. dieu toa. (coi chu dieu).

goi, mac. toa vi. cho ngoi. toa xuong. dang dung ma ngoi xuong thinh linh, (nghe vo). ban toa. ban tron. toa toi. mac toi. phan toa. minh lai mac lay toi, nghia la kien gian cho ai toi gi, thi phai chiu lay toi ay. toa thi. ngoi ma coi, ngoi tu nhien ma coi.
coi top toa. xem khong ro, coi chap choa. toa hoa. vo ra, tan ra. chay toa hoa. chay vo tan.

cho ngoi, phong viec. toa ngu. cho vua ngu, ngoi vua. chuong toa. id. toa nha. nha, cai nha. nha ngoi ba toa. nha ngoi cat luon ba cai vo mot. tam toa. ba toa xu viec, la toa so, toa xu viec buon ban, toa tren. toa phan xet. toa dinh toi phuoc, (dao thien-chua). toa giai toi. cho nguoi ta xung toi cho duoc nho on tha thu. toa cao giai. id. toa giang. cho ngoi ma giang giai ve viec dao. ngoi toa. ra tai toa ma xu viec, hoac cho nguoi ta xung toi, (thuong noi ve cac thay ca giai toi). quan toa. quan lanh viec xu doan. toa bua viec. phong viec quan.

(dai). lon, (noi theo tieng trieu-chau). toa hia. anh ca, (thien dia hoi). toa tui. sua soan, lam tot. an mac toa tui. an mac sac qua, ao quan nhum nha. toa khang. id. lam toa khang. lam lon loi, lam mat rong rai, hao phong. noi toa khang. noi lon loi.
khoa, dong, day xich. toa duoc. chia khoa. toa ra. bua ra, tan ra. toa y. mo y, rong y. khoi toa. khoi lop, khoi bay ra.
ho mon, lat nhat. toa tiet. nho mon, hen mon, khong dang su gi. toa toai. id. noi toa toai. noi vat, noi chuyen nho mon.
toac hoac. rach lon, ho ra qua, (thuong noi ve quan ao, bao bi). rach toac. id.
ho ra qua, tet ra, mo bet. mo toac. mo het ra. toac hoac. bo mo bet, mo rong qua, xe tet ra. ha toac mieng. ha mieng lon qua. rach toac. rach tet, rach ra ra. toac mang. tach mang, rach hai ben mep.

lay lam vui long, ung bung. toai thay. vui duong nao, dep y lam. toai bay. id. bat toai. khong ung bung, khong danh long ; te me, khong tho thoi, khong cua quay. ban than bat toai toai. (coi chu than).
te toai. nho mon, khong dang su gi.chuyen te toai.

lo lieu, nghi trong minh phai lam the nao. toan muu. lo muu, tinh phai dung muu chuoc nao. toan dinh. dinh lieu. toan lam. rap lam, doc long lam. toan noi. gan muon noi, nghi muon noi. toan di. nghi phai di, tinh phai di, gan di. vung toan. toan lieu, khong kheo, lieu viec sai lam.
chua. tan toan. cay chua, cay dang, cam kho. toan kho. id. toan tuong. loai cay trai nho co mui chua. toan tao. thu tao chua, bot no sao den, thi la mot vi thuoc hay lam cho nguoi ta ngu yen.

suy tinh, dem ke, bo con toan ma tinh. ban toan. ban co nhieu hot, nhieu ngan de ma tinh. con toan. hot ngan trong ban toan. phep toan. phep day cho biet tinh toan. bo toan. dat con toan, bo ?ma tinh. but toan. viet lach, tinh toan, ay la cong viec, nghe nghiep ke lam to lai. toan mang. phep suy tinh ngay sinh thang de ma doan ve so mang nguoi ta song duoc bao lau, sang hen, ngheo giau the nao. toan so. id. tho toan. ke thong viec tinh toan, so truong nghe but toan. vi toan. vi so dat ra de ma toan: vi nhut. vi mot, con mot, nhung so thuoc ve con mot. vi thap. vi muoi, con muoi, nhung so thuoc ve con muoi. vi ba. vi tram, nhung so thuoc ve vi tram. vi thien. vi ngan, cho ngan ve vi ngan. vi van. vi muon, cho ngan ve vi muon, vi muoi ngan. vi uc. vi muoi muon, mot tram ngan. vi trieu. vi mot tram muon, vi muoi uc. vi kinh. vi muoi trieu. vi ti. vi muoi kinh, mot tram trieu. vi cai. vi muoi ti, vi mot ngan trieu. vi nhuong. vi muoi cai, mot muon trieu. vi cau. vi muoi nhuong, muoi muon trieu. vi gian. vi muoi cau, tram muon trieu. vi chinh. vi muoi gian, ngan muon trieu. vi tai. vi muoi chinh, muon muon trieu.

nhum; tieng tro tu. trang toat. trang lop, trang lam. bac toat. id. tich toat. vay va, khong gon ghe. noi cuoi tich toat. bo noi cuoi hon ho qua. an trau tich toat. an trau vay va day mep. toat khau. tum mieng.
toc mach. hay dom ngo, hay luc lao, nguoi khong de dat.

long dai moc tai dau nguoi ta. toc bac, hac. toc tro trang, den tuoi gia. toc mai. toc hai ben mang tang xu xuong. toc may. toc to soi. toc mat. toc mau mat, giong mau huyen. toc ngua. toc xau hay lam cho ngua ca dau. toc do. toc nho soi va ung mau do. toc xanh. toc den xanh, tuoi tre. toc vang. toc ung mau vang lot. toc tran. toc con truoc tran. ket toc. chinh nghia la boi toc, van toc, tuc hieu la ket doi ban. van toc. quan toc chung quanh dau. dau toc. mot lon toc, toc boi lai roi. toc to. cung la toc. de toc. de toc cho dai, khong cao. ven toc. ven tem toc len cho gon, keo no do xuong. go toc. chai go toc cho xuoi. cao toc. cao got toc cho toi da dau. xo toc. xo dau toc khong co boi. bo toc xa. de toc xu xuong, khong boi. toc dai. toc de dai. trang da dai toc. bo xinh tot, dep de.

ho, ho hang, dong doi. truong toc. ke lam lon trong ho. dau toc. id.ke lam dau trong ho hang, thuong chung su ve viec cuoi hoi. than toc. ke ba con trong ho. noi toc. ho noi, dong doi ben cha. ngoai toc. ho ngoai, dong doi ben me. nu sinh ngoai toc. con gai ve ho ngoai, co ba doi ma xa. tru di tam toc. (coi chu di). cuu toc. chin ho, chin doi, tu cao, tang, to, khao, cho toi tu, ton, tang, huyen, ke ki than 己 身 nua la chin. toc loai. dong giong.

mau, chong ; do trong, vet ra. tuc toc. tuc thi. tac toc. cho mau, cho kip. hoa toc. id. tan toc. id. lam tuc toc. lam bay gio, lam hoi ha. chay tuc toc. chay mau, chay lien. toc di. do di. toc men. do men, vet men. gio thoi toc nha. gio thoi bay tranh la con nha trong, con suon khong. duc toc bat dat. muon mau chang tien, muon cho gap thi khong xuoi. tram toc. ve loai cay thom, (coi chu huong).
hoc toc. (coi chu hoc).

do nhot ca, ket bang tre vot nhon, mot dau no mot dau tot, co the cho con ca chun vao ma khong the chun ra. cai toi. id. toi nha. cai rong, cai dut, do dung ma nhot ca, co the chun vao ma khong the chun ra.(it dung).
dich khi hai trau bo. mac toi. mac dich khi ay. chet toi. chet vi dich khi ay. trau toi. con trau mac toi. toi trau. dich khi bat trau.
doi toi. xieng toa, day xich, day de ma cot troi. loi toi. id.
tieng tro tu. tim toi. tim kiem.

loai giong nhu hanh, giep la, lon cu ma cay nong. cu toi. id. mui toi. mot tep, mot cai boc trong cu toi. tep toi. id. toi muoi. toi dam giam. toi toi. loai giong nhu toi, lon la, lon cu hon ma khong cay, vi thuoc tri chung dau minh, phai dam no ra ma thang voi giam. noi hanh noi toi. noi hanh, noi chung len ve chuyen ke khac. nuoc mam toi. nuoc mam co bo toi.

tieng xung minh ; ke lam tay chon. toi to, ta. ke lam tay chon, lam day to. toi moi. ke ban minh cho chu ma lam day to. toi nguoi. toi voi anh, toi voi ngai. toi chua gap nhau. day to, chu nha gap nhau ; vua toi gap go. chung toi. tieng xung bon minh. mo, moi, vo, voi toi. id. lam toi. lam day to, lam tay chon, thu ha. than toi. tieng chi than phan minh ma noi ; cai than toi, minh toi, than phan toi. khon than toi. phan toi khon kho duong nao. dang dai biet suc ngua, nuoc loan biet toi ngay. (coi chu biet).

su pham luat, pham phep, trai le hang, deu hung du, bat nhon, deu bao hai, deu lam cho minh phai hinh phat. toi loi. id. toi khien. id. toi ac. toi loi nang, deu bao hai. toi tinh hoac tinh toi. deu can pham, deu loi lam, su co gi lam roi cho minh. toi va. deu vi pham, phan phat ta. toi nang. toi tinh trong lon. toi trong. id. nang toi. lon toi, nhieu toi, phai phat nang. lon toi. id. trong toi. id. toi nhe, toi khinh. deu vi pham khong co trong. nhe toi. it toi, bi phat nhe. may nang toi lam. may phai phat nang lam, toi may lon lam. mac toi. can pham toi deu gi, mac phat vi toi gi. dac toi. id. co toi. mac deu pham phep, da lam deu toi ac, phai trung tri. phai toi. id. tu toi. ke bi an phat, bi cam tu. ke co toi. ke mac an phat, ke pham toi loi. cam tho toi. cam chiu phat ta. phuc toi. chiu su minh vi pham. tri toi. bat phat, sua tri. van toi. hoi toi; hoi co chiu toi, chiu thu phat chang. hoi toi. id. noi toi. noi gian cho ke khac. xung toi. to cao cac toi loi minh da pham (truoc mat thay ca). to toi. chieu xung, to cao toi loi minh. an nan toi. dau don rau buon vi toi minh lam. toi to tong. toi ong to chung de lai, moi nguoi deu phai mac. toi minh lam. toi minh pham. toi lien can. toi lay, lien luy toi nhieu nguoi, mac chung trong vu kien cao nao. toi ong toi cha chi ma. co mac muoi, co can chi ma. biet toi. nhin biet toi minh, biet minh la nguoi co toi; biet nuoc loi. vo toi. khong co vi pham deu chi. nguoi vo toi. nguoi ngay lanh, chang co toi chi. hoach toi u thien vo so dao gia. co y nghich mang troi, thi chang co cho nao ma cau cho khoi. (coi chu dao). cong toi. toi loi lam ve viec quan. tu toi. toi rieng, toi an hoi lo, lam deu trai phep. vu phan toi dong. cao gian cho ke khac ve toi gi, thi phai chiu lay toi ay. toi phuoc. du lanh, deu lam cho minh phai toi, deu lam cho minh duoc phuoc. khong biet toi phuoc. khong biet du lanh; khong biet dang lam lanh, lanh du, cho khoi viec bao ung. khong biet so toi. khong biet so su bao ung, khong biet so phep. cuc toi. cuc bao hai, su co lam hai cho minh; (tieng trach con cai hay gia bao gia hai). de toi. gia bao, gia hai, (tieng than trach). toi lien toa. toi can lien. toi phan toa. toi cao giao ma minh phai mac. toi lay va tron. toi mac lay, va phat chung. toi da va lay. co deu loi lam, pham phep, thi phai ha minh ma xin cho khoi. toi bang troi. toi nang qua, lon toi qua.

dem hom, mu mit, am tham; rat, lam. toi tam. mu mit, khong ngo thay su gi; ngu muoi. toi mo, den. toi lam; mu mu, mit, mit. toi troi. troi khong co trang; troi mu mu. toi nhu troi ba muoi. toi den, toi lam. den toi. den luc dem hom. som toi. som mai, chieu toi; ban mai, ban hom. toi ngay. ca ngay. toi ngay sang dem. ca ngay dem. toi mat. choang con mat ; con mat khong thay dang. toi tri. cham hieu, khong duoc sang lang. chap toi. hoi gan toi. xo toi. cho xo, cho khuat mat, cho khong ai toi lui, khong ai ngo thay. bua toi. bua an toi ; buoi toi. phong toi. khuon tuong, do lay chon dung. tuc toi. tuc minh, oan uc lam. noi xo toi xo sang. noi chung, noi vung. toi ki, o. lay lam ghet lam, khong ua chut nao. toi can. gap lam, (noi ve ong can phai de di gap).
(doi). hu, nga. toi tan. phanh phoi, tan te, tan hoang. phong tuc toi bai. phong tuc bai hoai.

rach ra, chap noi tu mieng. ao toi. ao che mua, cham bang la. toi ta hoac ta toi. rach ra, te tet. toi tot. id. toi boi. id. ca loi toi boi. ca loi lang xang, dua nhau ma chay. day mong toi. loai day hay leo rao, day la tia tia, trai no chin co mau do bam. chi bang can truoc ao toi, danh cuong loi toa mat doi dua tranh. an phan ngheo.
(coi chu tai).

den, di den, cho den, thau den. chay toi. chay den cho nao. noi toi. niem no, noi den ai, noi qua chuyen gi. hoi toi. niem no, hoi han. lo toi. tuong den; lo be tan toi. nho toi. nho den. thuong toi. dem long thuong. dong toi. da dong. toi noi, chon. thau den noi, chon. toi ki. den ky hen. toi so, mang. so mang den roi, toi chung roi. toi van. id. toi tai. nghe duoc roi. lam cho toi tay. lam cho ra viec, lam thang phep, lam han. sac thuoc cho toi. chung nau thuoc thang cho vua chung, nhu mot chen ruoi con bay phan. toi quan, ai khon ngoan thi biet. den truoc mat quan, moi biet ai phai quay, ai khon dai.(noi ve viec kien thua). toi tet. den ngay vui dau nam. ke truoc toi nguoi sau cung toi. nguoi truoc duoc; nguoi sau cung duoc; tieng khuyen ke hoc hanh, ke theo dang cong danh. di cho toi noi. di cho den cho minh phai di. nuoc toi tron moi nhay. khong biet lo hau. khong ai biet toi. khong ai biet toi. bai toi. thu bai bat cap, ai bat duoc du cap truoc thi goi la toi, nghia la den truoc roi cung duoc an tien. say nga toi nga lui. say qua, say nhao. van tay voi chang toi cao. than phan ngheo hen, khon sanh buc giau sang, (noi ve viec cuoi vo lay chong). toi cau toi. tieng he dong hoi chu no di.
gom lai, cot thau lai; lam phep tom giu (theo men, moi). tom luoi cau. cot tom luoi cau. day tom. day that nhieu gut de ma tru ta.(theo phep men, moi). cot tom. cot day gut ay cho ai.

nhom gop, rut lai, thau cho van, lam cho van. tom thau. thau gop; dem lai mot cho; thau ve mot moi; lay di het. tom ve. rut lai, dem ve mot moi. tom ve mot moi. id. tom lai. lam loi noi rut. tom gop. thau gop. tom tat. lam ra van tat; loi noi tat. noi tom. noi rut lai, noi viec ca the. tong tom. nhom cac deu the ca, lam cho van tat; gom ve mot moi. gom tom. id. cot tom. cot nhom lai, cot thau lai mot moi. tom luoi cau. (coi chu tom).

loai o nuoc, minh cong cong, co dot co long, hay di thoi lui, co di thi bung cai duoi. tom tep. tom lon, tep nho ma giep, cung ve mot loai; dung nhu tieng doi. tom bac, dat, rang, long, lua, chau, su. cac thu tom nho. tom tit, ket, hum, gong, cang. cac thu tom lon. tom song. thu tom hay o song, o nuoc ngot. tom chac. thu tom bien con bang ngon ?cai, nguoi ta lay lam ngon. mam tom. mam lam bang tom. kho tom. tom nho phoi kho, hoac la tom say. cau tom. cot moi ma nhu tom. vot tom. dung vot ma bat tom. mo tom. mo ma bat tom deo theo cha theo co duoi song. lung tom. lung noi xuong song cong vong, lung khum khum. con tom nhu con ca. dung moi nho ma nhu con ca lon; mat it ma duoc nhieu. moi tom. moi nho, le vat nho mon; ay la nghe nhung nguoi lam quan nho, di le cho quan tren it, ma gop dan, an dan thi nhieu. duoi tom. vat chi sau duoi re hai ma up lai, nhu cai duoi con tom. ghe duoi tom then tro. ghe cho ca dong, (coi chu ghe).
ton lot. dut lot; mua long ke lon.
ton ten. bo thong xuong cung dong dua. danh ton ten. deo thong thong, dua qua dua lai. dua ton ten. dua qua dua lai ma hong len.
tieng trong nho.

cao, trong, tang len. ton kinh. het long cung kinh, lay lam cao trong, kinh trong. ton trong. id.qui trong, sang trong. ton tanh. tieng hoi ho ke lon la ho gi. ton xung. cach hoi danh hieu ke lon; xung tang, keu tang. ton len. tang len, kinh nhac len. ton vuong. kinh nhac len lam vua, tang len ngoi bau. ton qui. sang ca. ton su. tieng tang xung ke lam thay. ton truong. ke truong thuong, dang kinh trong. ton huinh. tieng xung tang ke lon hon minh. ton ti (thuong ha). cao thap, lon nho. chi ton. rat cao sang. thien ton. dung cao trong o tren troi, (noi ve phat). nguon thi thien ton. dang lam coi re o tren het, dau het, (phat).

chau; ten ho. tu ton. con chau. dich ton. con con truong nam. tang ton. con dua chau, chau ba doi. huyen ton. con con dua chau, chau bon doi. vien ton. chau xa. hoang ton. chau noi vua. cong ton. chau vua. thien ton. nang tien goi la chuc-nu. ngoai ton. chau ngoai. ton quon. ten ong vua doi tam-quoc.
hao phi, uong phi, hu mat, ton that. ton hao hoac hao ton. id. ton kem. id. ton cong. mat cong, uong cong. ton cua. mat cua, uong cua. ton tien. mat tien, uong tien. so ton. so hao phi, so mat.
thuan, que thu nam trong tam que. huong ton. huong dong nam. gio ton. gio dong nam. ton ngon. loi noi diu dang, hoa nha.
con; gin giu, danh de. chi ton. con lai, dong lai. de ton. de danh, de don. bao ton. giu gin, bao boc. on ton. hoa nha, trung hau. ton ten. bo nang ne, be bon.

ton hao, hao mon, giam bot. ton phi hoac phi ton. ton hao, xai phi. ton that. that thoat, hu mat, hu hao, (thuong noi ve su lam mua). ton thuong. id. ton hai. hu hai, thiet hai. hao ton. hu hao, hao mon. ho ton. chung ho khuc khac mot doi tieng ma lam cho phai gay mon. ton duc. bat nhon, that duc, mat phuoc duc.
huong, khiem nhuong. khiem ton. id. ton nhuong. id.
tieng tro tu. lon ton. (coi chu lon).
manh bao. du ton. hung du, lung lang, hung ac. hung ton. id.
lam bon ton. lam bo lang xang, ham ho; lam bo ron ma di dau. trau cau bon ton. trau cau ron rang.
(tan). ton thi hoang. danh hieu ong vua dot sach, chon hoc tro, (doi nha tan).

hai kinh viec truoc, ran minh chua cai. ton kinh. id. ton don. bi don ma that kinh, nho su phai don ma so. mot lan cho ton den gia. bi mot lan roi, phai ran so cho den gia. chua ton. chua biet so, chua khon, chua chua.

bo om ma dai. om tong. om nhom, bo ca nhom, om lam. tong teo. id. tong tot. id. con ca tong. loai nai huou, minh thot lai ma cang cao. ca long tong. thu ca con con, bang trang ngon tay, hay an tren mat nuoc cung hay ruc ria. ruc ria nhu ca long tong. tieng trach nguoi hay xin xo, hay bon mot cua ke khac.

thu cay hay chiu suong nang. cay tong. id. tong cuc. anh em ban. tong ba. cay tong cay ba, la hai thu cay ben chac, song lau. tranh tong xich tui. man chan, tuong lien, do trang suc. tue han tri tong ba chi tam. nam lanh moi biet tinh cay tong cay ba, co hoan nan moi biet long nguoi.

bui ram. tong tap. ram rap. vi tong khu tuoc. lua chim ve rung bui, doi voi cau vi uyen khu ngu 爲 淵 驅 魚 nghia la duoi ca ve vuc sau, vi du ke bat nhon khong biet nuoi dan, lam cho dan phai bo xu minh ma tim toi cho co nhon.

dong, ho, coi re; dung cham. tong toc. dong ho. tong than. ba con ruot ra. tong chi. dong doi, nhanh ba con, con chau. tong phai. id. tong mon. id. dong tong. dong mot ho, mot dong. ngoai tong. ho ngoai. qui tong. ve cung dong doi, ve cung cha me, ba con; gai bi chong de phai ve phai ve cung cha me, goi la qui tong. ke tong do. ke moi mang, goc tich. ke tong tich. id. tong mieu. nha tho to tien, mieu tho ong ba. tong cham. dung cham. tong phai. tuong nham, dung nham. duc tong. thu duc lon. tong ra. tuong ra, xong dut ma ra.

dua, duoi, xua duoi. ho tong. cam binh khi dua di, ho giu doc dang. luc tong. sao ra ma goi di cac noi, (noi ve giay viec quan). tong khu; tong loi tong khu. duoi quach, bat mot hai phai di di, khong cho o. tong di. duoi di. duoi tong. duoi ngay, duoi dua. xo tong. xo manh. tong tai, ach. lam phu phap ma duoi ta than hay lam tai nan. tong hoa, hoa bo. lam phep ma tru hoa tai, duoi con hoa. tong vo kham. lua vo nguc, bat vao trong nguc, bo vo kham. nuoc chay tong. nuoc chay manh, nuoc chay dua. noi hong tong. noi lon loi, rong mieng lon tieng. tong khach. dua khach di, cung la tong quai. tong chung. dua dam ma, lo viec chon cat. tong tang. id. duong sinh tong tu. nuoi ke song, chon ke chet. tong hoa ho. lop nap gia thuoc hon, de cho hoa ho bat ra phat ra cho manh. dan tong. dan lon nap phia sau de cho no dua dan chai.
uoc tong, nha tong, (trung-quoc). lu tong. nuoc ma-ni.

tom, gom; mot dia phan chung nam, muoi lang. tong lanh. chuc lanh binh. tong binh, nhung. tuoc quan vo gom hay viec binh. thien tong. tuoc quan vo hay mot tram binh. ba tong. tuoc quan vo duoi bac thien-tong. chanh tong tai. tuoc quan lon chu truong viec gi, (nhu lam lich lam sach v.v.). tong suat. gom viec doc suc. tong quan. chuc quan doi xua gom hay mot lo, goi la lo tong quan, so theo chuc che thoi nay thi la quan dao. tong luan. sach luan rut ra cac chuyen trong su. phan tong. mot dia phan nho o trong mot huyen chia ra, co chung nam, muoi lang, de cho mot nguoi nao trong cac lang ay lua ra lam dau, doc viec binh luong, tuan phong trom cuop, cung goi la dan quan.

nhot, teo, om qua. top riet. nhot minh con co mot chut, nho qua. cai mat top riet. cai mat nho qua, nhon qua. top kho. teo riet lai nhu cui kho. top vat. om nhom, con xuong voi da. top mo. cai xac mo; thit mo thang roi, teo lai con xac.
doan, lu. mot top. mot lu. hai top. hai lu. tu top. tu lu, tu bon. lam hop top. lam gap qua, voi vang qua.

rut ra, qua khoi, hon, nhon, vot. tot guom. rut guom. tot chung. hon chung, hon nhieu nguoi. tot khoi. qua khoi. tot non tot nui. qua lam. di tot. di len, di mat. chun tot. chun tuot. lot tot. (coi chu lot). noi tot tet. noi keo kec, ngay nga. cay tot ngon tot dot. cay vot ngon, nho ngon, nho dot.
(tieng tuc). dam tot. dam ngay, dam tuot. chay tot. chay tuot, chay ngay vao. thoc cay thong hong vao mieng sung, no chay tot. -. tieng con ga choi thua chay ma keu.

thau den noi roi, den noi, dung den, cung roi. cung tot. cung roi, het roi, giap roi, den noi roi. theo tot o. theo cho den cho o, cho o. tot ngon. den ngon roi, thau ngon. tot pham. den pham cao hon het, khong con pham nao nua. tot chon. dau thon duoi chon, gia nhu hai cai xuong dung lay nhau.

xung dang, nen the, lich su, dep de, tu te, doi voi tieng xau; nhieu, manh. tot lanh. id. xinh tot. dep de. tuoi tot. toan hao, moi tot. tot net. dam tham, de dat, diu dang, khong hop top, nong nay. tot tinh. tinh khi diu dang, diem dam; tinh y vung vang. tot tri. co tri nhieu, day tri. tot chi. co chi vung vang, khong hay son long, thoi chi. tot the. duoc the, co the than nhieu. tot the lam giac. tot tuong hoac tuong tot. tuong mao dep de lich su. nguoi tot. nguoi lanh, nguoi chinh truc, khong lam su gi xau. tot tieng. tieng keu thanh: chuong keu tot tieng; giong thanh bai: hat tot tieng. tieng tot. co tieng khen ngoi. tot dang, dang. hinh dang dep de, de coi. tot lom. tot cho nup. tot troi. troi thanh bach; phai thi tiec. troi tot. id. tot con. con de ra ngo nghinh; nhieu con. tot sac. co bong sac. sac tot. sac xinh, bong sac dep de. tot trai. lich su trai. tot so. so van may man. tot tay. co tay hap lam su gi, (coi chu tay). tot noi. kheo noi; co nhieu van noi: nhieu nguoi noi. noi tot. noi hay, noi de nghe, noi suon se; noi khong vap. noi tot cho. noi tu te cho ai, noi deu khen ngoi ai. lam tot. trau hinh chuot dang. tot suc. manh suc, nhieu suc luc. beo tot. beo map va dep de. tot nhut. tot lam. tot ban hang. dong ban hang, co nhieu nguoi mua ban lon. tot tay sai. nhieu tay sai; tay sai gioi. dat tot. dat hay sinh cay trai, dat nhieu phan, dat phi nhieu; dat rao re. thuoc tot. thuoc qui, thuoc lua, thuoc hay, (thuoc bac). tot thuoc binh moi lanh. co nhieu thuoc hay binh moi kha. tot lo. gioi lo, lo nhieu the. tot lop. nhieu muu lop, nhieu the gat gam hay. noi tot lop. noi nhieu the, noi cho keu. tot via vang. via vang may man. si tot. quan linh. con tot. con co dat lam quan linh. het tot. het sach; chang con chi la tot, do xau. tot nin. hay nin, hay nhin. sung tot. sung hay. tot sung. co nhieu sung hay. tot quan linh. nhieu quan linh hay.

xet hoi, tan van, xet cho ra viec, de vao, rap vao, rap lai, ket vao. tra tri. xet hoi cho ra viec, cho biet su co. tra xu. xet viec ma xu dinh. tra soat. xet net, kiem tim. tra ra. xet ra, hoi ra. tra ra la dua nao trom cuop. tra cho ra. tra hoi cho ra moi, cho duoc viec. tra khong ra. tra hoi khong duoc. tra viec. xet viec. tra mieng. hoi mieng, khong dung roi vot. tra vao. rap vao. tra tay. ra tay, tho tay. tra mieng. ra, rap lam cho mieng mom khit khao, noi ve mieng keo, hong cot; dung mieng vao, noi den. tra cho mam, mam. ra, rap vao cho mam cho chac. tra nut ao. ket nut ao. tra thuoc doc. bo thuoc doc vao dau, lam cho ke khac mac thuoc doc. tra can. trao can cho ai, bay bieu cho ai, giao viec cho ai, bao phai lam deu thiet hai cho k khac. tra can rua, can dao, can cuoc, can gao. tra thap can rua, dao, v.v. khat tra. xin xet hoi. hau tra. chuc hau cho quan, cho lang tra xu. ca tra. thu ca nuoc ngot nhieu dau mo. cay tra. thu cay choai choai hay moc hai ben me song, la giong la bo de. rach tra. ten rach o ve huyen binh-long, gia-dinh. bang tra. ten nga song thuoc phu di-minh (ben-tre). song tra. ten song o ve tong cau-an-ha.
cai can, cai xac. tra te. id. khu tra. bo can, xac.

qui quyet, xao ngon, doi tra. da tra. qui quai lam. tra hang. gia hang dau. tra bai. gia thua. tra hon. gia viec cuoi ga, hua mot noi, ga mot noi. khi tra. doi nhau, gat nhau. man tra. id. qui tra. qui quyet, lam qui quai. tra danh. mao ten. tra ngon, ngu. loi noi phinh pho. tra trinh. xyen ngoa, trao tro, (coi chu tro).
